jobs.excerpt: Job Summary At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.



Job Description

As a Senior Manager of Corporate FP&A at Fuze Health, you will play a pivotal role in shaping company-wide financial strategy and providing actionable insights that drive business performance in the rapidly evolving pharmacy industry. You’ll lead the development and execution of enterprise-level financial strategies, collaborating with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth initiatives and ensure operational efficiency across the organization. Your insights and leadership will influence key decisions, ensuring Alto remains competitive in the market while advancing our mission to improve health outcomes for all.

In this senior-level role, you’ll take ownership of complex financial analysis, forecasting, and budgeting processes at the corporate level, driving consolidated performance reporting and identifying opportunities for operational optimization. You’ll work closely with department leaders and executive leadership to support their decision-making, positioning Alto for continued success in the dynamic pharmacy landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Strategy Leadership: Lead the development and execution of financial strategies aligned with Alto’s long-term business objectives, driving the company's growth and competitive positioning.

  • Senior Leadership Interaction: Partner with executive leadership to provide strategic financial guidance, contributing to high-level decision-making and the overall success of the business.

  • Advanced Budgeting and Forecasting: Oversee the company’s consolidated budgeting process, working with key stakeholders across the organization to create accurate, data-driven forecasts and financial models. Lead corporate-wide financial planning and ensure that plans support growth and operational targets.

  • Strategic Financial Analysis: Conduct comprehensive financial analysis, identify trends and patterns, and present actionable insights to senior leadership to optimize business performance and guide future investments.

  • Executive Performance Reporting: Develop and present detailed financial reports that track company-wide key performance indicators (KPIs), analyze variances, and recommend actions to senior management and the board.

  • Cross-Functional Business Partnership: Collaborate with Accounting, Treasury, HR, IT, and business unit leaders across the organization, providing financial leadership and support to drive decision-making and promote alignment company-wide.

  • Risk Management and Strategy: Identify and assess financial risks and opportunities, developing strategies to mitigate risk and maximize growth potential, with clear recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Process Innovation: Lead efforts to improve financial processes, enhancing the efficiency, accuracy, and impact of the FP&A function.

  • Leadership and Team Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of FP&A professionals, fostering a culture of collaboration, excellence, and accountability within the department.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis, with a strong preference for experience in the healthcare or pharmaceutical sectors.

  • Expert proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

  • Proven ability to lead through influence, collaborating with peers and executive leadership to drive business success.

  • Thrives in a high-growth, fast-paced environment, with the ability to manage complex projects and drive results under pressure.

  • Exceptional analytical and Excel skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable business insights.

  • Strategic thinker with a proven track record of influencing executive-level decision-making.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of simplifying financial concepts for non-financial stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS) in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

  • Extensive experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, with a deep understanding of industry-specific financial dynamics.

  • Expertise in advanced financial modeling and proficiency with financial software such as SAP, Oracle, or Sage Intacct.

  • Proficiency with SQL, Looker, Alteryx, or similar tools.

  • Familiarity with pharmacy economics within retail pharmacy, PBM, or pharmaceutical environments.



Additional Information

Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. jobs.excerpt: Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Circle is looking for a Regulatory and Licensing Program Manager to drive our licensing applications from filing strategy through to approval. Every new license, registration, or charter is a multi-month program on a regulatory clock, and it pulls in work from teams across the company. You will have early visibility into sensitive business and regulatory decisions. Handling that information with discretion is a core part of the role.


This is a program management role that requires real regulatory depth. You will run several applications at once and set the standard every future one follows. Regional policy and legal leaders own the strategy and the regulator relationship; you make the program move. In practice that means deciding what happens in what order, putting a name against every task, and getting the executive steering committee what it needs before it meets. We use AI heavily on this team and expect you to do the same. It is how a portfolio this wide stays manageable.


You will see every market Circle is considering before the decision is made, and you will be in the room with the people making it. How this function works is largely yours to define, and you will do it as an individual contributor leading by influence.


What you'll work on:

  • Supporting Circle's licensing applications end-to-end, from the case for entering a market through to approval, running several programs at once.
  • Building the program plan for each market – sequencing, dependencies, owners, dates – and holding it as the plan everyone works from.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams, including Legal, Commercial, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Product, Engineering, People & Workplace, and others to turn regulatory requirements into executable plans.
  • Facilitating working sessions and executive steering committee briefings that drive programs forward, from setting the agenda and framing decisions to closing the loop on outcomes.
  • Tracking and managing risks across all active programs, owning the escalation path and getting the right people involved early.
  • Defining and managing the reporting and metrics that give senior leadership and cross-functional partners an accurate, up-to-date picture of every market in the portfolio.
  • Establishing and evolving scalable service standards for how Circle runs regulatory and licensing programs.
  • Supporting, as directed, in external procurement activities across scoping, contracting, budget, and delivery.
  • Strengthening how the global policy organization works: bringing the same discipline to consultations, submissions, briefings and events, and to whatever else the team needs run well.
  • Serving as the go-to for program management across the global policy organization, setting the standard for how programs are run and helping team members strengthen their approach to planning, communication, and execution.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

Core Requirements:

  • 7+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 4 years supporting regulatory, licensing, legal or compliance work at a financial services, fintech or similarly regulated company.
  • Direct involvement in at least one licence, registration, or charter application, from early requirements to submission, or in a regulatory examination or remediation carried end to end.
  • Experience delivering complex, multi-month programs with many dependencies and a deadline you do not control.
  • The ability to hold senior colleagues to commitments you have no authority to enforce, and to raise a risk before it is comfortable to do so.
  • Daily, practical use of AI in your own work. You reach for it first on research, analysis, and internal reporting, and you know where a person still has to check the output.
  • A track record of building with AI, not only prompting it. You have shipped reporting workflows, automations, or internal tools that other people use, in environments like Claude, Vibebox or equivalent.
  • Strong written communication. You can turn a large set of inputs into a one-page status that an executive can act on.
  • The discipline to follow a requirement all the way to close, and sound judgment with confidential and privileged material.
  • Flexibility on working hours to support licensing and regulatory activity across time zones, from regular engagement with regulators in other regions to occasional deadline- or regulator-driven demands outside normal business hours.
  • Familiarity with generative AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and prompt development.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Familiarity with the regulatory questions specific to stablecoins and digital assets: reserve composition and attestation, redemption, safeguarding of customer funds, and the payments, e-money and virtual asset regimes that govern them.
  • Experience working with one or more high-bar financial services regulators in any major jurisdiction.
  • Fluency in an additional language.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Oxford Road Oxford Road is the world’s largest podcast advertising agency.
jobs.description:
About Oxford Road

Oxford Road is the world’s largest podcast advertising agency. We unite brands and creators through strategy and technology for outcomes only we can deliver.

Since the beginning of podcasting, we’ve been here building the playbook, setting the standards, and scaling brands through the power of audio and creator-driven media. Today, we manage campaigns across podcasts, radio, streaming audio, YouTube, and emerging creator platforms for clients that include half of the top advertisers in podcasting.

What really sets us apart? We’re not just buying media. We’re shaping the market itself.

Our thought leadership defines the conversation. Our newsletter reaches thousands of industry decision-makers every week. Our podcast, The Media Roundtable, convenes the most influential voices in audio advertising. Our annual Chief Audio Officer Summit is the premier gathering for marketers, platforms, and creators shaping the future of the medium. Our research (from attribution methodologies to brand safety frameworks) becomes industry standard.

We don’t wait for the market to tell us what’s next. We build it.

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT

Client Success is the foundation everything else is built on. Growth opportunities only exist because clients trust us, and that trust is earned through consistent, excellent service, campaign performance, and the kind of proactive communication that makes clients feel like they always have a dedicated partner in their corner. The best Client Success Leads don't feel like vendors to their client; they feel like a member of their internal team. Someone who knows their business, speaks their language, and is as invested in their success as they are.

This role is also not growth-agnostic. Because Client Success sits closest to the client, this team is uniquely positioned to identify expansion signals before anyone else sees them. The best CS Leads don’t just protect a book of business — they actively grow it by deepening relationships, surfacing opportunities, and partnering with the Growth team to bring those ideas to life. Retention and growth are two sides of the same coin, and this role owns both.

THE MINDSET

This role isn’t just about managing accounts. It’s about making clients feel like they couldn’t succeed without us. That means being the connective tissue between every internal team and the client, catching problems before they become crises, delivering insights that make our clients look smart to their own leadership, and proactively identifying opportunities to do more.

You don’t wait to be asked. You don’t pass the buck. You don’t explain why something didn’t happen. You make it happen. You bring data-backed points of view, not just status updates. And when you see a client ready to expand, you don’t wait for the Growth team to find it — you bring it forward. The success team is expected to bring strategic thinking to performance and satisfaction, not just process execution.

Client Success leads on performance and satisfaction while keeping a consultative duty on growth. You actively surface growth signals and partner with the Growth team.

You bring recommendations, not menus. When a client has a problem, you don't present three options and ask them to choose… you tell them what you think they should do and why. You present the expensive idea. You present the unconventional one. You give them something to say no to, not something to hide behind. And when something goes wrong internally, that never becomes the client's explanation.


RADICAL OWNERSHIP OF…

Owning these areas well is what separates good from great in this role.

  • Campaign Execution & Pacing — Own the day-to-day health of every campaign in your book. Be the first to know when something needs to change and have a plan before the client asks.
  • Performance Insights — Dig into the data to understand the why behind results. Identify patterns, anomalies, and opportunities, and bring those findings forward with a clear point of view and not just a data dump. Synthesize insights in partnership with the Growth team to build strategies that improve results at scale.
  • Client Relationships & Day-to-Day Communication — Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients. Own the relationship from onboarding through ongoing campaign management, ensuring clients feel informed, valued, and confident at every stage.
  • Campaign Launch Coordination — Orchestrate every new client onboarding touchpoint in collaboration with New Biz & Growth Leads - including internal kickoffs, Salesforce setup, Slack channel creation, dashboard requests, analytics notification, and finance account setup.
  • Weekly Performance Reporting — Pull, analyze, and deliver weekly reports that go beyond the numbers. Surface what’s working, what isn’t, and what we’re doing about it. QC all dashboards before client review. Clients should never have to ask “how are things going?”
  • Mistake Ownership — When something goes wrong, you get ahead of it. The client should never find a problem before you do. Own the error, bring the resolution, and make sure the fix delivers more value than the mistake cost. Trust is built in how you handle the hard moments, not just the easy ones.
  • Quarterly Business Reviews — Own the QBR process end to end: preparation, storytelling, delivery, and follow-through. QBRs should make clients feel like strategic partners, not just buyers. They should walk away with a clear picture of what we’ve accomplished, where we’re headed, and why they should stay and grow with Oxford Road.
  • Growth Signal Identification — Maintain a strategic lens on every account. Actively look for expansion opportunities (new channels, untapped audiences, incremental budget conversations) and bring those signals to the Growth team with context and a POV. The CS Lead is the first line of offense on account growth, even when the Growth team owns the proposal.
  • Client Communication — Respond to emails within 2 hours, send recaps after every call, and initiate proactive outreach before clients come looking for answers. Always be a step ahead.
  • Retention — Own the client relationship so deeply that churn feels unthinkable. Campaign success covers a multitude of problems — always keep your eyes on the prize.

May share responsibilities on accounts where no Client Service Coordinator is Assigned:

  • Cross-Functional Coordination — Quarterback media, creative, analytics, and activation teams on your accounts. Ensure everyone is aligned and that internal complexity never becomes the client’s problem.
  • Operational Integrity — Maintain Basecamp project management, Salesforce forecasts, competitive reporting, and all client-facing materials with accuracy and timeliness.
  • Optimization Execution — Coordinate campaign optimizations, makegoods, script variation requests, and promo code management in close collaboration with media, creative, and growth teams.
  • Creative & Compliance Coordination — Manage script variation requests, approve voiced radio airchecks, share top reads and bonus reporting, and coordinate all client approvals on creative deliverables.
  • Financial Administration — Request and approve post invoices, maintain monthly Salesforce forecasts, and coordinate CIA invoice reconciliation with the Accounting team.

MEASUREMENTS OF SUCCESS

  • Campaign Performance — You share accountability with the Growth team for making the media work. Eyes on the prize.
  • Client Satisfaction Scores — weekly informed, minimum quarterly and annual formal measurement
  • Client Retention — 95%+ retention across your book of business. Health and stability of assigned accounts.
  • Growth Contribution — Actively surfacing expansion opportunities and feeding qualified signals into the Growth team pipeline.
  • Timely & Accurate Delivery — Weekly reporting, QBRs, and client-facing materials delivered on time and without errors.
  • Internal Team Confidence — Cross-functional teams view you as the reliable operational lead for your accounts. Are you making it easier or harder for media, creative, and analytics to do their best work?
  • Quality of Thinking — Are you bringing points of view or status updates? Are your recommendations backed by data and delivered with conviction? The standard isn't just whether you flagged the opportunity — it's whether you showed up with a clear perspective on what to do about it.
  • Salesforce Hygiene — Accurate forecasts and up-to-date opportunity management across primary opportunities.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • This is not a passive account management role. Showing up to calls and sending recaps is table stakes, not the job.
  • This is not a pure execution role — you are expected to bring a point of view, flag risks, and push back when something isn’t right for the client.
  • This role does not own growth strategy or incremental expansion proposals — but you are the eyes and ears on the ground. You are expected to actively look for growth opportunities and bring them forward. When you see a client ready to expand, you don’t wait — you flag it immediately and partner with Growth to make it happen.
  • This is not a consultative, arm’s-length role. You are deeply embedded in your accounts and operationally accountable for their success.

PRIORITIES

New Client Launch:

  • Schedule and lead the internal kickoff call and pre-presentation regroup
  • Set up client in Salesforce: Primary Opportunities, Mention Templates, Competitor tracking
  • Create internal Slack channel and client folder in DR Specialists
  • Notify Analytics of initial spend and measurement data sources; support pixel attribution methodology definition
  • Request Tableau dashboard creation and client access
  • Set up account with Finance via email
  • Present media plan to client; lead the internal alignment meeting once plans are approved

Weekly Ongoing:

  • Lead internal weekly calls — prepare and distribute agendas in advance; empower team members to come prepared with their subject-matter analysis
  • Lead external client calls — distribute agendas and results prior to the meeting; send recaps with action items post-meeting
  • Own weekly performance review process — synthesize insights and recommendations in partnership with the Growth Strategist
  • Coordinate with media teams on optimizations, makegoods, and revisions; follow up to confirm completion
  • Submit RFPs and “Please Book” approvals on confirmed media plans via Google Forms & Basecamp
  • QC dashboards before client review — own the full QC process from identification through resolution
  • Manage script variation requests and coordinate client creative approvals

As Needed:

  • Request and communicate promo codes and URLs to clients; verify they are live
  • Share radio post logs, top reads, and bonus reporting with clients
  • Coordinate host order information and manage vendor/creator onboarding calls
  • Review and approve voiced radio airchecks; retrieve from networks as needed
  • Notify Analytics of any pixel measurement changes
  • Conduct host read calls as needed

Monthly / Quarterly:

  • Maintain monthly Salesforce forecasts by client
  • Request CIA invoices (if required) and approve post invoices
  • Create and present Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)
  • Update and maintain competitive reporting

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Exceptional Communication Skills — You can present results clearly to a CMO and translate complexity into confidence for a client.
  • Operational Discipline — Strong attention to detail and time management across multiple clients and projects simultaneously.
  • Relationship-First Mindset — You invest in the people behind the accounts, not just the metrics.
  • Only Oxford Mentality — A genuine drive to find the first, best, and most differentiated solution every time. You don't default to what's been done before. You push for creative integrations, present the option no one else would, and hold yourself to a standard of excellence that makes clients feel like they couldn't get this anywhere else.
  • Proficiency in Relevant Tools — Salesforce, Basecamp, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office; comfort with performance dashboards (Qlik, Tableau, or similar) is a plus.

WEEKLY OUTLOOK

  • Lead and attend all client calls for your assigned accounts — ~5 hours/week
  • Internal team syncs and cross-functional coordination — ~4-6 hours/week
  • Campaign monitoring, reporting prep, and performance analysis
  • Recap and follow-up communication after every client interaction
  • Strategic account reviews — scanning your book for growth signals, relationship risks, and expansion opportunities
  • Collaboration with the Growth team to share account intelligence, flag expansion signals, and align on client strategy

Do whatever it takes to make our clients successful.

The pay range for this role is: 70 - 90k USD per year (Remote)

jobs.description:
Join the Mitsubishi Motors North America (MMNA) Team!

At Mitsubishi Motors NA, we are driving innovation, quality, and excellence in the automotive industry. Our commitment to delivering cutting-edge vehicles goes hand in hand with our dedication to fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment.
Our team members are the driving force behind our success, and we believe in empowering individuals to contribute their unique skills and perspectives. We are a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values diversity, creativity, and continuous improvement.
At MMNA, your career is not just a job but a journey of growth. Benefit from ongoing employee development programs, contribute to our impactful Community Relations initiatives, and enjoy a range of employee benefits that make your experience with us exceptional.
Be part of a company proud of its heritage and excited about the future where together, we shape the future of mobility and drive success in every mile.

About the Job
As part of Mitsubishi’s Momentum 2030 plan, we are focused on expanding our retail dealer network to meet future market growth and customer demand. The business need is clear: build stronger dealer representation in high-potential, strategic markets across the United States—especially in the rapidly growing Northern region. This role plays a critical part in shaping the future of our retail footprint in the North Region. This role will focus specifically on the central and western portion of the North Region, playing a critical part in shaping the future of our retail footprint.

Role Summary
As the Regional Dealer Development Manager, you will coordinate and oversee regional dealer placement activities, support prospects and site selection, and ensure new and existing dealers meet corporate requirements for management, capital, facilities, signage, and operational standards in the NorthRegion. You will develop and implement strategies to strengthen the dealer body through performance improvement programs while ensuring policy compliance and maximizing dealer network effectiveness.

As a Regional Dealer Development Manager, You Will:

  • Coordinate Regional Dealer Placement activities including the development of dealer agreement packages for new points, buy/sells, renewals, relocations, and terminations.
  • Oversee and coordinate activities related to regional dealer business management, working capital, profitability, and financial performance.
  • Manage and address compliance issues including facility, signage, flooring, and trademark requirements.
  • Develop and present new dealer and buy/sell proposals to the Franchise Committee.

  • Meet stated deadlines while consistently delivering high-quality results.

Measuring Your Momentum:

  • Familiarize yourself with Mitsubishi’s 2030 network strategy and footprint goals.
  • Build strong working relationships with Regional Management and District teams.
  • Identify priority open point markets and assess current dealer performance and compliance.
  • Initiate assessments for potential new dealer candidates and begin prospecting.
  • Continuously improve Mitsubishi/MEL/MDL knowledge and presentation skills.

Year 1 Victory Lap:

  • Successfully launch new dealers in priority strategic markets aligned with the Open Point Plan.
  • Improve performance and profitability of underperforming and newly appointed dealers.
  • Drive timely dealer agreement renewals and buy/sell transitions.
  • Demonstrate measurable impact on dealer network representation, activation, and overall health.

Ready to Join The Team? You Should Have:

  • 5+ years of wholesale/retail automotive experience, including experience as a District Sales Manager.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of dealer financial statements, dealership operations, and capital planning.
  • Strong ability to influence and motivate others, with exceptional verbal/written communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple high-impact initiatives.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Extensive travel required.
  • Must maintain a valid unconditional driver's license and MMNA-approved driving record.

Extra Horsepower (Profile Differentiators):

  • Proven success in Dealer Development with a major OEM.
  • Prior experience in dealer placement, franchise compliance, and buy/sell negotiations.
  • Strong understanding of market representation strategies and retail network expansion in growth markets.
  • Experience improving dealership profitability and launching new stores.

Why Join Us

  • Direct impact on network growth – Play a leading role in expanding and strengthening Mitsubishi's dealer network as part of the company's Momentum 2030 strategy.
  • Variety and visibility – Work on everything from facility improvements and franchise transactions to launching entirely new dealerships.
  • Partner with business leaders –Build strong relationships with dealer principals, ownership groups, and executive leadership while helping shape the future retail footprint of the brand.

Pay Transparency:

The base salary for this position ranges between $120,000 to $130,000. The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, we are proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for all eligible employees which also includes 401k with company match, Mitsubishi Lease Program, and a full range of medical, financial, and other perks and benefits.

Perks and Benefits:

  • Family First: Enjoy comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans.
  • Be a Proud Mitsubishi Ambassador: Take advantage of our Discounted Employee Lease Car program, covering insurance, maintenance, and registration fees, with no down payment or credit check required.
  • Drive with Perks: This position comes with an assigned vehicle, contingent upon a satisfactory driving record.
  • Secure Your Future: Benefit from our 401(k) with Company match and annual contributions based on years of service.
  • Fuel Your Growth: Access professional development opportunities, including training, tuition reimbursement, and employee resource groups.
  • Take Time for Yourself: Enjoy up to 30 days of paid time off, including holidays, vacation, and other leave options.
  • Thrive in an Open Environment: Experience our collaborative workspace where ideas flow freely.

The MMC Way:

Our values form the foundation of everything we do. At Mitsubishi Motors, we are committed to a set of core principles that guide our actions, decisions, and interactions. Diversity and How to Apply:

At MMNA, we embrace the strength that diverse perspectives and experiences bring to our team. Our application process is designed to champion inclusion and equity. We understand that perfection is a journey, and if you ever have questions about your application or the process itself, don't hesitate to reach out to your recruiter.

Mitsubishi Motors is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, excited about collaborating with talented individuals of all identities. jobs.description:
About Vasion

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About the role

This role is remote, or hybrid for candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices in St. George or Lehi, UT.

Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, the Web Operations Manager is the operational engine of Vasion's web team — the person who turns business requests into shipped pages and the person who keeps the team's delivery rhythm on track.

This role owns Vasion's CMS day to day: building and editing pages and landing pages using existing components and templates, and knowing when a request can be handled directly versus when it needs to be scoped and handed to a developer or designer. This role also runs the team's operating cadence — standups, sprint planning, prioritization, and retros — and is the first stop for any stakeholder across Marketing who needs something from the web team. A big part of the job is translating a business ask ("we need a new campaign page," "this section needs to change") into a clear, actionable requirement someone can actually execute against, then following it through to done. Daily partners include web developers, UX/UI designers, the Head of Search & AI Visibility, content, customer marketing, growth marketing, and regional marketing managers.

What you'll do
CMS Management & Page Execution
  • Build, edit, and publish webpages and landing pages directly in the CMS, using existing components and templates, based on business requests from across Marketing and the broader business
  • Own the intake process for web requests: gather requirements, ask clarifying questions, and turn an ambiguous business ask into a clear, actionable spec
  • Determine the right path for each request — execute it directly when it's within scope, or scope it and hand it to the right teammate (developer, UX/UI designer, etc.) when it requires new components or dev work
  • Maintain governance over templates, components, and design-system usage across the site so pages stay consistent as more people request changes
  • Handle redirect management, URL governance, and the ongoing consolidation of Vasion's multi-brand web footprint
  • Monitor Core Web Vitals, site speed, uptime, and overall page performance, and flag/triage issues as they come up
  • Ensure pages meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2 Level AA, WCAG 2.1 AA minimum), conducting basic accessibility checks and coordinating remediation with developers when issues are found

Team Operations & Delivery

  • Run web team standups, sprint planning, prioritization meetings, and retros
  • Build and maintain the roadmap for Vasion's web and digital properties, and own sprint health (committed-work completion, blocker resolution, cycle time)
  • Serve as the first point of contact for any stakeholder engaging the web team — triage inbound requests and turn them into scoped roadmap items
  • Coordinate QA, cross-browser testing, regression testing, and releases with the development team
  • Support localization and multi-region site execution in partnership with content and regional marketing teams

Search & Conversion Execution

  • Implement technical SEO and AEO/GEO content structuring on pages, based on strategy and priorities set by leadership
  • Build, QA, and ship CRO tests defined in partnership with leadership
  • Surface technical feasibility and constraints back to leadership to help shape realistic, well-informed strategy

Cross-Functional Partnership & Reporting

  • Partner with the Director, Digital Marketing and the Head of Search & AI Visibility to translate strategy into an executable web roadmap
  • Deliver regular performance reporting and insights to marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Stay current on web, CMS, and delivery best practices, and bring new tools or approaches to the team
Qualifications

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in web operations, digital production, web project management, or a closely related discipline
  • Demonstrated experience building and editing pages inside a modern CMS (headless CMS strongly preferred), working within existing components and templates
  • Strong requirements-gathering skills — proven ability to take an ambiguous business request and turn it into a clear, actionable spec someone else could execute
  • Experience running Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros, prioritization) and owning a team's roadmap and delivery health
  • Good judgment on triage — knowing what to build yourself versus what to scope and hand to a developer or designer
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, enough to scope dev requests accurately and have informed conversations with engineers
  • Familiarity with technical SEO fundamentals and CRO/testing concepts at an execution level (you don't need to set the strategy, but you need to be able to implement it)
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • B2B SaaS or technology industry experience
  • Formal Agile/Scrum training or certification
  • Experience with project/work management tools such as Workfront, Asana, Monday, or Jira
  • Experience with a Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform for managing images, video, and brand assets across web properties
  • Familiarity with GitHub and modern web deployment workflows (pull requests, branching, staging/production deploys)
  • Experience with web analytics and experimentation tools at an execution level (GA4, VWO, Optimizely, or comparable)
  • Experience with SEO platforms like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or Moz
  • Experience with heatmap and session replay tools like Hotjar or FullStory
  • Light JavaScript ability
  • Experience supporting localized and multi-region website properties
  • Fluency using AI and LLM tooling to speed up requirements-writing, QA, or content drafts
  • A passion for problem-solving, comfort with ambiguity, and creativity
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and requests in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Highly collaborative team player who seeks to understand and listen first, before recommending improvements
Benefits
  • Flexible work environment
  • Vacation Bonus
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Competitive pay
  • A full suite of traditional benefits
  • Training/Advancement opportunities
  • 401k with company match and immediate vesting
  • Financial wellness education
  • Company-contributed HSA
  • On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.
Our Core Values

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

  • Disruptive Visionaries: Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
  • Relationship Builders: We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
  • Candor Seekers: Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
  • Action Owners: Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.
More about Vasion

Visit to learn more about Vasion.

Additional Information

Vasion is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation and other legally protected characteristics.

Our interview process may vary slightly depending on the role. We’ll always let you know what to expect at each stage and give you plenty of opportunities to ask questions along the way.

People Team Introduction and Cultural Drivers Interview

An initial conversation with a member of our People Team to learn more about you, your experience and what you’re looking for in your next role.   • Monitor, analyze, and report on key metrics (open rates, click-through rates, conversions) and identify trends to optimize performance.
  • Design and execute A/B tests on subject lines, copy, send times, and creative to improve engagement.
  • Lead adoption of AI tools across the campaign workflow — drafting copy, segmentation, QA, and reporting — and pilot new tools that help the team scale during high-volume periods while preserving Sur La Table's voice.
  • Partner with the Analytics/CRM team to deepen audience segmentation expertise and integrate customer insights into campaign strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR, and other applicable email marketing regulations.
  • Stay current on email and SMS marketing trends, tools, and best practices, and drive process improvements across teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  • 1–3 years of hands-on email marketing experience.
  • Proven experience using generative AI tools or AI features within email/SMS platforms to improve productivity and results.

  • Familiarity with email marketing regulations (CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR).
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment, paired with sound judgment about where human review and brand voice matter most.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Emarsys, Wunderkind, Google Analytics, Heap, Adobe Suite, or Canva.
  • HTML and CSS email coding experience.
  • Retail or e-commerce industry experience.
  • Passion for the culinary industry and an affinity for the Sur La Table brand.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your campaigns reach customers across every channel — you will work closely with brand, merchandising, CRM, and ecommerce teams and see the results of your work in real time.
  • Skill Building: Develop deep expertise in AI-driven marketing workflows, advanced segmentation, and modern email/SMS platforms while growing your career in digital marketing.

Interview Process

Delos Insurance Solutions is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Associate Underwriter to support our property underwriting operations. ·Underwriting & Risk Assessment

·Review, evaluate, and underwrite new business and renewal submissions for homeowners and other residential property lines.

·Manage daily underwriting activities, including inspection reviews, endorsements, and system-generated tasks.

·Evaluate property risk characteristics in accordance with established underwriting guidelines and company risk appetite.

·Identify and select profitable risks while minimizing adverse selection.

·Meet or exceed established production and quality standards.

·Adhere to underwriting guidelines, processes, and effective date requirements.

·Escalate guideline exceptions to an Underwriter or Senior Underwriter for approval.

·Agent Communication & Collaboration

·Serve as an underwriting resource for appointed agents, answering questions, clarifying guidelines, and supporting quality submissions.

·Collaborate with internal teams to improve underwriting efficiency, processes, and overall service quality.

·Understanding of underwriting principles, risk assessment, and risk selection, or transferable experience in claims, insurance customer service, or related functions.

·Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-service mindset.

·Experience using underwriting platforms, exposure assessment tools, or business intelligence dashboards.

·Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively.

·Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and sound decision-making skills.

·Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and Adobe.

Preferred Qualifications

·Active Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance license in any state; California license strongly preferred.

·Professional insurance designations such as CPCU, ARM, or equivalent.

·Familiarity with California property underwriting practices and guidelines.

·Experience evaluating catastrophe (CAT)-exposed risks, including wildfire, hurricane, and other natural hazards.

·Experience within Managing General Agency (MGA), Excess & Surplus (E&S), or non-admitted insurance environments.

·Exposure to commercial property underwriting.

·Interest in leveraging technology, automation, and data to improve underwriting processes.

·Understanding of how climate trends and emerging risks impact the insurance industry.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States
  • Unlimited PTO, including sick leave and company holidays
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance (25% paid by employee, 75% covered by Delos including dependents)

Job Title: Contract and Vendor Advisory Specialist (Contract Writer)
Work Arrangement: Fully remote within the United States; core hours Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM Eastern Time
Location: Remote, United States (Eastern Time schedule)
Employment Type: W-2, full time, 40 hours per week
Engagement Type: Contract, approximately six months, anticipated November 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027; the engagement concludes when the client's vendor contract is fully executed
Final Interview: Client interview by video conference

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring a Contract and Vendor Advisory Specialist on behalf of the client, a state government human services agency. The client is preparing to contract with a system vendor for a multi-year modernization of its child welfare information system. The Specialist is the contract writer and negotiation lead on the client's team: working alongside the client's project manager, business analyst, program subject matter experts, procurement specialists, and legal counsel, the Specialist drafts the vendor contract and service level agreement, leads negotiation sessions with the selected vendor, turns negotiated positions into contract language, and builds the SLA, KPI, performance monitoring, and corrective action structure that will govern the vendor after signing. Contract drafting begins November 1, 2026. The contract is expected to go through the client's independent review and federal partner review in April 2027, with execution targeted for April 30, 2027. This is a full-time, fully remote engagement performed on Eastern Time, and it ends when the contract is signed. This is not a project management role and not a legal counsel role; the client provides both.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft and refine the vendor contract and service level agreement using the client's contract templates, exhibits, and attachments, incorporating direction from the client's legal counsel and procurement specialists.
  • Lead negotiation sessions with the selected system vendor together with client staff, expected at least weekly and up to daily during active negotiation, and convert each negotiated position into clear, enforceable contract language.
  • Maintain the contract through its full review cycle: draft completion, client internal reviews, state independent review, federal partner review, final modifications, and routing for signatures.
  • Deliver a contract plan and schedule covering scope, roles, milestones, risks, communication plan, and required approvals through contract execution.
  • Define service level agreements, key performance indicators, and a performance monitoring framework tailored to the modernization project, and write them into the contract.
  • Develop the vendor performance reporting structure and risk mitigation recommendations that the client will deploy after contract signing.
  • Customize corrective and preventive action plan (CAPAP) templates and provide advisory notes on compliance and risk mitigation.
  • Identify, log, and help mitigate risks in contract terms, including compliance with state and federal funding requirements.
  • Facilitate collaboration among program leadership, procurement, the project team, and legal advisors so that contract terms are clear, enforceable, and aligned with program priorities.
  • Develop guidance for client teams on contract and vendor management practices, including vendor onboarding and offboarding.
  • Provide weekly progress updates on progress, concerns, and roadblocks; prepare monthly status reports; and deliver a final executive review with recommendations on contract reviews, amendments, and renewals.
  • Produce all deliverables in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Project, Visio) or Adobe PDF, working in Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Azure DevOps, and DocuSign on client-provided systems or virtual desktop.

Requirements

Required:

  • Seven or more years of experience drafting and negotiating information technology or professional services contracts for state or local government, including statements of work, service level agreements, key performance indicators, and performance terms.
  • Demonstrated experience as the primary author of at least one large system implementation contract (software, SaaS, or systems integration) carried from first draft through negotiation to execution.
  • Experience leading or co-leading negotiation sessions with vendors and converting negotiated outcomes into contract language.
  • Experience with contracts subject to federal funding requirements and oversight (for example HHS, ACF, or CMS funded programs), including state independent review or comparable approval processes.
  • Three professional references, submitted with the application, from engagements within the last five years who can speak specifically to the candidate's contract writing. Applications without three references will not be considered.
  • Strong written communication, with experience producing executive summaries, contract plans, and status reports for senior government audiences.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Project, Visio), SharePoint, Teams, Azure DevOps, and DocuSign.
  • Available full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM Eastern Time, from November 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027.
  • Located in the United States and authorized to work in the United States; work cannot be performed from outside the United States.
  • Must sign a client non-disclosure agreement, pass a background check, perform all work on client-provided systems or virtual desktop, and refrain from using AI meeting assistants in client meetings.

Preferred:

  • Experience with CCWIS, SACWIS, child welfare, Title IV-E, Medicaid, integrated eligibility, or other federally funded human services systems.
  • PMP or another PMBOK-based credential, an IIBA certification (CBAP or CCBA), or a contract management credential such as CPCM, CFCM, or NIGP-CPP.
  • Prior work with a state central IT agency, state procurement office, or vendor relationship management unit.
  • Juris Doctor or paralegal background.

How to Apply

Please send your resume and three professional references to with "Contract and Vendor Advisory Specialist" in the subject line. For each reference, include the name, title, organization, email address, phone number, and the contract work the reference can speak to. References must be from engagements within the last five years and must be able to speak specifically to your contract writing. Applications submitted without three references will not be considered.

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

jobs.description:
Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)
Department: Performance
Job Location: Remote (Mexico)
Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)
Total Compensation: $925,000 - $1,200,000 MXN + Benefits
New Hire Starting Pay: $925,000 - $1,101,000 MXN + Benefits
Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes.

Working Within Our Values:

At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers.
    • Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.
  • Client: Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes.
    • Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.
  • People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise.
    • Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.
  • Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation.
    • Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
  • In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
  • In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development.

Qualifications

  • You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).
  • You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.
  • You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.
  • You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.
  • You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.
  • You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.

---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

We are looking for an HR Business Partner to create a seamless and supportive experience for every employee at Reserv in the UK. In this role, you will manage key processes throughout the employee lifecycle — from onboarding to day-to-day HR support — while serving as a trusted partner to both team members and leadership. You will bring empathy, organization, and sharp problem-solving skills to a fast- paced, fully remote environment where we value initiative, clear communication, and continuous improvement. If you are excited about building thoughtful people processes, supporting a growing team, and shaping the future of HR at an ambitious insurtech, we would love to connect with you.

What you'll do

Strategic partner

  • Act as a trusted advisor and sounding partner to managers and team leads, providing guidance on team dynamics, performance management, and workforce planning.
  • Develop and execute people strategies that drive business performance, retention, and engagement — translating organizational goals into tangible people initiatives.
  • Lead on end-to-end recruitment activity for the UK, partnering with hiring managers to attract and retain top talent while maintaining a consistent, positive candidate experience.
  • Drive culture change and organizational development initiatives, holding leaders and managers accountable for adoption and embedding change effectively across teams.
  • Develop, own, and continuously improve HR policies from inception through to implementation, ensuring they are fit for purpose, legally compliant, and aligned with the company’s values and growth trajectory.

Employee relations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all UK employee relations matters, managing a high volume of cases end-to-end — including performance management, disciplinaries, grievances, and occupational health referrals — with minimal escalation.
  • Bring proven experience managing complex, long-running cases including long-term sickness absence, reasonable adjustments, and occupational health-led processes, ideally gained in operational or high-volume frontline environments.
  • Negotiate and manage Settlement Agreements (formerly Compromise Agreements), including liaison with legal counsel where required, ensuring commercial and legal risk is appropriately managed.
  • Balance empathy with compliance in line with UK employment law (Employment Rights Act 1996, Equality Act 2010, and related legislation), escalating matters to the VP, People Operations only where necessary.
  • Help leaders proactively identify and address team health concerns and interpersonal conflict before they reach formal process stage.
  • Support investigations, policy interpretation, disciplinary, and grievance procedures in accordance with ACAS Codes of Practice and internal policy.
  • Help foster an inclusive, equitable, and engaging remote-first culture using data and employee feedback to make evidence-based recommendations.

Performance & talent management

  • Manage the performance review cycle, lead calibration sessions, and coach managers on delivering constructive feedback and meaningful development conversations.
  • Collaborate with the VP, People Operations to roll out talent development programs, promotion frameworks, and career pathways that scale with the company.

HR programming

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve HR programs, policies, and workflows spanning the full employee lifecycle, with a focus on scalability and automation.
  • Lead the development and delivery of the company’s EDI (Equality, Diversity & Inclusion) strategy, building programs and initiatives that foster a culture of belonging, psychological safety, and equitable opportunity across the UKworkforce.
  • Drive employee engagement through structured listening programs (e.g. surveys, focus groups), translating findings into actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Leverage data and employee feedback to recommend improvements to People Ops processes that increase efficiency and impact.
  • Support employee recognition, onboarding, and retention initiatives.

Operations & compliance

  • Maintain an up-to-date working knowledge of UK employment law, proactively monitoring legislative changes and implementing updated policies and practices ahead of new laws coming into effect.
  • Oversee right-to-work checks and ensure ongoing compliance with UK immigration and employment eligibility requirements.
  • Uphold UK GDPR and data privacy obligations, ensuring employee data is handled with appropriate confidentiality and in accordance with ICO guidance.
  • Serve as a secondary point of contact for employee questions requiring a nuanced or strategic response.

Analytics & reporting

  • Analyze HR data and trends (turnover, engagement, headcount, etc.) and deliver insights to leadership to shape people strategies.
  • Develop reporting mechanisms that support business leaders in making data-informed decisions.

Qualifications

  • CIPD Level 7 qualified (or equivalent experience), operating at a strategic HR level with the confidence to work autonomously and advise senior stakeholders.
  • 4–6+ years of experience in HR advisory / People Operations, with at least 2 years in a Business Partner or advisory capacity.
  • 2+ years of end-to-end payroll management experience for a workforce of up to 200 employees, including pension administration (auto-enrollment and ongoing scheme management).
  • 2+ years of experience in a high-growth startup, scale-up, or fast-paced operational environment — you know how to balance ambiguity, pace, and flexibility.
  • Solid, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law, including the Employment
  • Rights Act, Equality Act 2010, ACAS Codes of Practice, and UK GDPR.
  • Demonstrable experience managing a high volume and wide range of ER cases end-to-end, including Settlement Agreements, long-term sickness, and occupational health processes.
  • Experience with UK benefits administration is desirable but not essential, including auto-enrollment pensions, private health insurance, and statutory entitlements (SSP, SMP, SPP, etc.).
  • Proficient with HR systems; experience with Rippling is a bonus.
  • High emotional and social intelligence, with the confidence and composure to navigate highly sensitive or contentious situations with care and professionalism.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, good intuition, and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.
  • Able to manage multiple ongoing projects independently with excellent attention to detail and organization.
  • A decisive problem solver with a “get it done” attitude who thrives in a fast- paced, sometimes ambiguous environment.
  • Exceptional standards of confidentiality and ethics when handling sensitive people information.
  • A genuine growth mindset — keen to continue learning and developing as the company scales.
  • Comfortable working fully remotely and with a geographically distributed team.
  • Proficient with standard tech tools — Apple Mac, Google Workspace, and
  • Slack — and comfortable picking up new technology quickly.

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!
