We are proud of our culture of engagement and accountability that rewards people for innovative thinking and achievement of key objectives. For more information, please visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.


JOB SUMMARY:

The Director of Drug Product Development will lead and direct formulation and process development for patient-centered parenteral drug products supporting BioCryst’s biologics portfolio. This role is responsible for development of portfolio projects in a phase‑appropriate manner while working with external Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs). The role involves responsibility for all aspects of biologics drug product development from supporting early discovery efforts to late-stage technology transfer, scale-up, process validation and commercialization.

The incumbent will work cross‑functionally with other groups outside the Pharmaceutical Sciences organization, including Clinical Operations, Quality, & Device Development, to support clinical and late‑stage development programs. This position requires strong and comprehensive scientific and technical expertise in biologics product development and the ability to operate effectively in a fast‑paced, collaborative biotech environment.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide scientific, technical and operational leadership for formulation, process development and manufacturing of patient-centered, injectable drug products for BioCryst’s portfolio from pre-clinical to successful licensure, primarily through external partners.
  • Develop drug product development strategies through internal/external partnerships and product integration into drug/device combination products.
  • Enable the progression of BioCryst’s biologics portfolio that currently includes protein-based modalities as liquid and lyophilized dosage forms in vial, prefilled syringe, and cartridge-based presentations.
  • Drive the product development efforts in a phase-appropriate manner defining formulation, manufacturing process, container/closure for clinical trials and towards commercialization.
  • Lead interactions with external partners to drive the above activities. Maintain close collaboration with internal program leaders and stake-holders.
  • Support organization and program leaders in developing budgets, timelines, tracking progress as well as risk identification, communication and mitigation.
  • Provide subject matter expertise for technical due diligence and for the technical as well as strategic content of the relevant drug product sections of regulatory submissions.
  • Author and review high‑quality development reports, technical summaries and other documentation to support product development.
  • Mentor and develop colleagues to internal and matrix teams, contributing to a high-performing pharmaceutical sciences organization.
  • Stay current with evolving CMC and global regulatory strategies for biologics and small‑molecule programs through literature and external networking, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and regulatory expectations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • MS / PhD in Bio/Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or related discipline with at least 10 years of relevant field experience in end-to-end biologics drug product development (encompassing formulation, process development, scale up, technology transfer and manufacturing support). A significant part of this experience must include directing and managing development with external partners.
  • Must be proficient in current approaches for formulation and drug product process development, manufacturing processes and equipment, regulatory expectations and applying these to developing efficient approaches to ensure product licensure.
  • Experience with high concentration protein formulation development, aseptic processes, vial, prefilled syringe, cartridge presentations, liquid and lyophilization dosage forms is a must.
  • Knowledge of current regulatory guidelines and cGMP requirements is necessary.
  • Must have a strong grounding in biochemistry / biophysics to ensure a science-driven approach to biologics product development.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory submissions and interacting with Analytical, Quality and Regulatory functions.
  • Proven ability to manage external partners and deliver results in a fast‑paced biotech environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience authoring technical reports and regulatory documentation.

jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role

Mozilla is seeking experienced browser engineers to join a small team exploring new applications of browser technology. The work combines deep systems engineering, rapid experimentation, and close collaboration across technical disciplines.

We are looking for a browser engine specialist who enjoys turning difficult systems questions into working experiments. You will investigate browser behavior, implement changes deep in the engine, and establish which ideas produce meaningful improvements. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of engine-level investigations and implementation, working closely with the team’s technical lead.

The work suits someone who has built or substantially changed browser internals, understands the tradeoffs embedded in those systems, and enjoys applying that knowledge to unfamiliar problems. Your experiments will help inform technical direction.

What you'll do:

  • Design and implement experiments within browser engine subsystems. Investigate how internal data structures and execution behavior affect performance, correctness, and the interfaces exposed to developer tools.
  • Evaluate ways to represent and expose browser state efficiently and accurately. Identify the tradeoffs in each approach, including information loss, implementation complexity, and compatibility with dynamic web content.
  • Prototype engine capabilities that support reliable programmatic interaction with web content. Investigate how document structure, layout, navigation, and event handling affect correctness and performance.
  • Instrument browser behavior and evaluate changes against repeatable tasks. Measure performance and correctness, isolate the effect of each change, and document unsuccessful experiments as clearly as successful ones. Check that gains hold beyond the workloads used to develop the prototype.
  • Profile the overhead introduced by new capabilities and pursue improvements where measurements justify them. Use AI tools to accelerate coding and analysis, and verify their output through debugging, tests, and measurement.

What you'll bring:

  • Deep hands-on expertise in at least one browser engine subsystem, such as DOM and Web APIs, layout and rendering, accessibility, JavaScript runtimes, or networking and process architecture. You have implemented substantial changes and can trace their effects into neighboring subsystems.
  • Strong proficiency in C++ or Rust, experience navigating a large systems codebase, and practical knowledge of memory ownership, concurrency, object lifetimes, and performance debugging. You can build the JavaScript and scripting tools needed to exercise and measure your work.
  • A demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar code, form a precise hypothesis, construct a useful prototype, and interpret the results. You can separate the effects of your implementation from variability in websites, workloads, or model behavior.
  • A strong understanding of web platform behavior and compatibility. You can reason about how document structure, script execution, rendering, and user interaction relate, including cases where the browser’s internal state is difficult to expose accurately to another system.
  • Experience with profiling, tracing, regression tests, or conformance tests, and a habit of grounding performance claims in reproducible evidence. You can explain both the benefit of an optimization and the circumstances in which it fails.
  • Curiosity about AI agents and a willingness to work directly with agent harnesses and coding tools. You can connect a low-level implementation choice to the information an agent receives and the work it must do next.

Nice to have:

  • Contributions to Gecko, Servo, Blink, WebKit, or another browser engine
  • Experience maintaining an open-source project
  • Technical leadership in a small team building a new product
  • Experience with accessibility infrastructure, browser security, profiling, or automated evaluation of agent workflows

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.
jobs.description:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

About the Role

Most companies make you choose: build the platform, or go deploy it. Here you do both — and that's the point.

As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you're part of a single team that both delivers Afresh's AI into enterprise grocery customers and builds the platform that makes that delivery fast. You'll spend dedicated time in the field — embedded with a customer, integrating into their data, shipping AI systems on top of it — and dedicated time on the platform, turning what you just learned into reusable tooling the whole team deploys next. You build the house you live in.

Afresh leads the customer relationship and direction; you and a small team bring the technical firepower — scope and architect the work with the customer, then build it. Because you also own the platform underneath, the rough edges you hit in the field become the things you fix at the root.

This is senior, hands-on, 0-to-1 work in a space with no playbook.

What You'll Do

In the field (forward deployed)

  • Partner with Afresh's account lead and the customer's technical teams to scope and architect the work — the data sources, the architecture, and the path to production.
  • Embed with the customer's data and engineering teams (remote and on-site); integrate into their cloud and data platform; build production-grade pipelines and model messy enterprise data into trustworthy data products.
  • Design and ship LLM- and agent-powered systems on that data — retrieval, agentic workflows, data-quality and analytics agents — reliable enough to run in production, not just to demo.

On the platform (building the house you live in)

  • Harden what works in the field into the shared platform: the knowledge and grounding layer (knowledge graph, ontology, and retrieval) that makes grocery data usable by LLMs, the agent frameworks, and the serving infrastructure.
  • Build the evals, tracing, and tooling that let the team measure quality — accuracy, hallucination rate, latency, cost — and ship faster on the next customer.
  • Build for leverage: clean interfaces and reusable building blocks, not one-off per-customer code.

Across both

  • Own the flywheel: field learnings flow straight into the platform, and platform improvements show up at the next customer.

What Makes You a Great Fit

We encourage all highly-qualified candidates to apply, even if they do not fulfill all the listed criteria.

  • 5+ years building production software and data systems, with strong, production-grade code
  • An architect's instinct: you can take an ambiguous problem and a messy data landscape, design a clean and workable solution, and then build it.
  • Genuine AI/LLM depth — you've built real systems with LLMs and agents (retrieval/RAG, tool-use) and you evaluate quality rather than eyeball it.
  • Real data-engineering depth: building and operating data pipelines, modeling messy enterprise data, and working in a modern cloud data platform (Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).
  • Range across both modes — you genuinely like being in front of customers and going heads-down to build reusable infrastructure, and you can switch between them without one suffering. This is the role's defining trait.
  • Customer-facing comfort: you work well with a customer's engineers and data teams — running working sessions, explaining your thinking, and earning trust through what you deliver.
  • A bias toward ownership and momentum, and comfort traveling to customer sites regularly (~10-20%).

Nice to Have

  • Experience in grocery, retail, or supply chain data domains.
  • Knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic layers in production; graph and vector stores (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) and hybrid search.
  • MCP or similar tool/context protocols; agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph); MLOps, model serving, and observability for LLM systems.
  • Prior forward-deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering — or early-stage startup experience navigating rapid customer expansion.

Why Afresh?

  • We're a mission-driven company that eliminates hundreds of millions of pounds of food waste in grocery stores every year — your work has direct, visible impact.
  • You'll do both halves of the job: deploy with customers and build the platform you deploy — never a body-shop consultant, never an ivory-tower platform engineer.
  • Be part of an engineering culture that's genuinely AI-forward — we want to be on the bleeding edge of agentic development, not watching from the sidelines.
  • Senior team, high trust, and real ownership at a pivotal inflection point for how Afresh scales.
  • Collaborative, supportive environment & awesome people

This position is not eligible for company sponsorship.

Salary Band in U.S. (USD): $168,912-$253,368 + meaningful early-stage equity + benefits

Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh
At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.
  • Invested in Your Future: Competitive base salary, meaningful equity (U.S. employees), and a 401(k) program with a generous company match.
  • Flexible & Modern Workspace: Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and "Coworking Wallets" for flexible workspace access.
  • Growth-Obsessed Culture: We believe in continuous learning. Every employee receives an annual professional development budget to master new skills and grow their career at Afresh.
  • Holistic Monthly Stipends: Beyond your paycheck, we provide monthly stipends for "Betterment" (wellness/lifestyle) and telecommunications to ensure you have what you need to thrive.
  • Time to Recharge: Flexible paid time off to take the time you need to recharge.
*Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits

About Afresh

Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales.

Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. Our best-in-class AI research has been published in top journals, including ICML, and our investors include Al Gore’s Just Climate, former Whole Foods Market CEO Walter Robb, and Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors.

Grocery is the past, present, and future of our food system – the waste we create today will impact our planet for years to come. Join us as we continue to build a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive team that embodies our company’s values of proactivity, kindness, candor, and humility.

Afresh provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

Here at Afresh, many of our employees work remotely provided that they reside in one of the following states: AL, AR, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MA, MI, MT, MO, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OR, PA, TX, WA, UT, VA, WI.

Job Title: Senior Consultant - Vault PromoMats

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Consultant in our European Professional Services team, you will partner with top global pharma organisations to solve critical business challenges. jobs.description:
Location: within European time zones.

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) acquires, launches and develops leading pet and equestrian marketplaces around the world. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we're on a mission to transform it by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through technology. We're a driven, ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by investors such as Verdane. We've been profitable since our first year, so we don't rely on investor capital to grow.

The opportunity

CLM is changing, and we want to rethink what it looks like when AI, automation and customer data sit at the heart of how we work. Our CRM covers email, push, in app and SMS for buyers and breeders across our marketplaces, with more markets joining as the group grows.

As our CRM & Lifecycle Manager, you'll own key parts of the customer lifecycle with our Head of CLM, across strategy, data, automation and execution. You'll spot where engagement can improve, design new journeys and experiments, and build the workflows that bring them to life.

You'll also help shape how the CLM itself works. Successful experiments become repeatable systems, and work that doesn't need a person gets automated.

Your edge is building fast and measuring everything. You use AI daily for research, analysis, segmentation, copy, personalisation and testing, so running several markets does not mean several times the work.

What you will do

  • Own the customer lifecycle. Design journeys for buyers and breeders that respond to what they do, across email, push, in app and SMS.

  • Turn data into action. Dig into behavioural data, spot opportunities and turn them into relevant experiences.

  • Automate the repetitive. Turn manual CRM processes into automated workflows, so time goes to higher value work.

  • Test what AI makes possible. Experiment with personalisation, content and segmentation, measure the results and take what works into production.

  • Build for scale. Create reusable journeys and processes, ready for new markets as the group grows.

  • Work across the business. Partner with product, data, engineering and marketing on the customer experience and the infrastructure behind it.

Requirements

Must have experience

  • 4 or more years in CRM or lifecycle marketing, preferably in house, with campaigns you personally built that moved a metric you can name. Marketplace, consumer app or ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Hands on experience in Customer.io or a comparable platform such as Braze, Iterable or Klaviyo. You're comfortable with segmentation logic, events, attributes and journeys that branch.

  • A habit of measuring. You set up tests properly, read results critically and sanity check a number before anyone else does.

  • Daily, active use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for building, copy, QA, localisation and workflow automation. You have a clear view of what to automate and what stays human.

  • Fluent English, written to a standard that needs no editing before it reaches a customer.

  • Able to own CRM as a team of one when needed: briefing agencies and freelancers, holding them to account, and saying "not this week" to requests with a clear reason.

Preferable experience

  • HTML and Liquid for email templates.

  • SQL, or working with a data warehouse and product analytics.

  • Marketing automation beyond the CRM, such as webhooks or tools like n8n.

  • A CRM platform migration.

  • A two sided or reputation exposed marketplace, such as pets, dating, fintech or the gig economy.

You will thrive here if you

  • Have the mindset of a hands on builder rather than a delegator.

  • Believe process serves outcomes, not the other way around.

  • Value clarity, candour and collaboration.

  • Take a roadmap and run with it, without needing daily direction.

  • Are curious beyond CLM and happy to pick up other marketing projects.

  • Are excited by the challenge of scaling one of Europe's most impactful consumer marketplaces.

What we offer

  • Direct access to founders and country leads.

  • A profitable, growing business rather than a slide deck.

  • A diverse team of more than 100 colleagues across the world.

  • Competitive compensation.

Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates.

You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision.

What technologies will you work with?

We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software.

  • Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS
  • Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery

We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

What will you do?

  • You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement.
  • You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code.
  • You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners.
  • You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs.
  • You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems.

Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision.

  • You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.
  • You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.
  • You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.
  • You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working.
  • You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

Bonus (Helpful, but not required)

About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above Montana. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need.

You Will Get To:

  • Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements.

  • Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation.

  • Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners.

  • Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations.

  • Leverage Zillow’s CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement.

  • Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently.

  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication.

  • Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions.

  • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

  • This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license.

  • Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test – National Component with Uniform State Content.

  • Physically located in and working remotely from Montana.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

jobs.description:
THIS IS AN UNPAID, REMOTE VOLUNTEER POSITION. Please read carefully before applying.

Background

Pitch Labs, a 501(c)3 non-profit, works to inspire, educate, and mentor aspiring high school entrepreneurs to build their first business. Obtaining knowledge to be a successful business founder can be financially costly and energy-draining. Our 100% volunteer-run nonprofit offers aspiring high school entrepreneurs free access to our mentor-matching program, entrepreneurship support community, and resource library. We strive to create a world where anyone can be an entrepreneur.

What We Need

We have a vision, we have a platform, but we need events to connect everyone together. Business reaches every single industry and profession in the world, and that means there are an infinite amount of questions to answer and lessons to teach. As a Product Owner, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including leadership, product development, marketing, sales, and user support, to drive the product roadmap and bring new Pitch Labs features to market.

How this Role ties into Our Mission:

Enabling young entrepreneurs is an essential part of our mission at Pitch Labs. As a Product Owner you will be supporting not only the internal stakeholders but also the customers to drive the most important features for the organization. Agility is the cornerstone of our organization and this product owner will enable the development team to work efficiently and effectively by prioritizing the highest value features for the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Requirement Gathering: Engage with a diverse range of stakeholders, including sales, customer support, and end-users, to gather and prioritize product and customer needs.

  • Backlog Management: Strategically plan and prioritize the product feature backlog, development tasks, stories, epics, and themes to ensure the product delivers maximum value. Ensure alignment with the organization’s mission and long-term product strategy.

  • Product Development: Partner closely with the software engineering team to iteratively develop and refine new features and products. Emphasize quick learning cycles to adapt and respond to the evolving needs of Pitch Labs.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Foster collaboration across marketing, sales, and customer success teams to ensure financial and customer satisfaction goals are met, with a focus on maximizing the impact on internal and external stakeholders.

  • Continuous Improvement: Continuously collect, analyze, and act on product feedback from multiple sources, including direct user input. Use insights to drive product improvements that support the growth and success of Pitch Labs customers.

Qualifications

  • Experience: At least 2 years of experience with SaaS or cloud products as a Product Owner or Product Manager.

  • Agile Methodology: In-depth knowledge of Agile processes and principles.

  • Product Delivery: Proven track record of delivering products from the ground up.

  • Communication Skills: Outstanding communication, planning, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail.

  • Analytical: Analytical and data-driven, able to extract meaningful insights to make informed product decisions.

  • Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills with an ability to find process efficiencies.

  • Collaborative style with a preference to lead with influence.

  • Entrepreneurial enthusiasm and grit, always willing to roll up your sleeves.

  • Adaptability: Thrive in a dynamic environment, ideally having experience in a rapidly growing company.

  • MUST be based in the US.

Benefits: Advanced Google Workspace and Canva features, the flexibility of working remotely, coaching/Q&A sessions with industry experts, resume coaching and guidance, public recognition of outstanding work on our social platforms, internal networking, and more!

Time Commitment: THIS IS AN UNPAID, REMOTE #WFH VOLUNTEER POSITION.

Although this is a volunteer role, given our startup-like functioning, we only seek active volunteers who are energized, ready to engage and make an impact.

Please be prepared to contribute at least 5 hours a week for at least the next 6 months. As we invest heavily in training each volunteer, we humbly request that if you are unable to meet this time commitment, that you do not proceed with our application further. All volunteers must attend their department’s team meeting or 1-1 meeting every week. We enforce a 24 hour response policy to promote a smooth workflow and mindfulness towards ongoing projects/deadlines that team members are working on.

We are able to accommodate volunteers who need time off for exams, work, family events, etc., as long as these commitments are appropriately conveyed as soon as possible.

What you'll do

Required

Nice to have

jobs.title: Director, Customer Growth - Americas
jobs.excerpt: About Us HiBob helps modern, mid-size businesses transform the way they manage people.
jobs.description:
About Us
HiBob helps modern, mid-size businesses transform the way they manage people. Our HR platform gives HR leaders and managers the tools they need to connect, engage, develop, and retain their people. Built for the way people work today – globally, remotely, and collaboratively – Bob helps organizations create better work experiences at scale.

Being a Bobber means bringing your full self to work and doing your best work alongside thoughtful, ambitious people. We are building a global team that values curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and a genuine commitment to customer success.

It’s an exciting time to join! Salesforce is leading a $166 million investment in the company, supporting our vision to bring trusted people context into the AI-powered enterprise. As we accelerate our product, technology, AI, and innovation roadmap, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape what comes next.

About the Role
​​​​​We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded Director of Customer Growth to lead HiBob’s existing-customer growth business across the US, Canada, and Latin America. This is a regional GTM leadership role with end-to-end accountability for the full Customer Growth UU motion across the Americas: expansion through upsell and cross-sell, together with renewal uplift.

Reporting into Customer Growth leadership, you will lead the regional Account Management and Renewal Management organization through its people managers, setting the strategy, operating rhythm, and commercial standards required to deliver predictable growth from HiBob’s installed customer base.

The Americas is a critical growth market for HiBob. Your mandate is to build a scalable, high-performance Customer Growth engine that captures the opportunity across the customer lifecycle, deepens strategic customer relationships, and increases HiBob’s presence and brand awareness through a growing base of successful customers.

You will balance the proactive “Hunt” for expansion opportunities with disciplined “Harvest” execution at renewal. Efficiency is non-negotiable: growth should scale through sharper prioritization, account tiering and intent signals, AI and automation, smart bundling, and repeatable commercial playbooks rather than linear headcount growth.

Location: New York City or the surrounding area preferred; open to candidates located within the Eastern Time Zone. Candidates based in the NYC metro area are expected to work a hybrid schedule.






Responsibilities

  • Own the Americas Customer Growth commercial outcome across the US, Canada, and Latin America, with accountability for expansion ARR from upsell and cross-sell and for commercial uplift at renewal.
  • Lead the full regional Customer Growth UU motion, bringing Account Management and Renewal Management together under one clear strategy, operating model, forecast, and performance cadence.
  • Deliver against regional Customer Growth targets, translating goals into clear expectations for managers and teams across pipeline creation, conversion, renewal uplift, forecast accuracy, and quota attainment.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Americas Customer Growth leadership team and organization, creating clear accountability, strong succession, and high- performance commercial culture.
  • Scale the “Hunt and Harvest” model: build proactive whitespace and lifecycle expansion while ensuring renewal opportunities are systematically managed for appropriate uplift and commercial value.
  • Create pipeline, not just manage it. Establish a signal-led approach using account tiering, intent data, customer lifecycle triggers, adoption insights, and structured plays to identify and prioritize the highest-value growth opportunities.
  • Build a rigorous operating rhythm for weekly forecasting, pipeline inspection, deal progression, renewal coverage, QBRs, and performance management using Salesforce, Clari, and the relevant Customer Growth tooling.
  • Improve productivity, average deal size, and deal velocity through AI-enabled workflows, automation, smart product bundles, scalable outreach, and differentiated high-touch and lower-touch motions.
  • Coach teams on value-led selling and complex commercial execution, using MEDDPICC and consistent deal inspection to improve qualification, stakeholder alignment, and close execution.
  • Build trusted executive relationships across strategic customers and act as a senior commercial escalation point for complex expansion and renewal conversations.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success so customer value, adoption, risk, and commercial opportunity translate into coordinated retention and growth actions without blurring functional ownership.
  • Partner with Sales, Sales Engineering, RevOps, Marketing, Product, Implementation, Finance, Legal, and Deal Desk to remove friction from the customer lifecycle and ensure Customer Growth is represented in decisions affecting expansion and renewals.
  • Represent the Americas customer and market perspective in global Customer Growth strategy, sharing insights and scalable practices that strengthen HiBob’s broader growth model.
  • Recruit, onboard, ramp, and retain exceptional Customer Growth talent as the organization scales.
How Success Will Be Measured
  • Total Americas Customer Growth UU / commercial growth performance.
  • Expansion ARR from upsell.
  • ARR generated through renewal uplift.
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and protection of the existing revenue base.
  • Regional, team, and individual quota attainment.
  • Expansion and renewal pipeline creation, coverage, conversion, and forecast accuracy.
  • Average deal size, deal velocity, and productivity / efficiency of the Customer Growth organization.
  • Successful development, ramp, retention, and succession of a high-performing regional team.

Base salaries for this role range from $153,000 - $195,000 per year. Additionally this role has a variable compensation component.
As an HR company, HiBob seeks to create a best-in-class employee experience for all Bobbers. We take immense pride in the diversity of our team and in creating an environment that is fair and equitable for all. Ensuring pay equity across race, gender, and all other forms of diversity is pivotal to this mission.
When determining salary ranges for our roles, we look at external market data and the salaries of Bobbers holding the same or similar roles. Our pay bands are wide because great candidates come to us with a broad range of experience and skill sets. When making individual pay rate decisions, we take into account the candidates’ depth of experience, their qualifications relative to incumbent employees, and their location-among other factors.

Requirements

  • 5+ years experience leading Account Management, Customer Growth, Expansion Sales, Renewals, or another commercial post-sales organization in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment
  • A proven track record owning and delivering a meaningful regional recurring-revenue target across an existing customer base
  • Demonstrated success growing ARR through upsell, cross-sell, and renewal uplift, with a strong understanding of recurring-revenue economics and NRR
  • Experience leading managers and multiple commercial teams or motions; the ability to coach leaders as well as individual contributors is important for this role
  • Proven experience leading managers and multiple commercial motions
  • Ownership of a meaningful recurring-revenue target
  • Demonstrated success across upsell, cross-sell and renewal uplift
  • NRR, expansion ARR, renewal performance and churn-risk expertise
  • Pipeline creation from the installed base, not simply pipeline management
  • Strong forecasting, pipeline generation, deal and pipeline inspection, and performance-management capability in a quota-carrying SaaS environment including QBRs and renewal coverage
  • Strong proficiency with Salesforce and experience with revenue intelligence and forecasting platforms such as Clari, and with outreach platforms
  • Strong knowledge of MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the ability to coach complex commercial opportunities
  • Demonstrated use of AI, automation, data, and customer signals to improve seller prioritization, productivity, and commercial outcomes
  • Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with the ability to move fluidly between regional strategy, operating metrics, people leadership, and individual deal execution
  • Executive presence and excellent communication, coaching, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior customer stakeholders and cross-functional GTM leaders
  • Cross-functional GTM leadership
  • Separate Preferred criteria, including HR tech experience and experience leading AM + Renewal organizations together
  • Experience in HR technology, HRIS, or a related enterprise software category is a plus

Benefits

At HiBob, our people are at the heart of everything we do.

We’re building a global village of ambitious, thoughtful, and talented Bobbers who want to do the best work of their careers. With a vibrant NYC office and remote teammates across the country, we’ve created an environment where people can be themselves, grow quickly, and make a real impact.

Joining HiBob means working alongside exceptional people while being supported with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and pre-IPO equity, including the perks below.

Ownership & Financial
  • Equity in a global, high-growth HR tech SaaS leader
  • 401(k) with a 3% company match effective the month following your start date
  • $2,500 employee referral bonus
Health & Wellbeing
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage from day one
  • $1,920 annual wellness stipend to support your physical and mental wellbeing
  • Annual Headspace membership and expanded wellness benefits
Workplace Flexibility
  • Hybrid working model for Bobbers in the NY metro area
  • Temporary work from anywhere for up to 2 months per year (after 6 months)
Work-Life Balance
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays to rest, recharge, and enjoy
  • Bob Balance Days – 4 additional days within a calendar year - Enjoy a company-wide long weekend at the beginning of each quarter
  • Your birthday off — plus a special gift from us
Work From Home
  • Home office allowance to set up your ideal workspace
Community & Culture
  • Two paid Social Impact days each year to give back to causes you care about
  • Frequent team and company social events, both in-person and virtual
Location Eligibility: While this is a remote position, HiBob is currently authorized to hire in the following states: CA. CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, MA, MD, MN, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA. Candidates must reside in one of these states to be considered for employment.

Join HiBob and be part of a dynamic, people-centric organization where your impact will shape the future of work. Apply now and unleash your potential in a supportive, inclusive environment that celebrates your uniqueness.

Position Title:

Enterprise Data Architect

Department:

ETS Analytics and AI Data

Job Description:

This position may be performed remotely from the following locations within the United States of America: Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, Oklahoma, and Texas.

Please only apply if you live and work full-time in one of the states listed above or plan to relocate to one of these states before starting your employment with OU Health. State locations and specifics are subject to change as our hiring requirements shift.

Preferred Experience:

Candidates with hands‑on enterprise data platform implementation experience are strongly preferred, as this role will play a critical role in designing and building a new companywide data solution from the ground up.

The Data Architect III leads design, implementation, and maintenance of OU Health’s Enterprise Data Platform and Information Architecture Framework. This role builds architecture, processes, and governance protocols to secure and manage data across its full life cycle, ensuring compliance and adaptability in an ever‑changing healthcare and technology environment. This role collaborates with clinical, research, and administrative leaders, vendors, and partners to deliver a scalable, secure, and future‑ready analytics platform that meets diverse data needs.

Essential Responsibilities:

Responsibilities listed in this section are core to the position. Inability to perform these responsibilities, with or without an accommodation, may result in disqualification from the position.

  • Develop and implement scalable, secure, and interoperable data systems (including data warehouses, data lakes, and real-time processing platforms) tailored for OU Health’s enterprise data analytics platform.

  • Define and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models to standardize data across clinical, research, and operational systems. Ensure models support healthcare-specific requirements (clinical, claims, provider, member, etc.).

  • Design and oversee data integration processes (ETL/ELT pipelines) to enable seamless data flow between OU Health and other entities as needed.

  • Work closely with clinical, research, and administrative stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data solutions that meet departmental needs. Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among all parties.

  • Monitor and optimize database performance, troubleshoot issues, and integrate new technologies to support evolving healthcare analytics needs.

  • Implement robust security and backup procedures to protect sensitive patient information and ensure compliance with privacy laws.

  • Prepare and maintain system documentation, data dictionaries, and architecture blueprints. Provide training and guidance to team members on data management best practices.

  • Identify opportunities to enhance data infrastructure, support innovation, and enable advanced analytics for improved patient outcomes and operational efficiency.

  • Work closely with clinical staff, IT professionals, data analysts, and researchers to understand data requirements, workflows, and pain points. Facilitate regular meetings and workshops to gather input and align data solutions with clinical and operational needs.

  • Act as a liaison between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex data concepts into actionable insights. Ensure that data architecture decisions reflect the priorities of clinicians, administrators, and compliance officers.

  • Promote a culture of knowledge sharing by documenting data models, standards, and best practices. Provide training and mentorship to team members on data management, security, and governance.

  • Lead collaborative efforts to troubleshoot data issues, optimize workflows, and implement new technologies. Encourage open communication and feedback to continuously improve data systems and processes.

  • Participate in project planning and execution, ensuring that data architecture aligns with project goals, timelines, and resource constraints. Coordinate with project managers and other architects to deliver integrated solutions.

General Responsibilities:

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, or related field required.

Experience: 5 years of experience in data architecture, database design, or healthcare IT required.

License(s)/Certification(s)/Registration(s): None required.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Proficiency in database management systems (SQL, NoSQL, cloud platforms).

  • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7).

  • Familiarity with data modeling, ETL tools, and data integration platforms.

  • Programming skills (Python, Java, Scala) and experience with big data technologies.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication abilities.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across clinical and technical teams.

  • Deep understanding of healthcare data security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

jobs.description:
Let’s build the future of medicine - together.

Remote | Full-time | $275,000-$300,000

YOUR ROLE

At Enveda, we’re reinventing drug development: not just with our discovery and development platform, but also in our approach to culture and organization. Our Program Strategy & Operations (PSO) leaders are not simply trackers of timelines, they are strategic and operational copilots to the Asset Entrepreneurs driving their molecule. You will be the connective tissue across the single-threaded asset team, transforming rich, cross-functional information into sharper strategy, better decision-making with our C-suite, and faster, higher-quality execution, directly determining how quickly we bring our first-in-class natural-molecule-inspired medicines to the patients who need them most.

We think of this role as an Asset Entrepreneur in the making, bringing a founder mentality from the start; you will be judged on the speed and quality of the asset's decisions and the progress that follows, not on how many meetings you run. In this role, you will report to the Asset Entrepreneur and be accountable for:

  • Operating as a strategic thought partner to your Asset Entrepreneur, anticipating program inflection points, modeling backup and expansion scenarios, and helping determine when to accelerate, pivot, or pause aspects of the development plan based on data and risk.
  • Owning program execution end-to-end, operating like the COO of a single-asset biotech: rapidly identifying obstacles and doing whatever is needed to keep the program moving, be that coordinating across functions, rallying CRO partners, or designing dashboards to keep all aligned.
  • Translating complexity into clarity by distilling scientific, clinical, regulatory, and operational inputs into rigorous analytical insights and clearly communicated options for the Board and C-suite, including crisp, data-driven slides/memos.
  • Maintaining disciplined documentation and operational clarity, capturing key decisions, assumptions, and benchmarks while keeping dashboards, trackers, and updates accurate, accessible, and action-ready for asynchronous alignment.
  • Contributing to Enveda’s institutional intelligence and playbook, documenting benchmarks, best practices, and learnings that make each future program faster and smarter.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Longitudinal asset development from IND-enabling studies through commercial strategy
  • Full cross-functional operations, working shoulder-to-shoulder with clinical, translational, regulatory, CMC, and commercial experts
  • External engagement, selecting and managing our external vendors, advisors, and strategic partners, and building a presence among our disease area’s top thinkers
  • Board and investor engagement, embedding in our investor and business development (BD) processes and seeing first-hand how biotechs grow
  • Scientific storytelling, helping to discover, craft, and tell the narrative of new molecules that often bring novel biology into the therapeutic world, requiring substantial education of patients, clinicians, and investors
  • Company building and culture creation, as we write the playbook and growing body of operational knowledge in a nascent biotech on the path to a new, multi-disease, multi-mechanism commercial future.
    • In short, you’ll sit at the intersection of strategy, science, and operations, where decisions visibly move both the program and the company.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

    If you’ve ever wished you could combine the discipline of program management with the strategic thinking, creativity and agency of a startup leader - and operate like the COO of a single-asset biotech – this is that opportunity.

    You might be a fit if you are:

  • Experienced in biotech or pharma program management, portfolio or asset strategy, management consulting, or operations - and able to use this experience to help your program avoid missteps
  • Fluent with AI, using it from the start of your workflow not as a novelty, but as a multiplier of human judgment and creativity
  • A crisp communicator, able to synthesize information across disciplines to propose clear, compelling options, laid out in concise slides / memos supported by clear data analysis
  • Willing to roll up your sleeves and make things happen yourself, when needed, regardless of title: gaps don’t linger in your perimeter and you can’t rest until they’re resolved
  • Used to thriving in ambiguity and moving fluidly between strategic vision and tactical execution
  • Emotionally intelligent, humble, and honest, leading through collaboration, not control
  • Intellectually curious, analytically rigorous, and can bring an optimism that lifts the team

    • We hire for trajectory, not just credentials. If you meet most of the above and care deeply about this problem, we want to hear from you.

This role is remote, though will necessarily involve travel on a roughly monthly basis to meet the team and key external stakeholders.

ABOUT ENVEDA

We're a clinical-stage, AI-enabled biotech discovering medicines from nature four times faster than the industry standard. We recently raised $311M in a Series E, bringing total funding to over $845M, and doubled our valuation to $2B. jobs.description:
About the Role:

As the Senior Software Systems Analyst on the DATUM team, under the leadership of the VP of Software, you will own the functional definition of our software scope, translating what we sell into what we build. This is a new role on the DATUM team, created to close the gap between the sale and the software.

Your work first begins with providing collaborative inputs to the Solutions Software team who takes point on presales through proposal generation, the Level 1 Software Design Specification (SDS), and the ROM estimate. There is a collaborative handoff from Solutions that you will further expand into a Level 2 SDS and a firm estimate that attach to the proposal. From there you carry the definition through delivery, kick-off, detailed design workshops, onsite discovery, integration specifications, and daily partnership with the Development lead as the design matures into working software.

DCS will appreciate your rigor, your curiosity, your ability to hold a room of stakeholders, and your instinct for asking the question nobody thought to ask before development starts. Most of all we will appreciate that we can count on you to get things done.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop the Level 2 SDS, expanding on the Level 1 SDS and solutions guidance produced by the Solutions Software team, to attach to the customer proposal.
  • Build firm estimates for software scope at contract, converting ROM-level pre-sales numbers into committed hours, deliverables, and assumptions.
  • Partner with the Solutions Software team through the L1 to L2 transition so that the scope sold is the scope delivered, surfacing gaps and risks early.
  • Support in person project kick-offs and lead detailed design workshops with customers, internal stakeholders, and the Software Delivery Team.
  • Conduct onsite discovery at customer facilities to validate operational requirements, material flow, process exceptions, and existing systems.
  • Participate in and/or lead project Scrum ceremonies, and own and groom the project backlog.
  • Maintain and update the SDS with the Development lead throughout design and development, keeping the specification and the build aligned as decisions are made.
  • Author 3rd-party integration specifications for the subsystems DATUM orchestrates; print and apply, robotics, sortation, scales and dimensioners, parcel and carrier systems, and similar.
  • Author WMS/ERP integration specifications defining messaging, data mapping, transaction flows, and error handling between DATUM and host systems.
  • Define detailed IT and network specifications, including server and virtualization requirements, hardware, networking, security, and infrastructure needs.
  • Define the DATUM-to-Controls integration specification in partnership with the Controls Engineering team.
  • Provide inputs to the Product and R&D teams, drawn primarily from project needs and the sales pipeline, to help shape the DATUM roadmap.
  • Travel to customer sites as required for discovery, design workshops, design reviews, and commissioning support. Anticipated level of travel is up to 50%.
  • Represent the Software department with the highest standards of ethics and integrity.
  • Evaluate organizational performance data to identify areas of opportunity and adapt.

We’re Excited About You Because:

  • You have 8 or more years of experience in software development, systems analysis, solution design, or technical project delivery for WES/WCS, WMS, or other industrial software.
  • You have a technical bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Electrical Engineering. Potentially Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, or equivalent experience.
  • You have written design specifications, functional requirements, or integration documents that development teams built from, and you can defend them in front of a customer.
  • You understand material handling automation and where a warehouse execution system sits between WMS/ERP above and PLC-level controls below.
  • You have hands-on experience specifying integrations, REST/APIs, messaging, flat file, EDI, and the realities of someone else’s system on the other end.
  • You are comfortable estimating software scope, stating your assumptions, and standing behind the number.
  • You have worked in an Agile/Scrum environment, managed a backlog, and are proficient with Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • You are excited to play a key role in helping build and grow the DCS Software Team – and to shape a role that is new to it.
  • You’re able to deliver results in fast-paced and high-stress environments.
  • You are an enabler and enhancer of our company culture.
  • You have excellent communication skills and you’re able to work well with clients, management, and multidiscipline teams.
  • You’re a self-motivated performer who can execute with minimum supervision and guidance.
  • You’re a creative problem-solver who can manage multiple complex tasks and projects at a time.
  • You are proficient in MS Office products and diagramming tools such as Visio, Draw.io or Lucidchart. Familiarity with SQL, log review, and modern software project management suites is a plus.

About Us: 

Conveyor may be in our name, but it’s only part of what we do. DCS was founded in 1982 and has grown to serve major clients in multiple industries by providing material handling, full-scale warehouse operations and conveyor design solutions that are custom crafted for their need. We don’t sell ready-made systems - we build relationships that empower us to craft custom solutions together. It’s the teamwork approach, sharing ideas and building upon them, that produces the best results.   

And DCS is committed to creating an extraordinary employment experience for our team. We work like crazy to hire and develop great people, build relationships, and ensure that the programs and services we offer our team are among the best in the business- from a killer snack wall and casual work environment to flexible PTO and opportunities to give back within the community.

More reasons to join our team:   

  • We pride ourselves in our family-like culture and casual, but focused, work environment   
  • We offer competitive salaries and health benefits   
  • Our 401K program includes a 100% match up to 5%   
  • Participation in our Discretionary Profit-Sharing Program   
  • We offer our employees flexibility and autonomy   
  • We do community outreach projects throughout the year   
  • We know how to throw company events   
  • We work hard, but we also know how to have fun - darts, anyone?

jobs.title: Call for proposal for Advocacy and Strategic Lobbying Consultant
jobs.excerpt: The World Councl of Chuches is looking for a Consultant for advocacy and strategic lobbying: 1.
jobs.description:
The World Councl of Chuches is looking for a Consultant for advocacy and strategic lobbying:

1. Background
The World Council of Churches’ Ecumenical Accompaniment Programme in Palestine and Israel (WCC–EAPPI) has worked since 2002 to accompany Palestinian and Israeli communities and organisations pursuing a just peace through non-violent means. The programme combines protective presence, systematic monitoring and documentation, and evidence-based advocacy through an international ecumenical network.
The EU-supported GUARD project will operate for 36 months in East Jerusalem and the Jerusalem periphery, with particular attention to communities affected by forced displacement, settlement expansion, restrictions on movement and worship, settler violence, home demolitions, and discriminatory planning and residency policies. The action aims to strengthen protective presence, translate verified field evidence into strategic advocacy, and mobilise international political, faith, civil-society, and media constituencies.
The project’s advocacy component includes structured international delegations, high-level policy briefings, strategic lobbying in selected countries, sustained follow-up with decision-makers, engagement of WCC member churches and EAPPI national coordinations, and coordination with local and international civil-society partners. WCC–EAPPI therefore seeks an experienced Advocacy and Strategic Lobbying Consultant to support the design, preparation, delivery, and assessment of these activities.

2. Purpose of the Assignment
The purpose of the consultancy is to strengthen the quality, reach, coherence, and measurable influence of WCC–EAPPI’s international advocacy under the GUARD project. The consultant will help convert verified field documentation and community-validated priorities into targeted policy engagement, effective lobby missions, and structured follow-up with decision-makers and influential faith and civil-society networks.

3. Objectives
• Develop and maintain a practical advocacy and lobbying strategy aligned with GUARD Outcomes 2 and 3 and the approved project workplan.
• Identify priority decision-makers, institutions, entry points, messages, and feasible policy asks in each target country or institution.
• Prepare and coach Ecumenical Accompaniers, former EAs, church representatives, community voices, and WCC–EAPPI staff for safe, ethical, and effective advocacy engagement.
• Support the organisation of lobby weeks, delegations, policy briefings, and follow-up engagement in ways that connect verified field evidence with concrete policy action.
• Strengthen coordination with WCC networks, EAPPI national coordination and the Advocacy Coordination network.
• Establish an outcome-oriented system for documenting access, commitments, follow-up actions, policy influence, learning, and risk.

4. Scope of Work

4.1 Inception and strategic planning

  • Review the approved GUARD application, logical framework, advocacy workplan, existing fact sheets, incident trends, campaign materials, prior lobby reports, stakeholder maps, and relevant WCC policies.
    • Conduct inception consultations with WCC–EAPPI coordinator, Middle East programme Executive, and advocacy staff, selected national coordination, and key partners.
    • Prepare a concise inception report and an assignment workplan, including methodology, deliverable schedule, consultation plan, risks, safeguarding measures, and information needs.
    • Refine the advocacy theory of change, priority policy objectives, messages, calls to action, target audiences, influence pathways, and indicators of progress.

4.2 Stakeholder mapping and engagement planning
• Map and prioritise relevant executive, legislative, diplomatic, faith, media, and civil-society stakeholders, including decision-makers in EU institutions and selected EU Member States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and the United States.
• Identify credible institutional entry points, political calendars, committee processes, policy windows, and opportunities for coordinated engagement.
• Develop engagement plans that specify the objective, audience, messenger, evidence, policy ask, channel, risk, and follow-up action for each priority stakeholder.
• Ensure outreach is coordinated with WCC offices, national coordinations, and strategic partners to avoid duplication and strengthen complementarity.

4.3 Advocacy products and briefing materials
• Translate verified WCC–EAPPI documentation into concise, audience-specific briefing notes, talking points, meeting briefs, policy asks, and follow-up correspondence.
• Advise on the strategic use of living fact sheets, feature stories, videos, community testimony, and rapid-response communications within policy engagement.
• Apply a rigorous verification and clearance process so that all claims are accurate, appropriately sourced, legally and politically sound, conflict-sensitive, and consistent with WCC–EAPPI positions.
• Ensure EU visibility and acknowledgement requirements are applied where relevant and approved by WCC–EAPPI.

4.4 Training and preparation of advocacy participants
• Design and deliver practical training for selected EAs, former EAs, church representatives, staff, and other approved advocates on policy engagement, message discipline, meeting roles, ethical storytelling, media readiness, and secure handling of sensitive information.
• Facilitate simulation exercises and provide tailored coaching before each lobby mission or high-level engagement.
• Prepare participant packs with objectives, stakeholder profiles, key messages, evidence, meeting protocols, safety guidance, and debriefing tools.

4.5 Lobby missions, delegations, and strategic engagement
• Support the preparation and implementation of agreed lobby weeks and strategic engagements in Belgium/Brussels, Hungary, Italy, the United Kingdom, Canada, and the United States, subject to the approved annual workplan, budget, and security assessment.
• Advise on the advocacy design and follow-up of structured international delegations to East Jerusalem, ensuring that field visits, community encounters, briefings, and calls to action are coherent and ethically managed.
• Help secure and prepare meetings with relevant parliamentarians, officials, diplomats, church leaders, journalists, policy advisers, and civil-society actors.
• Where agreed, accompany or remotely support missions, facilitate daily briefings and debriefings, troubleshoot emerging issues, and document commitments and next steps.

4.6 Follow-up, monitoring, learning, and reporting
• Establish and maintain a confidential stakeholder engagement and follow-up tracker that records meetings, policy asks, commitments, responsibilities, deadlines, and outcomes.
• Draft tailored follow-up messages and provide decision-makers with verified updates, feature stories, talking points, and responses to questions.
• Track outcome-level evidence, including access gained, commitments made, parliamentary or diplomatic actions, public statements, policy references, coalition actions, and other plausible contributions to change.
• Facilitate after-action reviews and provide practical recommendations to improve subsequent advocacy cycles.

5. Geographic and Audience Focus
The assignment will prioritise the geographic and institutional audiences approved through the project workplan. These may include:
• European Union institutions and selected Member States, initially Belgium/Brussels, Hungary, Germany and/or Italy;
• the United Kingdom, Canada, and the United States;
• international and national parliamentarians, government officials, diplomats, and policy advisers;
• senior church and faith leaders, especially constituencies able to influence public policy and diplomatic engagement;
• international journalists, editors, influencers, and media representatives; and
• civil-society, legal, humanitarian, and advocacy partners participating in coordinated actions.
Priorities may be adapted by WCC–EAPPI in response to the political context, policy opportunities, security conditions, project indicators, and available resources.

6. Expected Deliverables

No.

Indicative timing

1

Assignment understanding; reviewed evidence base; methodology; stakeholder consultation plan; risks and mitigation; deliverable calendar; information and support required.

3

4
