8

Final consultancy report and handover

Consolidated results against objectives and indicators; contribution analysis; stakeholder and follow-up status; lessons; recommendations; handover of final editable materials.

Within 15 working days after completion of the assignment

8. Management, Coordination, and Approval
The consultant will report to the WCC–EAPPI Programme Coordinator and work closely with the Advocacy Officer. Relevant deliverables may require review by WCC communications, legal, programme, or senior management focal points and, where appropriate, consultation with partners or affected communities.
The consultant may not issue public statements, represent WCC positions, contact stakeholders in WCC–EAPPI’s name, publish project information, or commit project resources without prior written authorisation. WCC retains final approval over advocacy objectives, messages, participant selection, itineraries, external communications, and deliverables.

9. Duration, Level of Effort, and Travel
The assignment will require up to 90 working days, deployed in tranches according to an agreed workplan and the timing of advocacy activities. The contract start and end dates will be stated in the consultancy agreement. The assignment is primarily home-based, with travel to agreed locations where required, budgeted, authorised in advance, and considered feasible under prevailing security and access conditions.
Any international travel will follow WCC travel, security, safeguarding, insurance, and expense procedures. WCC–EAPPI may replace, postpone, relocate, or convert an in-person activity to remote delivery where security, access, diplomatic, financial, or operational considerations require it.

10. Required Qualifications and Experience
• Advanced university degree in international relations, public policy, law, human rights, political science, communications, theology, development studies, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be accepted.
• At least seven years of progressively responsible experience in advocacy, government relations, public policy, political engagement, campaigning, or strategic communications.
• Demonstrated record of organising and supporting high-level advocacy or lobby missions involving parliamentarians, government officials, diplomats, faith leaders, or international institutions.
• Strong understanding of EU institutions and at least two of the other target environments identified in this TOR; a credible network in relevant institutions is a significant advantage.
• Substantive knowledge of international human rights law, international humanitarian law, and the political and protection context in Israel and Palestine, particularly East Jerusalem.
• Proven ability to translate complex field evidence and legal analysis into concise, audience-specific policy messages and achievable calls to action.
• Excellent facilitation, training, negotiation, political judgement, writing, and oral communication skills in English; additional relevant languages are an advantage.
• Demonstrated commitment to do-no-harm practice, confidentiality, safeguarding, gender sensitivity, cultural awareness, and responsible use of testimony.
• Ability to work independently across time zones, manage multiple stakeholders, meet short deadlines, and adapt to changing political or security conditions.

11. Proposal Requirements
Interested individual consultants or consulting entities should submit:
• a concise technical proposal demonstrating understanding of the assignment and presenting the proposed methodology, workplan, quality assurance, risk management, and availability;
• an updated CV for the proposed consultant(s), or an organisational profile identifying the lead consultant and any team members;
• two examples or summaries of comparable assignments, with references that may be contacted;
• a financial proposal in the requested currency, showing the professional fee or daily rate, number of days, applicable taxes, and any anticipated reimbursable costs separately; and
• a declaration of availability, independence, confidentiality, and any actual or potential conflict of interest.

Travel and event costs should not be embedded in the professional fee unless expressly requested. Any reimbursable cost will require prior written approval and supporting documentation in accordance with WCC procedures.

Applications should be submitted by 31 October 2026

jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices (GCP), and the Sponsor's standards. The Sr. CRA is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders. The Sr. CRA is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner (SCP), and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close-out of sites in a clinical trial.

Monitoring Responsibilities and Study Conduct:

  • Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan (SMP) and applicable prevailing laws, GCP, and the Sponsor's standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality
  • Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site activation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met
  • During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery
  • Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites
  • Partner with Site Care Partner to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks
  • Attend investigator meeting when required (virtual or F2F). Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with Site Care Partner and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level
  • Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the SMP, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies
  • Monitor site level adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs) and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution
  • Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File (TMF) documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics
  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues
  • Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close-out plan and conduct close-out activities within required timelines
  • Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities
  • Support database release as needed
  • May undertake the responsibilities of an unblinded monitor where appropriate

Clinical/Scientific and Site Monitoring Risk:

  • Maintain thorough understanding of the product, protocol and therapy area in sufficient details to have appropriate discussions with the investigator and site team
  • Interact with investigator site heath care professionals in a manner which enhances the Sponsor's credibility, scientific leadership and in order to facilitate their clinical development goals
  • Support the study clinician in ensuring patient safety, eligibility and providing clinical guidance to investigators
  • Drive Quality Event (QE) remediation, when applicable
  • Serve as a point of contact for audit conduct, and drive Audit Observation corrective action/preventive action (CAPA) development and checks, when applicable

Skills:

  • Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodologies, ICH/GCP, Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local country regulations
  • Monitoring Experience: Minimum 2 years relevant experience in clinical research site monitoring
  • Must be fluent in English and in the native language(s) of the country they will work in
  • Ability to travel 60-80%
  • Valid driver’s license and passport required

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or professional degree in life sciences such as nursing, pharmacy, medical background or equivalent

Parexel is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected status, which in the US includes race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Job Description

Candidates located in the Southeastregion (GA, FL, AL, MS, LA) are strongly preferred.

The role is accountable for performance and compliance for assigned protocols and sites in a country.

Under the oversight of the CRA-Manager the person ensures compliance of study conduct with ICH/GCP and country regulations, our Company's policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally.

Acts as primary site contact and site manager throughout all phases of a clinical research study, taking overall responsibility of allocated sites.

Actively develops and expands the territory for clinical research, finding and developing new sites.

Participates in internal meetings and workstreams as SME for monitoring processes and

Systems.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Develops strong site relationships and ensures continuity of site relationships through all phases of the trial.
  • Performs clinical study site management/monitoring activities in compliance with ICH-GCP, Sponsor SOPs, Local Laws & Regulations, Protocol, Site Monitoring Plan and associated documents.
  • Gains an in-depth understanding of the study protocol and related procedures.
  • Coordinates & manages various tasks in collaboration with other sponsor roles to achieve Site Ready.
  • Participates & provides inputs on site selection and validation activities.
  • Performs remote and on-site monitoring & oversight activities using various tools to ensure:
    • Data generated at site are complete, accurate and unbiased.
    • Subjects’ right, safety and well-being are protected.

  • Conducts site visits including but not limited to validation visits, initiation visits, monitoring visits, close-out visits and records clear, comprehensive and accurate visit & non-visit contact reports appropriately in a timely manner.
  • Collects, reviews, and monitors required regulatory documentation for study start-up, study maintenance and study close-out.
  • Communicates with Investigators and site staff on issues related to protocol conduct, recruitment, retention, protocol deviations, regulatory documentation, site audits/inspections and overall site performance.
  • Identifies, assesses and resolves site performance, quality or compliance problems and escalates per defined CRA Escalation Pathway as appropriate in collaboration with CRA-Manager, CRM, TA Head and CRD as needed.
  • Works in partnership with GCTO country operations, finance, regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, legal and regional operations, HQ functional areas and externally with vendors and IRB/IECs and Regulatory Authorities in support of assigned sites.
  • Manages and maintains information and documentation in CTMS, eTMF and various other systems as appropriate and per timelines.
  • Contributes to CRA team knowledge by acting as process Subject Matter Expert (SME), buddy/mentor and sharing best practices as appropriate/required.
  • Supports and/or leads audit/inspection activities as needed.
  • Performs co-monitoring visits where appropriate.
  • Following the country strategy defined by CRD and/or CRA-Manager, contributes to the identification of new potential sites and works closely with them to develop strong clinical research capabilities.

Extent of Travel:

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 65%-75% of working time.
  • Expected travelling ~2-3 days/week.
  • Current driver’s license preferred.

CORE Competency Expectations:

  • Fluent in Local Languages and English (verbal and written) and excellent communication skills, including the ability to understand and present technical information effectively.
  • Good understanding and working knowledge of clinical research, phases of clinical trials, current GCP/ICH & country clinical research law & guidelines.
  • Good understanding of Global, Country/Regional Clinical Research Guidelines and ability to work within these guidelines.
  • Hands on knowledge of Good Documentation Practices.
  • Proven Skills in Site Management including management of site performance and patient recruitment.
  • Demonstrated high level of monitoring skill with independent professional judgment.
  • Good IT skills (Use of MS office, use of various clinical IT applications on computer, tablet and mobile devices) and ability to adapt to new IT applications on various devices.
  • Ability to understand and analyze data/metrics and act appropriately.
  • Capable of managing complex issues, works in a solution-oriented manner.
  • Performs root cause analysis and implements preventative and corrective action.

Behavioral Competency Expectations:

  • Effective time management, organizational and interpersonal skills, conflict management, problem solving skills.
  • Demonstrated high level of monitoring skill with independent professional judgement.
  • Able to work highly independently across multiple protocols, sites and therapy areas.
  • High sense of accountability / urgency. Ability to set priorities and handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a changing environment.
  • Works effectively in a matrix multicultural environment. Ability to establish and maintain culturally sensitive working relationships.
  • Demonstrates commitment to Customer focus.
  • Works with high quality and compliance mind-set.
  • Positive mindset, growth mindset, capable of working independently and being self-driven.
  • Demonstrates and projects professional demeanor and communication consistent with organizational policies and practices.

Experience and Educational Requirements:

  • Associate's degree, certificate or equivalent in a scientific / healthcare discipline together with at least 5 years of relevant experience in the healthcare field, including at least 2 years of direct site management (monitoring) experience in a bio / pharma / CRO.

Or

  • Bachelor’s degree (or above) together with at least 2 years of direct site management (monitoring) experience in a bio / pharma / CRO.

  • Experience in Neurology preferred.

Company:Driven Brands

The Automotive Training Institute (ATI), the largest coaching and training company for Owners of Independent Repair Shops in the US and Canada. With over 1700 shops actively engaged in our program, we provide coaching, training and the largest buying program in the automotive aftermarket for Independent Shop Owners. Our members have cumulatively increased their Gross Profits by almost $3.0 Billion dollars through the ATI program.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The General Manager, Member Programs (GM) serves as the business owner for ATI’s portfolio of member-facing programs, including coaching, training, peer groups, MSO programs, member onboarding and advisory services. The GM is accountable for the portfolio’s financial performance, strategic direction, member outcomes, and continuous improvement. The GM will establish portfolio priorities, financial commitments, performance expectations and investment recommendations, and will lead ATI’s member advisory and escalation efforts. This role partners with leaders of Coaching and Training, Peer Groups and MSO Programs to create and deliver a coordinated ownership for improved member experience.


Areas of Responsibility

  • Lead ATI’s member-program portfolio as one coordinated business, with clear strategy, financial targets, member outcomes and an integrated roadmap for program evolution.
  • Build and manage a program performance framework that tracks financial results, utilization, member engagement, satisfaction, retention influence, delivery quality, and investment opportunities.
  • Develop annual and quarterly plans for member programs, including goals, budgets, priorities, innovation roadmap, talent needs, and expected business outcomes.
  • Establish portfolio scorecards and monthly business reviews; driving accountability for plans, results and improvement actions Identify gaps, overlap and disconnected member experiences across programs and work with functional leaders to resolve them.
  • Own ATI's enterprise-wide member escalation and resolution process, ensuring member concerns are addressed quickly, root causes are resolved permanently, and insights are translated into operational, program, and service improvements.
  • Partner with Finance to establish meaningful program-level reporting and decision support frameworks.
  • Partner with Technology to identify systems and tools that improve measurement, delivery, personalization, and scalability.
  • Partner with Marketing and Sales to ensure programs are differentiated, clearly positioned and connected to ATI’s growth and retention strategy.
  • Lead strategic reviews of existing offerings and recommend changes that improve member value, competitive differentiation, efficiency, and profitability.
  • Serve as a senior leader who helps ATI become a stronger, more competitive company by improving the quality, relevance, measurement, and financial performance of its member offerings.

Success Measures

  • Clear ownership, governance, decision-making processes and financial accountability across ATI’s member program portfolio.
  • Improved program profitability, resource allocation, utilization, and investment discipline.
  • Improved member outcomes, engagement, satisfaction, retention, and program quality.
  • A high-performing operating model that creates alignment, accountability, and measurable results across all member program functions.
  • A defined innovation roadmap that helps ATI refine current offerings, test new concepts, and build a stronger competitive position.

Candidate Profile

  • 20+ years of progressive experience leading business units, member programs, customer success or professional service teams in franchise, automotive, or multi-location service organizations, with strong operational, financial, and team leadership responsibility.
  • Proven ability to drive results through both direct leadership and matrixed influence, leveraging executive presence, relationship building, negotiation, and organizational alignment to achieve strategic priorities, financial commitments, and enterprise-wide performance outcomes.
  • Proven success scaling cross-functional, multi-program organizations through strong leadership development, organizational accountability, change management, and effective partnership across the enterprise, with clear ownership of financial and performance outcomes.
  • Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, program economics, investment prioritization, performance reporting, and business case development.
  • Demonstrated success building products and programs by leveraging innovation, technology, performance insights, and customer success strategies to enhance member experiences, communities, and professional development offerings.
  • Executive-level communication skills with the ability to simplify complex business, financial, and program performance information into clear recommendations.
  • Deep understanding of the small business and owner-operator mindset, with demonstrated success helping business owners improve performance through practical leadership, meaningful relationships, real-world business solutions and hands-on delivery.

About Us: Artera is an artificial intelligence company dedicated to transforming cancer care. We’ve developed foundation models that analyze clinical and pathology data, generating actionable insights that guide therapy selection and improve outcomes for cancer patients. By continuously improving these models, we aim to uncover the biological mechanisms driving cancer progression.

We're looking for a machine learning engineer to help develop AI biomarkers that improve cancer care. You'll work closely with experienced ML scientists and engineers, as well as clinical, biostatistics, product, and regulatory partners, across the model-development lifecycle, from prototyping and experimentation through validation and production deployment. You'll contribute to challenging problems in medical AI, including building models from digital pathology and clinical data, improving robustness across scanners and sites, understanding model behavior, and advancing our pathology foundation models.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop and evaluate AI-based biomarkers using multimodal data, including whole-slide images, clinical variables, and molecular data, to predict patient outcomes, treatment benefit, and molecular traits.

  • Contribute to the development and evaluation of self-supervised foundation models and downstream machine-learning models, including multiple-instance learning, time-to-event / hazard models, segmentation, and classification.

  • Develop and evaluate methods to improve model robustness and reproducibility across scanners, institutions, staining protocols, and patient populations.

  • Explore and apply interpretability methods to explain model decisions, build clinician trust, and drive actionable model improvements.

  • Build and improve tools and workflows that support efficient, reproducible model development, experimentation, validation, and deployment.

  • Perform rigorous model evaluation and analysis, communicate findings clearly, and document experiments and technical decisions.

  • Collaborate with ML scientists and engineers as well as product, biostatistics, clinical development, and regulatory/quality partners throughout model development and validation.

  • Support regulatory and quality documentation related to AI model development and validation.

  • Contribute to peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, and external academic or industry collaborations.

Experience Requirements:

  • 1+ years of experience developing machine-learning or deep-learning models using PyTorch (or TensorFlow), including relevant master's or graduate research experience.

  • Familiarity with oncology and biomarker development, including cancer biology and treatment pathways, clinical endpoints, risk stratification, and what makes a biomarker clinically actionable.

  • Experience working with real-world datasets and evaluating machine-learning models using appropriate metrics and validation approaches.

  • Strong Python programming skills and familiarity with modern software-development practices, including version control, testing, and code review.

  • Ability to analyze experimental results, troubleshoot model behavior, and communicate findings clearly.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with ML engineers, scientists, and cross-functional partners.

Desired:

  • Experience working with complex clinical datasets, such as medical imaging, multi-omics, longitudinal patient records, or data from clinical studies and multi-institutional cohorts.

  • Familiarity with weakly supervised learning, multiple-instance learning, survival analysis, or related methods.

  • Experience with self-supervised representation learning or foundation models.

  • Familiarity with dataset shift and variation across sites, devices, scanners, or acquisition protocols.

  • Exposure to machine learning in regulated healthcare environments, including SaMD, FDA 510(k)/De Novo, design controls, or CLIA/LDT validation.

  • Research experience through publications, conference presentations, internships, or academic projects.

  • Familiarity with cloud-based ML development, including distributed training, workflow orchestration, experiment tracking, or reproducible pipelines.

At Gartner, we guide the leaders who shape the world, equipping them with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve mission‑critical priorities.

Gartner Consulting is where that insight becomes action, helping the world’s most influential enterprises and public‑sector leaders turn complexity into competitive advantage.


As a Managing Partner in Gartner Consulting North America, you will advise the country’s most influential organizations on the decisions that will define their next decade.


The Opportunity

As a Managing Partner, you operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and executive leadership. You are a trusted advisor to CIOs, CEOs, and senior government leaders—helping them navigate disruption, make high‑stakes decisions, and turn technology into a driver of growth, resilience, and transformation.


You will own and expand a portfolio of Gartner’s most important clients, bringing the full force of Gartner’s unmatched insights, benchmarking, and global expertise to their most mission‑critical challenges.


Why This Role Matters in North America

North America’s enterprises face a distinctive set of pressures:

  • Modernizing deeply entrenched legacy environments without disrupting operations
  • Balancing global digital acceleration with local compliance, risk management, and governance
  • Turning data, AI, and cloud investments into measurable value—not pilots
  • Managing ecosystem complexity across vendors, integrators, and internal stakeholders
  • Optimizing cost while maintaining quality, security, and brand trust, Gartner Consulting helps leaders navigate this complexity with evidence‑based decisions, benchmarks, and pragmatic execution.

What You’ll Do

  • Advise at the highest level. Partner with senior executives to define technology strategies that directly enable business outcomes—growth, efficiency, innovation, and risk mitigation.
  • Turn insight into execution. Lead hands‑on consulting engagements grounded in Gartner insights, helping clients move from “what should we do?” to “how do we make this real?”
  • Drive measurable value. Help organizations modernize platforms, rationalize applications, migrate to cloud, unlock data and analytics, manage cyber risk, and optimize cost and sourcing.
  • Expand account portfolio and drive revenue growth through strategic relationship development and consistently identifying and closing new opportunities
  • Lead exceptional teams. Inspire, coach, and develop high‑performing consultants who thrive on solving complex problems.

Where You’ll Make Impact

Your client work will span some of the most critical priorities facing enterprises today, including:

● Digital Acceleration & Enterprise Transformation

● Cloud Strategy and Operating Models

● Data, Analytics & AI Enablement

● Application and Portfolio Rationalization

● Cybersecurity, Risk & Resilience

● Sourcing, Ecosystem & Vendor Optimization

● Contract, Cost & Value Optimization

● Benchmark‑driven decision making


With a particular focus on State & Local Government Agencies in Oregon (OR) and/or Washington (WA), you will help leaders modernize legacy environments while competing in increasingly digital, data‑driven markets.


What Sets You Apart

  • A proven background in a well‑regarded consulting firm, balancing client delivery and revenue generation
  • Strong foundation in technology problem‑solving (architecture, analytics, engineering, or strategy roles)
  • Credibility across multiple IT domains—not just one “lane”
  • A track record of leading teams with a strong collaboration mindset, influencing executives, and delivering outcomes—not just recommendations
  • Intellectual curiosity and the confidence to adapt Gartner’s frameworks to each client’s unique situation
  • The stamina and presence to juggle multiple senior‑level client priorities without losing focus or quality
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Who Thrives at Gartner in This Role

  • Executive‑level relationship builders who are comfortable selling insight, not just services
  • Leaders who are coachable, reflective, and hungry to get better every year
  • Consistent over‑achievers who combine ambition with humility
  • People energized by complexity, change, and the chance to shape how organizations evolve through technology

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

jobs.description:
Fully Remote — South Africa | Independent Contractor | Full-Time, UK business hours | UK serviced accommodation client

About the Role

Outsource Ability is recruiting on behalf of a UK serviced accommodation operator for a confident and self-sufficient Sales Closer & Onboarding Specialist.

You will handle sales conversations with property owners, explain and close the client's service offer, and then run each new property through the full onboarding process — acting as the main point of contact for the owner from first call through to handover to the operations team.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Closing

  • Handle sales calls with property owners promptly and professionally.
  • Explain the client's offer clearly and confidently, using the agreed positioning and figures.
  • Handle objections and answer owners' questions directly, without referring routine queries back to the client.
  • Close agreed deals, issue contracts and collect onboarding fees and payments.
  • Follow up on open leads and carry out light lead nurturing, primarily by telephone and email.

Property Onboarding

  • Run the full onboarding process for each property once an owner has signed.
  • Trigger and arrange property photography.
  • Coordinate with the staging and design team to get the property prepared and presented to standard.
  • Work through the documented onboarding SOPs and CRM stages so no step is missed.
  • Keep the owner informed and supported throughout onboarding, acting as the face of the business during this period.

Handover to Operations

  • Confirm each property is correctly set up, then hand it over to the operations team.
  • Ensure the operations team receives all relevant property, owner and access information.

CRM and Record-Keeping

  • Maintain accurate lead and property records, statuses and next actions throughout the sales and onboarding process.

Systems

  • GoHighLevel
  • AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, used to streamline daily tasks and operations

Experience with every system is not essential, but you must be confident learning new technology.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Proven sales background with a demonstrable record of hitting targets.
  • Experience closing deals over the telephone.
  • Able to think on their feet and handle objections confidently, in line with the agreed scripts and SOPs.
  • Excellent telephone manner, with strong spoken and written English.
  • Comfortable working from scripts, SOPs and structured CRM processes, with strong discipline around notes, statuses and next actions.
  • Highly organised, with strong follow-up discipline.
  • Able to manage several onboarding processes at once without steps being missed.
  • Comfortable coordinating with third parties such as photographers and staging teams.
  • Available to take and make calls throughout the working day.

Advantageous

  • Serviced accommodation, short-term rental, lettings or wider property experience.
  • Experience communicating with UK consumers.
  • Experience using GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM.
  • Familiarity with AI tools in a professional environment.
  • Experience running a structured onboarding or account set-up process.

Remote Work Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be based in South Africa.
  • Have a modern laptop or PC (Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent, minimum 8GB RAM).
  • Have a stable fibre internet connection with a minimum of 50 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload.
  • Have a functional UPS, inverter or power station able to run a router and laptop for a minimum of 2–4 hours during load shedding.
  • Have a professional, noise-cancelling headset with a clear microphone.
  • Have a quiet workspace suitable for telephone calls and video meetings.
  • Be available for the agreed hours during UK business times.

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

The Data & AI Solution Architect is a senior technology leader responsible for leading the architecture, design, governance, and technical oversight of Carrier's enterprise cloud transformation initiatives, with primary responsibility for the migration of data platforms, analytics workloads, and AI solutions from AWS to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role establishes cloud architecture standards, defines target-state roadmaps, creates governance frameworks, and ensures scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective solutions across enterprise data, analytics, and AI ecosystems.


The position serves as a trusted advisor to business and technology leadership, guiding engineering teams through cloud modernization efforts, driving adoption of GCP best practices, and enabling long-term platform simplification, operational excellence, and innovation. The architect will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, delivery teams, cloud platform teams, security, and external partners to ensure successful execution of strategic transformation programs.


Key Responsibilities


Cloud Transformation & Architecture Leadership

  • Lead the architecture strategy and technical governance for enterprise cloud modernization initiatives
  • Define target-state architectures, migration roadmaps, and transition strategies for AWS-to-GCP transformation programs
  • Establish enterprise cloud architecture standards, design principles, reference architectures, and reusable pattern
  • Drive technology rationalization, platform modernization, and reduction of technical debt across data and analytics ecosystems
  • Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and provide architecture recommendations aligned with business objectives

AWS-to-GCP Migration Leadership

  • Lead architecture planning and execution for migration of data platforms, data products, analytics workloads, and AI solutions to GCP
  • Define migration approaches, landing zones, modernization patterns, and workload transition frameworks
  • Guide engineering teams on migration best practices, risk mitigation strategies, and operational readiness
  • Ensure successful migration of applications, data pipelines, warehouses, lakehouse platforms, and AI services while minimizing business disruption
  • Establish migration governance, review processes, and architecture quality gates.

Data, Analytics & AI Platform Architecture

  • Architect scalable and secure data lake, lakehouse, analytics, and AI platforms on GCP
  • Define enterprise standards for data integration, batch and streaming pipelines, API enablement, metadata, governance, and data quality
  • Guide architecture decisions involving BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataproc, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and broader GCP ecosystem services
  • Support AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and advanced analytics initiatives through scalable platform design and governance
  • Enable reusable, AI-ready data products and shared platform capabilities across business units

Architecture Governance & Solution Assurance

  • Lead architecture reviews and design governance processes for cloud and data initiatives
  • Validate solution designs for scalability, security, reliability, availability, performance, and maintainability
  • Establish cloud security, compliance, privacy, and operational standards in partnership with cybersecurity teams
  • Drive FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and platform engineering best practices

Stakeholder Engagement & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with business, product, engineering, cloud platform, security, and operations teams to align technology strategy with business goals
  • Act as the primary architecture advisor for cloud transformation programs and executive stakeholders
  • Mentor architects and engineering teams on GCP architecture, cloud-native design, and modernization best practices
  • Build organizational capability and establish long-term GCP architecture expertise across the enterprise

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in engineering or technical discipline
  • 10+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Cloud Architecture, or Data Platform Architecture

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree
  • 5+ years designing and delivering large-scale cloud solutions on GCP, AWS, or Azure
  • Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform such as BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, Monitoring
  • Experience with Lakehouse Architectures, Data Warehousing, Data Integration, Streaming, Data Governance
  • AI & ML: Vertex AI, Machine Learning Platforms, Generative AI, MLOps
  • Platform Engineering: Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Observability
  • Architecture & Governance: Enterprise Architecture, Architecture Review Boards, Reference Architectures, Technology Standards
  • Demonstrated success governing large-scale data, analytics, and AI platforms.
  • Experience working in global organizations and influencing cross-functional technology teams

Pay Range

The annual salary for this position is between $117,500.00 - $234,500.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Lead Control Systems Engineer

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The Lead Control Systems Engineer provides leadership, expertise, and delegates work for construction document

deliverables for building automation system (BAS), electrical power monitoring system (EPMS), and software

integration design projects in hyperscale data center and similar mission critical / technology sectors.

The Lead Control Systems Engineer will work with internal and external MEP/FP trade engineers, equipment

representatives, product vendors, and BIM / Revit / AutoCAD production resources.

The Lead Control Systems Engineer will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new

projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. This

role also will coordinate activities of other personnel and serve as a people manager.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals / values, and departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Develop and Execute Building Automation Systems Engineering Solutions (55%)

  • Serve as client program lead, project trade lead, and SME for the BAS and EPMS scope for one or more
  • projects and / or programs.
  • Develop client standards, basis of design (BOD), perform feasibility studies, and assist clients with building
  • automation roadmaps
  • Lead integration designs for DDC and PLC based BAS and EPMS systems
  • Design controls network / system architecture including IT / OT requirements
  • Select instrumentation, sensors, actuators, valves and other field devices
  • Coordinate with equipment, system, and product vendors for building automation interface requirements
  • Create and review project book and sheet specifications
  • Create and review sequence of operations
  • Create and review system diagrams and point / alarm lists
  • Work closely with client IT departments for network design, interface details, and security requirements
  • Provide direction on engineering production aspects with internal and external Revit / BIM resources

Construction Related Process, Deliverables and Submissions (15%)

  • Accountable for construction document deliverables for BAS submittal packages
  • Lead planning and execution of construction support activities with internal field personnel and subcontractors
  • Lead building automation-focused design reviews and page turns
  • Participate in internal and external quality control and peer reviews
  • Lead internal and external project meeting discussions on engineering scope

Reporting and Communication (15%)

  • Manage project communication and reporting
  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

People Manager (15%)

  • Manage and execute departmental or organizational projects, ensuring alignment with departmental focus
  • Ensure employee adherence to company policies and procedures, serve as the first stop for employee questions on workplace rules and practices
  • Direct team members clearly, maintaining consistency with organizational objectives
  • Develop team efficiency and prioritization strategies
  • Facilitate team member development through targeted coaching
  • Resolve conflicts within the team, promoting a collaborative atmosphere
  • Perform routine performance evaluations and 1:1 meetings, offering feedback and defining objectives
  • Participate in organizational strategy discussions to synchronize departmental and company goals
  • Foster interdepartmental communication to enhance organizational understanding
  • Align team efforts with overarching company strategies
  • Communicate details effectively to all stakeholders
  • Optimize resource management and task assignments within the team
  • Adapt resource allocation in response to project demands and departmental needs
  • Cultivate a team environment that encourages cooperation and collective problem-solving
  • Assist with team and departmental hiring and recruiting processes

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Skilled in navigating clients through BAS project designs including identification of standards, needs, and option evaluation
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Knowledge of Revit and AutoCAD
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Skilled in designing BAS and EPMS packages
  • Knowledge of construction design process, stakeholders, and deliverables
  • Knowledge of code requirements and energy guidelines related to BAS designs
  • Knowledge of data center HVAC applications and BAS control strategies including chilled water plants
  • Knowledge of IoT and smart building solutions
  • Knowledge of networking including addressing, VLANs, LANs, switches, and routers
  • Knowledge of OT protocols (BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, and MQTT)
  • Knowledge of DDC systems used in building automation designs
  • Knowledge of PLC systems used in building automation designs
  • Organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication, organization, self-motivation, proactiveness, and resourcefulness in a distraction-free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports, and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Ability to mentor and train junior engineers

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this

job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential

functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

Job Description

VICTAULIC 

Sourcing Specialist - SEA

Location: Anywhere in Malaysia / Thailand / Vietnam

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: Sourcing and Logistics

ABOUT VICTAULIC 

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries. 

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures. 

An Industry Leader with a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation 

At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our people. 

Let’s Build a Better World Together. 

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars: 

  • We build from within. 
  • We stand behind our people. 
  • We foster an environment for constant learning. 
  • We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world. 

YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE 

Under the direction of the Manager, Asia Pacific Sourcing & Logistics, you will be responsible for identifying, developing, and managing strategic supplier partnerships across Asia to support Victaulic's global supply chain.


You will ensure the reliable, cost-effective supply of components and commodities by driving supplier performance, mitigating supply risks, and implementing sourcing strategies that support business growth, quality standards, and operational excellence worldwide.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD & OWN 

  • New suppliers identification, assessment and establishment for required commodities / components in line with Victaulic Corp. procedures and business practices, to support Victaulic current and potential business needs in Asian Region and globally
  • Management of the related approved suppliers: including measurement and improvement of responsible Asian suppliers’ capacity, price, lead time, stock, delivery, packaging, logistics, communication, etc. Coordinate with QA and related Engineering people to closely work with responsible suppliers on solving quality issues
  • Analysis and interpretation of Asian quote packages representing Victaulic globalrequirements including Asian plants. Negotiation and agreement of global supply contracts for selected commodities and components for Victaulic globally
  • Timely communication of updated Victaulic requirements, practices & processes to responsible Asian suppliers (such as CCD, new standards, processes, etc.)
  • Timely search, identify and develop the new suppliers, timely obtain, negotiate and present the quotations from the selected suppliers
  • Issue the sample or pattern orders to suppliers after the quotations are approved, andeffectively follow up the sampling processes and interact with QA and suppliers during the whole sample process
  • Work in a cross-function environment and implement necessary purchasing tasks as the roles of Sourcing Specialist.

WHAT YOU BRING  ​

  • Hands-on sourcing experience including supplier identification, development and qualifications, supplier performance scorecard management, and with a detail-oriented manner
  • Fundamental products and manufacturing knowledge of ductile iron casting, fabrication and various valves used in piping system, physical properties or materials and engineering techniques used in new product development and product operations
  • Be able to read blue print, PC literate, able to use Microsoft Office software applications, sound presentation skills at all levels
  • Self-Motivated, result driven /goal oriented with customer focus and sense of urgency
  • Willingness to travel across Southeast Asia region and work flexibly as needed

WHAT SETS YOU APART 

  • Bachelor degree or above in Mechanical Engineering or related field
  • Fluency in English and Chinese language skills (verbal and written communications) to liaise with our internal and external stakeholders.
  • A plus for working in a cross functional environment and /or in a global culture

WHAT WE OFFER 

Build A Better Career 

  • Competitive salary package
  • Career development programs and internal promotion opportunities - we believe in growing talent from within.
  • Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

Build A Better Future 

  • Monthly medical allowance
  • A stable, globally recognised organisation with long-term career opportunities

Build A Better You 

  • Annual leave benefits and paid public holidays
  • Flexible working arrangements where business needs allow
  • Inclusive, collaborative culture where people support one another and celebrate success

Build A Better World 

  • Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day. 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY 

Victaulic is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, experience, and business needs.

We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diversity and believe that an inclusive workforce strengthens our business and communities.

VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY 

All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. All communications, inquiries and candidate submissions must be routed through Victaulic’s Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process. 

Let’s Build a Better World Together.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About Cyber Centaurs

Cyber Centaurs is a digital forensics and incident response firm serving businesses, law firms, insurers, and other organizations facing complex cyber incidents, employee misconduct, data theft, and litigation-related matters. Our work is guided by a simple principle: Evidence Over Assumption. We use defensible forensic methods, clear reporting, and careful analysis to help clients establish the facts and make informed decisions. Cyber Centaurs is growing, and we are seeking an experienced forensic professional who can take ownership of investigations while helping us continue to develop a disciplined, efficient, and respected digital forensics practice.

Position Overview

The Senior Digital Forensic Examiner is a senior, hands-on investigative position responsible for independently conducting digital forensic examinations from evidence acquisition through final reporting. This individual will manage assigned matters, examine computers and other digital evidence, document findings, prepare clear and defensible reports, and communicate directly with attorneys, executives, clients, and other stakeholders. The examiner may also support affidavits, depositions, hearings, and expert-witness engagements. The successful candidate must be comfortable performing detailed technical work while also contributing to quality assurance, process development, examiner training, and the continued growth of the forensic practice. The position offers a potential advancement path into a future Forensics Practice Lead or Director of Digital Forensics role as the team and service line continue to grow.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Independently manage digital forensic investigations from intake through completion.
  • Acquire, preserve, process, and examine digital evidence using accepted forensic methods.
  • Conduct forensic examinations of Windows computers, storage media, cloud data, email, and other relevant data sources.
  • Investigate matters involving insider threats, employee data theft, trade-secret theft, unauthorized access, intellectual-property disputes, fraud, workplace misconduct, and litigation.
  • Identify, interpret, and correlate operating-system artifacts, file activity, external storage usage, cloud synchronization, browser activity, email activity, application usage, and other relevant evidence.
  • Develop defensible timelines based on multiple forensic data sources.
  • Determine the meaning, reliability, and limitations of forensic artifacts.
  • Maintain complete case notes, examination records, chain-of-custody documentation, and supporting exhibits.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and technically defensible forensic reports.
  • Explain technical findings in plain language to attorneys, executives, clients, and other nontechnical audiences.
  • Participate in client meetings, attorney conferences, findings presentations, and case-strategy discussions.

  • Help develop and improve forensic procedures, examination workflows, reporting templates, and quality standards.

  • Maintain awareness of changes in operating systems, applications, cloud platforms, forensic artifacts, and industry practices.
  • Protect confidential, privileged, personally identifiable, and legally sensitive information.
  • Meet case deadlines and communicate promptly when scope, evidence volume, or technical conditions may affect delivery.
  • Travel periodically for evidence collection, client meetings, depositions, hearings, or other case requirements.

Requirements

At least five years of professional experience conducting digital forensic examinations or closely related investigations.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage forensic matters independently with limited supervision.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows forensic artifacts and file-system analysis.
  • Experience examining computers, storage media, email, cloud data, and user activity.
  • Experience investigating at least several of the following:
    • Insider threats
    • Employee data theft
    • Trade-secret or intellectual-property theft
    • Unauthorized access
    • External storage and USB activity
    • Cloud-storage and file-synchronization activity
    • Email-related activity
    • File deletion or attempted concealment
    • Workplace misconduct
    • Civil litigation or employment disputes
  • Strong understanding of forensic acquisition, evidence preservation, hashing, documentation, and chain-of-custody requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to correlate evidence from multiple sources and build defensible activity timelines.
  • Strong analytical judgment and careful attention to detail.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including experience preparing formal forensic reports.
  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly to nontechnical audiences.
  • Experience communicating directly with attorneys, executives, clients, or other senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple investigations, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Willingness to travel when case requirements make travel necessary.
  • Ability to pass applicable background screening and comply with confidentiality and evidence-handling requirements.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in digital forensics, cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, criminal justice, or a related discipline.
  • One or more recognized forensic certifications, such as:
    • GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner (GCFE)
    • GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)
    • Certified Forensic Computer Examiner (CFCE)
    • EnCase Certified Examiner (EnCE)
    • Certified Computer Examiner (CCE)
    • Cellebrite Certified Mobile Examiner (CCME)
    • Other comparable digital forensic credentials
  • Experience working for a digital forensics consultancy, incident response firm, law-enforcement laboratory, corporate investigations team, or litigation-support organization.
  • Experience preparing expert reports, declarations, or affidavits.
  • Prior deposition, hearing, or trial-testimony experience.
  • Experience supporting attorneys in employment, trade-secret, intellectual-property, fraud, or other civil disputes.
  • Experience with mobile-device forensics.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, cloud storage, collaboration platforms, or cloud audit records.
  • Experience with forensic scripting, data processing, automation, or custom investigative workflows.
  • Experience mentoring junior examiners or reviewing the work of other forensic professionals.

Professional Qualities

  • Careful and methodical without allowing avoidable delays to affect the investigation.
  • Dependable in meeting deadlines and communicating case status.
  • Comfortable making independent technical decisions while recognizing when consultation is appropriate.
  • Precise in documentation, reporting, and evidence handling.
  • Capable of defending their methods and conclusions under professional or legal scrutiny.
  • Respectful of the limits of the available evidence.
  • Comfortable working in a growing firm where processes continue to be refined.
  • Interested in helping develop a high-quality forensic practice rather than only completing assigned technical tasks.
  • Professional and composed when communicating with attorneys, executives, opposing experts, and clients facing stressful situations.

Measures of Success

  • Independently progressing assigned forensic matters.
  • Producing accurate and defensible work with limited substantive revision.
  • Meeting agreed-upon deadlines and communicating risks early.
  • Maintaining complete case documentation and evidence records.
  • Providing clients and counsel with clear, useful explanations of forensic findings.
  • Exercising sound judgment concerning forensic conclusions and evidentiary limitations.
  • Contributing practical improvements to Cyber Centaurs’ examination, reporting, and quality-control processes.
  • Developing the credibility and case experience necessary to support expert-witness engagements where appropriate.

Work Arrangement and Travel

This position may be performed remotely within the United States. Periodic travel to Cyber Centaurs’ Orlando office, client locations, evidence-collection sites, depositions, hearings, or trials may be required.

Some investigations may require schedule flexibility due to court deadlines, urgent preservation needs, travel, or time-sensitive client matters.

Meaningful Investigative Work

  • Conduct substantive corporate, legal, and litigation-related investigations.

  • Work on matters involving insider threats, employee data theft, trade-secret theft, unauthorized access, fraud, and workplace misconduct.

Litigation and Expert Engagements

  • Support attorneys and clients in complex litigation, employment, trade-secret, intellectual-property, and other contested matters.

  • Prepare clear and defensible forensic reports, declarations, affidavits, timelines, and supporting exhibits.

  • Participate in attorney conferences, depositions, hearings, trials, and other expert engagements when required.

  • Apply existing testimony experience while continuing to expand professional credibility across complex forensic matters.

Culture

  • Join a small, focused, and high-performance team.

With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. Job Description:

Role Overview

The Director, Global Network & Systems Design (NSD) provides global technical, organizational and strategic leadership for the design, architecture, testing and delivery of network and systems solutions supporting Fluence’s utility-scale energy storage portfolio.

This role leads the Global NSD organization and is accountable for establishing the technical architecture, engineering requirements, global standards, and governance necessary to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and repeatable solutions across Fluence’s global project portfolio. The Director leads a team of senior technical experts, including Principal Engineers and Architects, and provides technical direction across complex IT/OT environments spanning network infrastructure, cybersecurity, SCADA, controls, cloud connectivity, system architecture, testing, and validation.

The Director partners closely with Product, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Project Delivery, Commissioning, Services, Sales, and regional Customer Success teams to translate customer, product, grid, and regional requirements into scalable global solutions.

Global NSD retains technical ownership through from design through commissioning.. Following commissioning, solutions transition to Services for 24x7 operational support, with Global NSD providing advanced technical escalation and leading redesign or architectural changes when required. In addition, Global NSD to support services fleet reliability and optimization process by providing documentation, developing training and supporting Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) development.

  • Key Responsibilities

Global Technical Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead the Global NSD organization, including Principal Engineers, Architects, and other senior technical resources supporting Fluence’s global project portfolio.
  • Establish and execute the long-term NSD technical strategy and roadmap in alignment with Fluence’s product strategy, Customer Success priorities, and business objectives.
  • Define clear technical ownership, decision rights, engineering governance, and escalation paths across the NSD lifecycle.
  • Build organizational capability and technical depth to support increasing project scale, complexity, and geographic expansion.
  • Develop senior technical talent and establish appropriate career pathways, succession planning, and capability development.
  • Establish resource and capacity planning practices that align specialized technical expertise with global project demand and business priorities.

Architecture, Standards & Governance

  • Own and govern global reference architectures, engineering standards, design principles, and technical requirements across network and IT/OT infrastructure.
  • Establish standardized approaches for secure network architecture, cybersecurity, SCADA and controls integration, cloud connectivity, testing, and system validation.
  • Ensure global standards appropriately address customer requirements, grid codes, cybersecurity requirements, regulatory obligations, and regional technical standards.
  • Drive reuse and standardization while establishing appropriate governance for customer- or project-specific design deviations.
  • Establish engineering quality gates and technical design reviews throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure architecture and engineering decisions support system reliability, maintainability, cybersecurity, scalability, and long-term serviceability.

Project Delivery & Commissioning

  • Provide global technical oversight of NSD solutions from requirements definition and architecture through engineering, delivery, testing, and commissioning.
  • Ensure technical requirements and designs are sufficiently defined before execution and appropriately governed throughout delivery.
  • Partner with regional project and commissioning organizations to resolve complex technical issues affecting schedule, quality, system performance, or customer acceptance.
  • Establish clear technical readiness and acceptance criteria for transition from project commissioning to operational support.
  • Ensure effective technical handoff to Services, including required architecture, configuration, documentation, and support information.
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex network and systems issues requiring architectural decisions, redesign, or specialized engineering intervention.

Service Transition & Lifecycle Support

  • Partner with Services to establish an effective process between Global NSD and the global 24x7 support organization.
  • Define escalation pathways and technical engagement models for issues requiring Global NSD expertise following operational handoff.
  • Lead or oversee network redesign and significant architectural changes arising from operational experience, customer requirements, product evolution, or cybersecurity needs.
  • Incorporate field and service experience into continuous improvement of global architectures, standards, engineering practices, and future project designs.

Cross-Functional & Global Partnership

  • Partner across Product, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Services, Project Delivery, Commissioning, Sales, and regional Customer Success organizations.
  • Translate regional and customer-specific requirements into scalable global technical solutions while minimizing unnecessary customization.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify recurring field requirements and influence product roadmap priorities.
  • Communicate complex technical risks, decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to senior technical and business leadership.
  • Support critical customer and project engagements where senior technical leadership is required.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in network engineering, systems architecture, IT/OT infrastructure, industrial controls, power systems, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing senior engineers, technical leaders, architects, or globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading architecture and engineering for complex, mission-critical industrial, energy, or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Strong technical expertise in industrial networking and IT/OT architectures, including network design, segmentation, routing, switching, firewalls, secure remote connectivity, and resilient/high-availability architectures.
  • Strong understanding of industrial cybersecurity principles and their application within critical infrastructure environments.
  • Experience with SCADA, PLCs, plant controls, industrial communication protocols, and integration of control systems within complex operating environments.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing technical standards, reference architectures, engineering governance, and design-review processes across multiple projects or regions.
  • Experience leading technical delivery through design, implementation, testing, commissioning, and transition to operations.
  • Strong understanding of system verification, validation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and structured testing methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical escalations and make sound decisions where system availability, cybersecurity, safety, schedule, or customer commitments may be at risk.
  • Experience operating effectively within a complex global matrix organization across multiple geographies, cultures, and time zones.

  • Experience building or scaling a global engineering Center of Excellence or specialized technical organization.
  • Experience establishing global engineering standards while accommodating regional grid, regulatory, customer, and cybersecurity requirements.

Our Culture

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy.
