Paralegal, Corporate & Regulatory Compliance

Location: Remote (U.S.) | Reports to: Senior Legal Operations Manager

About Midi Health


At Midi Health, we are redefining healthcare for women in midlife. Our virtual care model connects patients with specialized clinicians, and our growth depends on a legal foundation that is organized, accurate, and built to scale.

We are seeking a Paralegal, Corporate & Regulatory Compliance to support Midi’s legal team across regulatory filings, entity management, equity administration, and finance coordination. This role will help keep Midi and its affiliated professional entities in good standing across many states. It will administer our equity program and serve as a key liaison between Legal and Finance.

The ideal candidate is a detail-driven, proactive paralegal who brings structure to recurring deadlines, owns their work from intake to completion, and knows when to escalate to an attorney. This role works closely with the legal team, Finance, People, Clinical Operations, outside counsel, and service providers.

Key Responsibilities:


Regulatory Filings and Compliance Calendar

  • Prepare, file, and track state and federal regulatory filings for Midi and its affiliated professional entities, under attorney supervision.
  • Support state-level filings for professional entities, including formations, ownership and officer changes, and other required updates.
  • Help prepare and maintain healthcare regulatory applications, renewals, and supporting documentation, coordinating with Clinical Operations and licensing teams as needed.
  • Maintain a centralized compliance calendar of filing deadlines, renewals, annual reports, and other recurring obligations.
  • Research state filing requirements and procedures, and flag changes or issues for attorney review.
Entity Management and Registered Agent Oversight

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with Midi’s registered agent and oversee its services across all jurisdictions.
  • Receive, log, and route service of process, government notices, and other registered agent correspondence promptly to the appropriate attorney.
  • Maintain the good standing of all entities, including annual reports, franchise tax filings, foreign qualifications, amendments, and withdrawals.
  • Maintain corporate records, minute books, entity charts, officer and director lists, and the entity management system.
  • Prepare board and stockholder consents, secretary’s certificates, good standing certificates, and other governance documents.
  • Support board meetings by preparing materials, tracking approvals, collecting signatures, and maintaining records.
Equity Administration

  • Administer Midi’s equity program and maintain accurate capitalization records in Carta or a similar platform.
  • Prepare equity grant documents and board approvals, and process grants, exercises, cancellations, transfers, and terminations.
  • Track vesting, post-termination exercise periods, and 83(b) election documentation.
  • Coordinate with Finance and outside providers on 409A valuations and stock-based compensation reporting.
  • Monitor equity issuances for securities law compliance and state notice filings.
  • Respond to employee equity questions and escalate tax, securities, or plan interpretation questions to the appropriate attorney or advisor.
  • Support financings, secondary transactions, and other corporate matters by managing diligence requests, data rooms, signature packets, and closing documents.
Finance and Legal Liaison

  • Serve as the day-to-day liaison between Legal and Finance on entity, equity, audit, tax, and contract-related matters.
  • Coordinate franchise tax payments, filing fees, and registered agent invoices with Finance.
  • Help manage outside counsel and legal vendor invoices, budget tracking, and spend reporting.
  • Support audit requests, including legal confirmations, equity reconciliations, and corporate documentation.
  • Track and document intercompany agreements and payments between Midi and its affiliated professional entities, in coordination with Finance and Legal.
  • Help maintain contract records and key obligation trackers relevant to Finance, including payment terms, renewals, and notice deadlines.

About You


  • Excellent attention to detail: You know the importance of proofreading, accuracy, and consistency in filings, records, and communications.
  • A strong sense of urgency: You thrive in a fast-paced, demanding environment and never let a deadline slip.
  • A problem solver with sound judgment: You take ownership of questions sent your way, whether from Finance, an employee, or a service provider, and you understand when attorney escalation is needed.
  • An organized, proactive project manager: You can manage many recurring obligations across multiple entities and jurisdictions, and you build frameworks to execute them reliably.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: You write clear issue summaries and explain processes simply to non-lawyers.
  • Curious and eager to learn: You believe technology can make legal work better and help the team serve the business.
  • Confident with people at all levels: You work comfortably with executives, finance leaders, clinicians, employees, and outside advisors.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You ask thoughtful questions and focus on details while understanding the legal team’s broader priorities.
  • Discreet: You handle confidential corporate, equity, and personnel information with professionalism.

Experience & Qualifications


  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a corporate paralegal at a law firm, in-house legal department, or both.
  • Hands-on experience with entity management across multiple states, including annual reports, foreign qualifications, and registered agent coordination.
  • Hands-on equity administration experience using Carta, Shareworks, or a similar platform.
  • Experience working with Finance on audits, tax filings, equity reporting, or legal spend.
  • Healthcare, digital health, or other regulated-industry experience is a strong plus, particularly with professional entities or healthcare licensing filings.
  • Experience at a venture-backed or high-growth company is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree or paralegal certificate preferred.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, Slack, and e-signature platforms.
  • Comfort with entity management systems, CLM tools, and AI tools is a strong plus.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $135,000 annually. Final compensation will depend on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible for equity and benefits.

Why Join Midi?


At Midi, you will help build the legal infrastructure that allows specialized midlife healthcare to reach more women. You will work with a mission-driven team that values accuracy, ownership, and practical problem solving.

Midi’s benefits currently include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), flexible paid time off, parental leave, a new-hire equipment stipend, and a monthly remote-work stipend.

Senior Grants Associate Job Announcement

Heartland Fund is seeking a Senior Grants Associate. For a thoughtful, mission-driven professional, this position is an exciting opportunity to support new systems and processes in a rapidly growing multi-entity grantmaking organization and ever changing compliance environment.

Heartland Fund’s Senior Grants Associate supports the organization’s day-to-day grants management processes, with a focus on facilitating the full grants lifecycle, maintaining accurate records and documentation, supporting grants management system use, and helping ensure compliance across grantmaking activities. This role helps ensure grantmaking processes run smoothly, staff and grantees receive timely and effective support, and the grants management process reflects our organizational values. The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to manage multiple responsibilities while supporting both day-to-day execution and ongoing process improvement.

You will have an opportunity to help us enable equitable investment in rural communities, democracy, and climate solutions. This is a unique and dynamic position with opportunities for growth and impact as the Heartland Fund prepares to launch as an independent entity in 2027.

This is a remote position with a starting salary range of $75,650 - $89,000. The position includes a generous benefits package.

About the Organization

As a funder collaborative, the Heartland Fund scales investment, supports local leaders, and builds long-term partnerships with rural and Native organizations to create thriving places where rural working people can determine our own futures, strengthening the entire nation. Heartland's grantmaking and programmatic investments support rural people working to transform their lives and communities toward shared prosperity, a healthy climate, and stronger democracy. We invest in building local capacity for issue advocacy, community organizing, economic development and local jobs, climate solutions, civic engagement, and sustainable urban-rural coalitions. We prioritize racial justice in all aspects of our work. In addition to grantmaking, Heartland also supports rural leaders and organizations through convening, research, and communications and storytelling.

Heartland Fund has three programs:

  • Rural Democracy expands nonpartisan civic participation and counters policies that harm our democratic institutions in places where rural action can define policy and democratic outcomes.

  • Resource Rural (RR) mobilizes resources enabling rural communities to unlock public and private investment to create positive economic change in their communities.

  • Rural Climate Partnership (RCP) supports hometowns across America to accelerate climate solutions and build healthy local economies.

Both RR and RCP programs help rural communities access public funding – through place-based technical assistance, local organizing, and a large-scale communications and narrative effort – to make a tangible difference in rural people’s lives and to advance climate mitigation and resilience.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Grants Associate works closely with program staff, grantees, and internal partners to support effective, compliant, and efficient grants management. This role is responsible for facilitating the full grants management lifecycle, maintaining accurate documentation and system records, supporting staff and grantees in the grants management system, and helping strengthen grantmaking processes and practices across the organization. The Senior Grants Associate reports to the Grants Management Officer.

Grants Administration & Compliance

  • Facilitate the full grants management lifecycle and drive all aspects of pre- and post-award grant activities.

    • Determine grantee organization eligibility and conduct due diligence on grant proposals.

    • Draft grant agreement letters and help ensure grant files are complete and up to date.

    • Track, review and follow up on narrative and financial reports and maintain other grantee related documentation.

  • Confirm that grant status is accurately recorded in the grants management system (GMS), with necessary documentation and programmatic tagging.

  • Coordinate with the Finance team to execute grantee payments and provide data for reporting.

  • Coordinate with the Operations team, to help ensure legal and regulatory compliance.

Grants Management Systems Support & Process Improvement

  • Serve as a guide in grants management processes and procedures, facilitating engagement and adoption of streamlined practices across the organization and identifying ways to further adopt trust-based grantmaking and learning practices.

  • Help ensure the grants management system supports programmatic decision-making, budgets, learning, and grantmaking processes.

  • Serve as GMS technical support resource.

Training, Collaboration & Team Support

  • Support training and knowledge sharing for program teams, ranging from forecasting and pipeline development, to data analysis, to compliance.

  • In partnership with the Grants Management Officer and team members, develop and implement new approaches to executing grantmaking strategies.

  • Provide mentorship across teams and support consistent, effective grants management and data governance practices.

  • Work with teams across the organization to prepare board, committee, and strategic partnerships materials, as needed.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented professional with at least five years of experience in grants management, who brings strong project management skills and comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder workflows. They can balance both day-to-day execution and ongoing process improvement.

Heartland Fund’s growing team takes pride in building an organizational culture rooted in learning, collaboration, racial justice, and a deep commitment to our mission. All staff are expected to provide leadership and vision to advance our mission, vision, and core strategies.

Qualifications

We realize that some great candidates may not have every single thing on this list. If you believe you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply.

Essential

  • Minimum of four years of experience in the social sector, nonprofit, and/or mission-driven organization
  • Knowledge of or experience with grants management, including grants management systems (Fluxx Preferred) and processes
  • Advanced proficiency with technology platforms including Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Drive) and video conferencing platforms (Zoom, etc.)
  • Understanding of or ability to quickly learn the financial and regulatory environment for nonprofit and philanthropic entities
  • Commitment to racial justice and equity
  • Exceptional project management skills, and experience developing and completing complex projects
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and analytical thinking
  • Highly collaborative with a partnership mindset
  • Entrepreneurial and resourceful, a proactive and creative problem-solver

Desired

  • Experience working in a philanthropic, fiscal sponsor, nonprofit intermediary, funder collaborative and/or other type of grantmaking organization

  • Experience in a 501c3 and 501c4 multi entity organization or campaigns, including knowledge of lobbying and/or political activity compliance requirements applicable to charitable, advocacy, and/or social welfare organizations

  • Experience providing training and user support for grants management systems (Fluxx Preferred)

  • Demonstrated experience working effectively with colleagues of diverse backgrounds and perspectives:

    • Appreciation of the diverse cultural tradition of rural peoples.

    • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.

    • Comfort working with a range of individuals in nonproﬁt organizations, government, foundations, and private sectors.

  • Working proficiency of a second language that is spoken in rural America

  • Experience living and/or working in rural America is strongly preferred

Compensation & Job Design

This is a full-time, exempt position. The organization is virtual, and the position may work remotely from their home within the United States. The starting salary range is $75,650 - $89,000.

The comprehensive beneﬁts package includes 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance for employees (and their families). Employees are able to enroll in a 401k retirement plan and are eligible for a 3% automatic contribution and up to a 3% employer match on 401k contributions. Employees are also eligible for pre-tax transportation beneﬁts. Full-time employees will receive 120 hours of vacation time, 80 hours of health leave, up to 2 days of casual leave, and 20 hours of volunteer leave annually. Employees will also receive 13 paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Employees are eligible for 12 weeks of paid family and medical leave after 90 days of employment. All employees of Windward are required to complete timesheets.

Heartland Fund is a project of Windward Fund, a 501(c)(3) public charity that incubates new and innovative public-interest projects and grant-making programs. Windward Fund is committed to attracting, developing and retaining exceptional people, and to creating a work environment that is dynamic, rewarding and enables each of us to realize our potential.

Windward Fund’s work environment is safe and open to all employees and partners, respecting the full spectrum of race, color, religious creed, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, political afﬁliation, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and all other classiﬁcations protected by law in the locality and/or state in which you are working.

The individual holding this position will also work part-time for a coordinated project, Rural Victory Fund, in Sixteen Thirty Fund, a 501(c)(4) organization, under a resource-sharing agreement between Windward Fund and Sixteen Thirty Fund. The responsibilities under that position will be overseen by Sixteen Thirty Fund.

Windward participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with employees’ Form I-9 information to conﬁrm authorization to work in the United States. Job candidates and employees authorized to work may not be discriminated against on the basis of national origin or citizenship status.

Travel Requirements

This position requires occasional travel within the United States.

How to Apply

Applications will be reviewed and considered on a rolling basis. A limited number of screening calls and interview spots will be filled starting in October 2026, with a desired start date by December 2026. Early applications are strongly encouraged.

Position available remotely within EU

We are looking for an experienced, motivated Freelance Backend Software Engineerwho will work closely with their Backend colleagues, as well as support our product teams. As a flexible and open-minded person with a passion for clean code you will be a perfect addition to our team. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to code reviews, test coverage, quality days and CI/CD principles.

If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you!

Essential skills for this mission:

  • You enjoy developing clean, stable, testable and performant backend code, serving our beautiful mobile applications

  • You have at least 3 years of experience working as a Software Engineer

  • You have at least 2 years of full-time experience as a Backend Engineer

  • You love working in and supporting an interdisciplinary team, together with architects, frontend engineers, QAs, and product owners

  • You are passionate about solid technical design, clean code and future-proof architectures

  • You are familiar with Java 17+ and frameworks like Spring 5, Hibernate, or JAX-RS

  • You have experience with SQL and relational databases like PostgreSQL

  • You have experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or any other cloud provider

  • You want to learn new technologies and are able to adopt them quickly

  • Great written and verbal communication in English

  • You are either an EU citizen or hold a valid Austrian work permit

Bonus skills:

  • Experience with medical, security, and privacy regulations

  • Knowledge of the diabetes industry or other comparable health industries

  • Experience working in agile environments

Here's what you can expect from us:

  • Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products

  • An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams

You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits. You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of health care systems around the world. Additionally, you may explore other roles related to software development, such as Product Owner or Scrum Master within our interdisciplinary team structure.

Who we are and what we care about?

We are committed to providing a healthy, equal and inclusive working environment for our employees to bring true relief to the patient! We care about family friendly career paths, sustainability, a healthy lifestyle and the flexibility of a modern workplace. We maintain a culture of learning and sharing, as well as open and candid feedback. At every level, there are many opportunities to develop and grow - both professionally and personally.

As a healthcare pioneer committed to transforming the lives of billions of people around the globe, we push boundaries to redefine what is possible. We know that early, accurate diagnosis is essential to maintain health, prevent disease and help advance new, targeted treatments and potential cures for the world’s most serious health problems. We have a passion for innovation and a profound commitment to make a lasting impact on society by continuing to improve the standard of care for humankind. Our culture inspires us to create healthcare that is sustainable, efficient and financially viable. Healthcare that is built on people’s needs, strong data and clinical insights. Healthcare that saves lives.

Marketing Operations & Communications Manager

About sMedia

sMedia is a digital advertising and SEO provider specializing in helping automotive dealerships boost their sales, maximize marketing efficiencies, and grow their market share. We integrate advanced technology with hands-on support to deliver dynamic, inventory-specific advertising solutions tailored exclusively to each dealership's needs.

We ground our partnerships in data, real results, and our core values: Growth, Reliability, Transparency, and Curiosity. We are looking for an accountable, strategic team member who is passionate about digital advertising and automotive retail, and who thrives on building trusting, long-term industry relationships that drive growth for everyone.

Role Overview

The Marketing Operations & Communication Manager serves as the architect and builder for sMedia’s B2B marketing engine. This role is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of relationship-driven content and growth-enablement assets, ensuring that every touchpoint in the prospect and partner journey reinforces sMedia’s position as a definitive thought leader in automotive digital marketing.

This position bridges strategic planning with hands-on technical execution. Working closely with executive leadership, you will translate the corporate roadmap into highly accurate product collateral, email marketing campaigns, educational webinars, and web content. A critical demand of this role is absolute precision: ensuring all messaging adheres strictly to sMedia's brand voice guidelines and that all product descriptions reflect our exact technical mechanics. By leveraging comprehensive CRM analytics and website performance data, you will continuously optimize campaign performance to fuel our sales engine without requiring extensive managerial oversight.

  • Reporting to: Head of Growth
  • Key Collaboration Partners: Manager of Customer Growth, Market Development Lead, and Customer Success Teams.

Your Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

1. Campaign Implementation & Execution (40% Focus)

  • Directly support the Market Development Lead by architecting relationship-driven content that builds trust with high-value prospects. This includes building, launching, and managing B2B marketing campaigns across email networks, HubSpot workflows, sMedia web properties, and corporate social channels, ensuring every asset facilitates a consultative sales approach.
  • Provide Customer Success teams with high-impact growth-enablement assets and automated nurture workflows designed to deepen existing dealership relationships and identify expansion opportunities within the current partner base.
  • Work with the Market Development Lead to draft, structure, and finalize authoritative webinar presentations and slide decks that focus on tangible dealer benefits, such as optimizing inventory turn rates to save on floor plan interest costs.
  • Organize, upload, and track all multi-departmental marketing requests inside Asana and Google Drive, ensuring cross-functional marketing initiatives launch on time and error-free.

2. Analytical Optimization & Performance Review (35% Focus)

  • Monitor and evaluate HubSpot email performance analytics, tracking delivery rates, engagement metrics, and workflow efficiency to continuously optimize messaging.
  • Routinely analyze website traffic patterns and conversion funnels using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to evaluate the health of marketing acquisition channels.
  • Draw actionable conclusions from dealership data and competitive market analysis, transforming raw metrics into clear, localized performance benchmarks to leverage across social media, blogs, newsletters, etc.

3. Brand Voice Protection & Product Accuracy (25% Focus)

  • Serve as the primary gatekeeper for the sMedia brand voice. Ensure all deployed content is direct, conversational, and authoritative, entirely free of marketing exaggerations, absolute statements (e.g., "always," "never"), or cliché automotive puns.
  • Maintain a flawless, 100% accurate understanding of sMedia’s product mechanics, proprietary features, and pricing tiers. Ensure public-facing copy correctly details how our tools operate.
  • Script, refine, and maintain the organization’s internal resource hub, newsletters, and educational case studies, simplifying complex digital concepts for dealers without sacrificing corporate credibility.

Your Background

  • 8+ years of dedicated experience managing B2B digital marketing campaigns, content deployment, and performance execution workflows.
  • 5+ years of direct automotive retail or agency experience. You must thoroughly understand dealership operations, OEM mandates, variables affecting vehicle turn, and the financial relationship between marketing spend and floor plan costs.
  • Proficient experience navigating Google Analytics (GA4) dashboards, CRM (HubSpot) marketing automation, Canva, and Asana project management software.
  • Complete fluency in reading, writing, and speaking professional English with a mastery of business communication standards.

Your Skills and Mindset

  • A driven self-starter who thrives with minimal oversight, taking complete personal accountability for the flawless execution of tasks within established operating guidelines.
  • Highly structured, detail-oriented personality focused on data over vanity metrics, possesses a continuous learning mindset to constantly identify process efficiencies.
  • A gifted translator able to take complex data anomalies, proprietary software scripts, or algorithmic features and translate them into simple, benefit-focused business solutions.
  • Intolerant of low-tier sales copy or vague buzzwords. Passionate about upholding corporate voice alignment and verifying the technical accuracy of corporate publications before deployment.
  • Confident collaborator capable of building positive, professional relationships across Customer Success, Sales, Ad Operations, and executive leadership teams.

Performance Measures & KPIs

  • Achieving a state of content execution where 95% of public-facing communications (blogs, social posts, email campaigns) require zero structural or stylistic revisions by executive leadership prior to deployment.

Description

Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection. At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth.

We are looking for a Security Engineer to join our MDR team as the founding Australia member of the Security organization. In this role, you will be part of our security function, focusing on proactive reviews and providing advanced guidance to customers, while independently owning AUS hours coverage. This is an opportunity to bring deep cloud security expertise to a fast-growing team, working closely with analysts, researchers, and engineers — with a clear path toward technical or team leadership as the AUS presence scales.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in fine-tuning Upwind's detection and response mechanisms.
  • Support proactive reviews of customer environments to identify risks, exposed attack surfaces, and recommend improvements.

  • Own the handling of complex or critical incidents escalated from Tier 1/2, including live, high-pressure engagements with customers.

  • Stay up to date with emerging threats, attack techniques, attack surfaces, and best practices in cloud security.
  • Contribute to the development and training of AI-driven detection models, leveraging machine learning to improve investigation accuracy and response efficiency.

Requirements

  • This role includes participating in a shared on-call rotation. While escalations are infrequent, team members are expected to be available for nights, weekends, or holidays during their rotation week.
  • Solid, hands-on experience in cybersecurity, ideally from a leading cloud or cloud security company, with real-world exposure to cloud environments.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to engage directly with customers — including staying composed under pressure or pushback.
  • Self-directed and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment.
  • Curiosity, problem-solving mindset, and a genuine personal interest in security beyond the day job.
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science / Information Security — an advantage.

jobs.description:
About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

Hiring Process

    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
    First Stage
    Portfolio & Design Leadership
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage
    Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership
    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

Data Process Policy

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.

jobs.excerpt: At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future.
jobs.description:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care,a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

Role Overview

As our Staff Application Security Engineer, you will be the primary owner and driver of our application security program. You'll work hands-on with engineering teams to embed secure development practices, improve tooling and automation, and guide security considerations for new features, architectures, and services.

This is a high-impact role where you'll shape the future of AppSec at a company that values security as a core part of product quality.

What You'll Do

Application Security Ownership

  • Lead and evolve the company's application security strategy, roadmap, and day-to-day operations.
  • Serve as the primary AppSec partner for numerous dev teams working on Ruby on Rails web apps, React Native mobile apps, and various other projects including Python and Go.
  • Provide security guidance during design, development, and code review for new features and projects.
  • Drive adoption of secure coding practices and threat-modeling across engineering teams.

Tooling & Automation

  • Manage and optimize existing AppSec tooling, including:
  • GitHub Advanced Security (SAST, SCA, Secret Scanning)
  • Invicti (DAST)
  • Hadrian (ASM)
  • AppDome (mobile application security)
  • Cloudflare WAF
  • Improve automation and integration of security tools into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify and implement additional tools or processes to strengthen the security posture.

Secure SDLC & Developer Enablement

  • Build and maintain secure development standards, playbooks, and training materials.
  • Partner with engineering teams during sprint planning and feature design to proactively address risks.
  • Conduct security reviews, code assessments, and vulnerability triage with development teams.

Cloud & DevOps Collaboration

  • Work with DevOps to ensure secure AWS infrastructure deployments and configurations.
  • Contribute to hardening efforts across ECS, IAM, networking, and supporting cloud services.
  • Assist in designing and maintaining secure CI/CD workflows.

Incident & Vulnerability Management

  • Lead or support investigation and remediation of application-level vulnerabilities.
  • Monitor, prioritize, and track findings from SAST/DAST/ASM tools.
  • Collaborate with engineering to ensure timely and effective remediation.

What We're Looking For

Required Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in Application Security, Product Security, or related engineering roles.
  • Strong understanding of secure coding practices, common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), and modern SDLC.
  • Experience working with cloud-native applications, ideally in AWS.
  • Understanding of SSL certificates & cryptographic key management.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, WAFs, and/or mobile application security tools.
  • Ability to partner effectively with developers and influence secure design decisions.
  • Familiarity with GitHub-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

Nice to Have

  • Development experience with Ruby on Rails or similar dynamic languages.
  • Knowledge of AWS ECS/EKS, container security, secrets management and infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, Terraform).
  • Experience building or maturing an AppSec program from early stages.
  • SOAR Automation & Scripting experience.
  • Experience working in a PCI-compliant environment working with annual reporting needs.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate measures success by reduced risk, not tickets closed, and reaches for secure design and simple guardrails before another scanner or gate. They think like an attacker but bring a developer mindset to their partnership with engineering, connecting the dots across application code, cloud infrastructure, and the pipeline rather than treating each as a separate domain. Engineers trust their technical judgment beyond the systems they personally own: they catch a bad design before it ships even when it isn't theirs, and they see a blocker coming early enough to design around it instead of just navigating it well after the fact.

The base annual salary range is listed below. This role is eligible for additional incentives, including an annual bonus.

Base Salary Range
$160,000—$195,000 USD

Why Join Us?

While you make a difference for others, we’ll work to make a difference for you, providing an uplifting, collaborative work environment and benefits that reflect your value to us. For eligible full-time employees, we offer:

  • Considerable employer contributions for health, dental, and vision programs
  • Generous PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave
  • 401(k) matching program
  • Merit advancement opportunities
  • Career development & training

And finally, our team spirit and culture! We cultivate an environment of community, connection, and belonging across our entire organization.

No fee will be paid to their parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to Beyond Finance employees or the Beyond Finance HR team. No placement fee will be paid to any third party unless such a request has been made by the Beyond HR team.

jobs.title: Go-To-Market Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About ImprovadoImprovado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.
jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is hiring a Go-to-Market Engineer to build and run the engine that generates sales pipeline, then step into deals to help close them. You report directly to the VP of Sales.

This is a team-of-one role with no SDR layer behind you. You own outbound cadences, the data and tooling stack, and event follow-up. You work directly with the VP of Sales to design and run go-to-market experiments, on Improvado wherever possible, and you work alongside the demand generation team so outbound and advertising hit the same accounts and people. You identify which current customers to expand and with which products. And you are forward deployed: embedded with prospects and customers, building working use cases in their environment, and packaging the experiments that worked in-house into outcome-based projects Improvado sells.

It is a hybrid of growth operator, forward deployed builder, and revenue strategist. The long-term path is to become an Improvado expert who builds agentic go-to-market loops with the platform at their core, first for us, then for our customers. If you have only done one of those jobs, this is not the role. If you have done two and are hungry for the rest, keep reading.

What you'll do

Outbound pipeline generation

  • Design, build, and run multi-channel outbound cadences (email, LinkedIn, phone) targeting enterprise marketing and data leaders and agency executives.
  • Write and continuously test messaging, subject lines, and personalization at scale, including AI-assisted personalization.
  • Own deliverability, sending infrastructure, and domain health.

Sales and marketing alignment

  • Work with the demand generation team so outbound and advertising target the same accounts, personas, and buying committees, with one shared target account list.
  • Build the operating rhythm between sales and marketing: shared definitions, a common view of account engagement, and a feedback loop from deals back into campaigns.
  • Partner with marketing on content and offers; own the sourced-pipeline number on the outbound side.

Go-to-market experimentation with the VP of Sales

  • Design and run go-to-market experiments with the VP of Sales: messaging by buyer persona, channels, offers, signals, and workflows, each with a hypothesis, a measurement, and a scale-or-kill decision.
  • Run them on Improvado wherever possible, so our own go-to-market is the lab for what we sell.
  • Maintain a messaging playbook per persona that outbound, advertising, and account executives all draw from, and share results with marketing on a regular cadence.

Customer expansion

  • Analyze the customer base to identify which accounts we should be upselling and which Improvado products fit each.
  • Build expansion plays with Customer Success and account executives, and run the outbound layer of those plays.

Tooling and data

  • Own the go-to-market tech stack: sequencing, enrichment, intent data, CRM hygiene, and the integrations between them.
  • Build and maintain target account lists and contact data with enrichment waterfalls and signal-based triggers.
  • Automate the repetitive parts of prospecting so one person operates like a team.

Event follow-up

  • Run pre-event targeting and outreach for conferences and field events.
  • Convert attendees, booth visitors, and scanned leads into qualified meetings within days, not weeks.

Forward deployed with prospects and customers

  • Learn the Improvado platform deeply: connectors, data models, the AI agent, and dashboards.
  • Embed with prospects and customers on active opportunities and expansions to build working go-to-market and marketing-data use cases in their environment. Ship something they use, not a demo.
  • Carry what you learn in customer environments back into our own experiments, outbound targeting, and messaging.

Package and sell what works

  • Turn successful in-house experiments into packaged, outcome-based projects that Improvado sells to customers: the outcome, the data required, the build, and the delivery path.
  • Help account executives position and scope those projects as part of the Improvado offer, and deliver the first ones yourself.

Measurement

  • Track pipeline sourced and influenced by channel, cost per qualified meeting, and conversion through each stage.
  • Report daily to the VP of Sales and kill what is not working quickly.

Who you are

  • 4 or more years in a pipeline-generating or growth role at a B2B SaaS company: outbound, demand generation, growth, revenue operations, or forward deployed / implementation work, ideally more than one of these.
  • You have personally built outbound cadences that booked meetings with enterprise buyers, and you can show the numbers.
  • You have designed and run structured go-to-market experiments with a clear hypothesis and measurement, and you can tell the story of one that worked and one you killed.
  • You have taken something that worked internally and turned it into something a customer paid for.
  • You have worked across the sales and marketing boundary and know what it takes to get both teams targeting the same accounts.
  • Technical enough to work with APIs, webhooks, SQL, and data pipelines, and to build on a data platform inside a customer's environment.
  • Fluent with AI tools for research, personalization, and automation, and interested in building agents, not just using them.
  • Comfortable being a team of one: you set your own priorities, build your own systems, and do not wait for an SDR or an ops team.
  • Strong writer. Your emails get replies.
  • Curious about marketing data and analytics: you want to understand how a CMO measures performance, not just who to email.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling or marketing to agencies or enterprise marketing teams.
  • Background in marketing analytics, ETL, data warehousing, or business intelligence.
  • Forward-deployed, implementation, or professional services experience at a data or AI company.
  • Experience with customer expansion or account-based programs.
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents or automated workflows with LLMs.
  • Experience running pre- and post-event programs for conferences.
  • Early-stage startup experience, Series A to C.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Medical and dental benefits
  • 401K plan
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid holidays
  • Professional development reimbursement

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.
jobs.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release alongside product, design, backend, and QA.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).
  • Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You prefer strict role boundaries and don't want to occasionally cross into a SQL query, a backend endpoint, or the API layer to unblock yourself.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.
  • Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
  • Full overlap with CET working hours.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

﻿Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Description

Who We're Looking For - The Dream Maker

We’re looking for a hands-on Billing & Collection Manager to lead our Billing & Collections team and own the function end to end.

You’ll be responsible for both team performance and operational results—ensuring customers are billed accurately and on time, payments are collected and reconciled, and outstanding balances are handled proactively. You’ll set priorities, establish clear processes, coach team members, and step into the details when a complex billing or collection issue needs to be resolved.

This role sits at the center of Finance, Sales, and Customer Success, combining people leadership, financial accuracy, direct customer communication, reporting, and process improvement. We’re looking for someone who notices when the numbers don’t add up, creates clarity for the team, and takes ownership of resolving the issue.

About Chargeflow

Chargeflow is a leading force in fintech innovation, tackling chargeback fraud and the impact it has on online businesses. Born from a deep passion for technology and eCommerce, we’ve developed an AI-driven solution that helps merchants manage credit card disputes, recover lost revenue, and protect their businesses through a unique success-based model.

Backed by $49M from Viola Growth, OpenView, Sequoia Capital, and other top-tier global investors, Chargeflow is on a product-led growth journey. We’re a tight-knit team of passionate builders and entrepreneurs, united by our mission to revolutionize eCommerce and protect online businesses from chargeback fraud.

What You’ll Own

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Billing & Collections team, creating clear expectations, accountability, and opportunities for growth.
  • Set team priorities, allocate work, monitor performance, and ensure consistent execution against billing and collection targets.
  • Establish effective team workflows, quality standards, escalation paths, and operating procedures.
  • Manage the end-to-end billing cycle, from generating and distributing invoices to verifying pricing, billing terms, and contract compliance.
  • Own accounts receivable and cash reconciliation, ensuring accurate and complete financial records.
  • Monitor outstanding balances and aging reports, guiding the team in taking proactive action to reduce overdue payments and bad debt.
  • Support the team in complex or sensitive customer conversations and personally manage escalations when needed.
  • Assess bad-debt risk and define the appropriate approach for long-term outstanding invoices.
  • Perform periodic reviews and reconciliations to support accurate revenue recognition.
  • Support weekly and month-end cash-flow forecasting.
  • Build and maintain reports on billing and collection performance, team KPIs, risks, and trends.
  • Use performance data to identify gaps, coach the team, and improve operational results.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen controls, optimize revenue collection, automate manual work, and scale the function.
  • Build strong relationships with key customers, understand their billing requirements, and address issues before they escalate.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Sales, and Customer Success to resolve discrepancies and create a smooth customer experience.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in billing, collections, accounts receivable, or a related financial operations role.
  • Proven people-management experience leading, coaching, and developing a Billing, Collections, Accounts Receivable, or Finance Operations team.
  • Experience setting team priorities, monitoring performance, managing workloads, and holding people accountable for results.
  • A hands-on management style and the willingness to step into operational details and customer escalations when needed.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of billing processes, collection strategies, account reconciliation, and accounting principles.
  • Experience working with billing platforms, CRM systems, and tools such as Stripe, Shopify, HubSpot, or similar.
  • Previous experience in fintech, payments, or payment processing.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn financial and team-performance data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Excellent English and strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • The confidence and judgment to handle sensitive customer and employee conversations professionally and assertively.
  • High attention to detail, accountability, adaptability, and the ability to lead effectively in a fast-moving environment.

Nice to Have

  • An MBA or another advanced qualification in Finance, Accounting, or Business.
  • Experience leading billing and collections for a global SaaS business.
  • Experience managing a remote or distributed finance operations team.
  • Experience improving or automating billing and collection workflows.

How We Work

We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and expect managers to take ownership of both their team and their function. Our managers create clarity, develop their people, and remain close enough to the work to recognize risks and step in when necessary.

We care about accuracy, but we also look beyond the immediate task to understand how the team, process, and systems can work better at scale.

This is a remote, full-time role based in the Philippines.

If you’re looking for a hands-on leadership role where you can build a strong team and take real ownership of a critical financial function, we’d love to hear from you.

Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release alongside product, design, backend, and QA.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).
  • Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You prefer strict role boundaries and don't want to occasionally cross into a SQL query, a backend endpoint, or the API layer to unblock yourself.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.

  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
  • Full overlap with CET working hours.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

What we offer

  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

Overview

WE ARE HIRING A FULL-TIME 100% REMOTE

CONTRACT GRANT WRITER!

The Grant Writer (6-9 months, possible contract to hire) will identify funding opportunities, coordinate the collection of required data and supporting materials, and prepare high-quality grant applications that align with organizational priorities and funding requirements. The Grant Writer will collaborate with internal departments, facility leaders, subject matter experts, finance teams, and operational stakeholders to gather information, develop proposal content, and ensure timely submission of competitive grant applications. This position operates independently while maintaining regular communication with the grants team and key stakeholders throughout the grant development process and serves as a liaison with external funders and community partners as needed to support successful funding outcomes. Experience with federal grant programs, such as Rural Health Transformation and State Opioid Response (SAMHSA), as well as local, state, and county procurements highly preferred. Experience in the behavioral health and substance use disorder treatment fields, including MAT, also preferred.

Our Passion:

We exist to Lead Care With Light. We need passionate, talented people working together who share our desire to provide the best quality care to our patients and lead the fight against the opioid epidemic. We are prepared to treat the entire disease, not just a piece of it.

Our Network That Serves Nationwide:

Acadia Healthcare's Comprehensive Treatment Centers (CTC) division operates 170+ CARF-accredited outpatient opioid treatment programs (OTPs) nationwide, serving patients undergoing treatment for opioid use disorder (OUD). As the leading provider of medication-assisted treatment (MAT) in the nation, we care for more than 74,000 patients daily. Our mission is to deliver comprehensive care, combining therapies with safe and effective medications. Our team stands at the forefront of the battle against the opioid epidemic.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Research, identify, and evaluate federal, state, and local funding opportunities that align with organizational priorities and program needs.

  • Bachelor's degree required; graduate degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional grant writing experience, preferably within healthcare, behavioral health, substance use treatment, nonprofit, or related sectors.

jobs.description:
The Senior People Operations Analyst will join Dorado Software Group as the operational lead for HR systems, data integrity, and global payroll coordination. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract to support our People function across NedGraphics and Optitex (18 countries: North America, South America, EMEA, Middle East, India, APAC). You'll report to the Director of People Operations.
This role requires someone who proactively identifies and flags data issues, process gaps, and compliance risks before they escalate. You will be the single point of accountability for BambooHR data accuracy, multi-jurisdiction payroll coordination, and onboarding/offboarding execution. The previous analyst in this role was let go after not proactively flagging data integrity issues; this role succeeds by catching problems early and escalating thoughtfully.

Why This Contract Is 12 Months
This role is backfilling for a strategic People Operations rebuild. We need an experienced analyst to stabilize our HRIS and payroll operations, document all processes, and set up the infrastructure for scaling. After 12 months, we'll evaluate next steps based on business needs and your interest.

This is a real operational role, not a stepping stone. We're looking for someone committed to leaving the function stronger and more documented than they found it.

Key Responsibilities

HRIS Administration and Data Integrity
  • Maintain all employee data in BambooHR with accuracy, including new hires, terminations, status changes, compensation updates, and reporting structure changes.
  • Conduct regular data audits to identify and correct inconsistencies, duplicates, and gaps; consolidate employee information from scattered sources into BambooHR as the single source of truth.
  • Ensure accurate data flows between BambooHR, Pinpoint (ATS), and Lattice (performance); maintain employee files in compliance with applicable regulations.
  • Handle all employee data in accordance with applicable privacy legislation across jurisdictions, including applicable Canadian and US state privacy laws, and international equivalents; ensure personal data is collected, stored, and processed lawfully and with appropriate access controls.
  • Identify process inefficiencies that create data risk (e.g., manual data entry steps, system gaps, spreadsheet workarounds) and propose fixes.
Payroll and Benefits Coordination
  • Execute payroll coordination across all jurisdictions by following established processes - preparing and submitting people data to Finance, third-party payroll providers, and employer of record (EOR) partners across North America, South America, EMEA, the Middle East, India, and APAC (new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, and stipends)
  • Reconcile against BambooHR records and flag discrepancies to the Director for resolution
  • Serve as the first point of contact for routine employee payroll and benefits questions, escalating anything outside standard parameters
Onboarding and Offboarding
  • Execute end-to-end onboarding for all new hires, including system setup, background checks, benefits enrollment, orientation scheduling, and equipment coordination with IT
  • Process employee terminations, including system updates, final pay calculations, applicable federal and provincial/state separation requirements, and exit logistics
  • Maintain and track onboarding plans with hiring managers; continuously improve onboarding and offboarding checklists based on feedback
Recruitment Administration
  • Administer Pinpoint ATS, including job postings, candidate pipeline management, interview scheduling, and coordination with hiring managers and external recruiters
  • Send offer letters and process pre-hire documentation; maintain recruitment dashboards and report on pipeline metrics including time-to-fill, source effectiveness, and candidate volume
Compensation Data Support
  • Maintain compensation data in auditable spreadsheets and systems; support the Director during annual compensation and performance review cycles with data, reporting, and administrative execution
AI Tools and Process Automation
  • Use AI-powered tools and agents to streamline repetitive HR tasks such as data validation, document drafting, employee query triage, and report generation
  • Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements, leveraging AI automation, system features, formulas, and workflow tools to reduce manual effort
  • Support the Director in evaluating and rolling out new AI tools within the People technology stack
Process Documentation and Improvement
  • Document all repeatable HR processes as clear, step-by-step SOPs; maintain the internal HR knowledge base so that processes are not dependent on any single person
Reporting and Dashboards
  • Build and maintain reporting dashboards in Excel, BambooHR, and other tools covering headcount, turnover, time-to-fill, and compensation distribution; prepare ad hoc reports for leadership as requested
  • Use AI-assisted analytics and visualization tools to improve the speed and quality of people reporting
Travel
  • Travel to offices in other international locations to provide HR support as necessary or to attend events

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

REQUIRED:
  • 6+ years of hands-on HRIS administration and payroll coordination experience.
  • Direct, recent experience with BambooHR.

  • Confirmed availability for a 12-month fixed-term contract.
STRONGLY PREFERRED:
