jobs.description:
Description

Creative Producer(In-House)

Remote (US) · Full-time

﻿

Cybersecurity is one of the most cinematic industries on earth. Hackers get movies made about them. Heists, hoodies, red rooms, blue teams, zero days, ransom notes typed on cracked screens. And yet most of the marketing looks like a stock photo of a padlock.

We want to fix that. We're hiring an in-house Creative Producer to help us do it.

Terra is an AI-native offensive security company. We build agentic pentesting that runs continuously, finds real exploitable vulnerabilities, and helps security teams close them before attackers get there first. Our customers are CISOs at banks, hospitals, and enterprises where a breach is a very bad day. The work is serious. The storytelling shouldn't be.

What you'll actually do

Produce the stuff people stop scrolling for. Short videos, launch films, event content, podcast episodes, motion pieces, weird one-offs, campaign assets, founder content, customer stories that don't sound like customer stories. You'll work directly with marketing, our founders, our researchers, and customers who occasionally let us tell their war stories.

You'll own the concept, the shot list, the shoot, the edit, and the ship. Sometimes you'll direct. Sometimes you'll be a one-person crew. Sometimes you'll wrangle a scrappy team of freelancers and AI tools into something that punches three weight classes above what it cost to make.

You will not be handed briefs and asked to execute them. You will be asked what you'd make, what you need, and how fast you can get it up.

Logistics

Remote, US-based. We have gravity in NYC, Boston, Florida, and San Francisco, but you can live anywhere in the US. Travel is 10 to 20% for shoots, events, and occasionally being in a room with the rest of us.

Compensation: Competitive base, plus meaningful early-employee equity and benefits. Where an offer lands depends on experience and the strength of your portfolio.

Requirements

  • You have a portfolio that makes us want to hire you before we finish scrolling
  • You're 3-5 years into your career and at least 2 years of experience as a Brand designer
  • You can operate cameras, direct talent, edit, and finish work yourself when you need to
  • You've used AI tools in production and have opinions about which ones are actually good
  • You can get technical when it helps and get out of the way when it doesn't
  • You say yes to weird ideas and then figure out how to pull them off
  • You do not need to know anything about cybersecurity yet, but you have to want to learn it fast

How to apply?

Send your portfolio. That's the first thing we're going to look at, so lead with it.

Then tell us: what would you make for a company like Terra in your first 90 days? Give us two or three concepts you're actually excited about. What would you need to pull them off? How would you do it on a shoestring with AI tools and a team that says yes too often?

We are not hiring an agency. Please do not submit through recruiters. We want to hear from the person who's going to make the work.

Full-time | $65,000 to $85,000 | Remote

Do you like solving accounting puzzles?

Some accountants like maintaining clean books.

You like figuring out why they aren't clean in the first place.

Breakwater Accounting & Advisory is looking for a Cleanup Manager who gets genuine satisfaction from taking messy financials, figuring out what happened, and turning them into books that leadership can actually trust.

You investigate. You trace the money. You ask questions. You test theories. You rebuild accounts. You find the root cause. Then you create a clean, reliable financial picture that the client and our ongoing accounting team can trust.

And then?

You move on to the next puzzle.

This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and problem solving. You'll work on multiple cleanup projects at once, diving into each one, solving the problem, creating a clean handoff, and moving forward.

What You'll Do

Find the mess. Figure out what happened. Fix it. Prove it's right. Move on to the next puzzle.

Investigate and solve

  • Dig into messy financial records to understand what happened and why.
  • Trace transactions to uncover errors, missing information, and broken processes.
  • Develop practical cleanup plans and work through them to completion.
  • Reconstruct financial activity when the existing records don't tell the full story.

Prove the numbers are right

  • Reconcile and substantiate major balance sheet accounts including cash, payroll, loans, revenue, prepaids, accruals, fixed assets, and equity.
  • Create supporting schedules and documentation that show why the numbers are right.
  • Go beyond “it balances” to create financials that are accurate, explainable, and defensible.

Make the books make sense

  • Redesign charts of accounts when they no longer serve the business.
  • Organize financial reporting so business owners can understand what is actually happening.
  • Identify the story behind the numbers and make that story easier to see.

Fix what caused the problem

  • You'll reverse-engineer workflows such as invoicing, payroll, inventory, and expenses to understand where things went wrong.
  • Help create better processes so the same problem doesn't show up again.

We don't believe in cleaning up the same mess twice.

Use your accounting and technology expertise

  • QuickBooks Online is one of your primary tools. You'll troubleshoot complex issues, untangle stubborn balances, and find solutions when the obvious answer isn't working.
  • We're a tech-forward team. We use modern accounting technology and AI to solve problems and improve efficiency. You don't need to be an AI expert. You do need to be curious and willing to try new approaches.

Communicate and collaborate

  • Work directly with clients to ask smart questions, gather missing information, explain complicated accounting issues, and keep projects moving.
  • Collaborate with the Breakwater team, document your work, and create clean handoffs to the ongoing accounting team.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
  • 5+ years of high-level accounting, audit, or full-cycle bookkeeping experience.
  • Strong understanding of how balance sheets actually work.
  • Experience with accruals, revenue recognition, depreciation, amortization, and other complex accounting concepts.
  • Prior reviewer, senior accountant, audit, or similar experience.
  • Proven experience cleaning up messy or inaccurate financials.
  • Expert-level QuickBooks Online proficiency.
  • Excellent investigative and problem-solving instincts.
  • Ability to stay focused and see a problem through to completion.
  • Confidence communicating complex financial issues to non-accountants.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects without losing the details.

Experience in an outsourced, multi-client accounting environment is a plus, as is experience with tools such as Xero, Dext, Ramp, BILL, Gusto, ACS/Realm, and advanced Excel.

Why Breakwater?

At Breakwater, you'll work with businesses and nonprofits across a variety of industries, so no two cleanup projects are exactly alike.

You'll join a team that values being proactive, positive, prepared, purposeful, protective, and principled.

You'll also get:

  • $65,000 to $85,000 salary
  • Full-time employment
  • Five weeks of PTO
  • Benefits
  • A collaborative, supportive team
  • Challenging accounting work where you get to solve problems every day

If you read this and thought, “that sounds like fun!” we want to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Underwater Acoustics & Bioacoustics Consultant
jobs.excerpt: We are SLR Consulting (Canada), an 1000+ team of advisory, environmental, engineering, and regulatory professionals across Canada.
jobs.description:
We are SLR Consulting (Canada), an 1000+ team of advisory, environmental, engineering, and regulatory professionals across Canada. We deliver services through the integration of over 30 disciplines to help clients address some of their most complex challenges around sustainability. We are Making Sustainability Happen.

As our new Senior Underwater Acoustics & Bioacoustics Consultant , you will play an important role on our Acoustics team.

You will work with a multidisciplinary team to support a wide range of clients by leading underwater acoustics modelling and assessment, translating project activities into reliable predictions and clear reports. Your responsibilities include developing sound propagation models, reviewing source data, supporting field measurement and monitoring programs, and contributing to mitigation strategies that protect marine environments and guide responsible development.

As part of a globally connected acoustics and vibration team, you will collaborate across specialties while serving as a senior consultant in underwater acoustics. You will work across projects involving ports and terminals, offshore energy, dredging, marine construction, subsea cables, transportation infrastructure, and other coastal developments throughout North America and internationally.

Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership in underwater acoustics assessments, modelling, monitoring, and advisory services on a diverse range of marine projects, including:

  • Coastal and offshore development projects including ports and terminals, dredging, marine construction, offshore energy, subsea cables, renewable energy, and nearshore infrastructure.

  • Vessel noise assessments, construction noise assessments, cumulative effects evaluations, and underwater noise impact studies.

  • Technical support for environmental assessments, permitting, regulatory approvals, compliance programs, stakeholder engagement, and expert technical advice.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Underwater Acoustics Assessment & Modelling

  • Develop and run underwater sound propagation and exposure models for both continuous and impulsive sound sources.

  • Define modelling assumptions, environmental inputs, sensitivity analyses, uncertainty assessments, and quality assurance procedures.

  • Model sound propagation considering environmental variables including bathymetry, water depth, temperature profiles, salinity, seabed composition, and oceanographic conditions.

  • Predict underwater noise footprints for proposed and operational marine activities.

  • Integrate species distribution, hearing sensitivity, and ecological datasets into acoustic models.

  • Support source characterization using field measurements, literature values, equipment specifications, and operational data.

  • Evaluate zones of behavioural disturbance, auditory injury, masking, stress responses, and cumulative impacts to marine fauna.

Underwater Sound Measurement & Monitoring

  • Design, coordinate, and execute underwater acoustic monitoring programs.

  • Deploy, retrieve, calibrate, and maintain hydrophones and underwater acoustic recording systems.

  • Measure ambient and anthropogenic underwater noise from shipping, construction, dredging, seismic surveys, and offshore operations.

  • Support underwater acoustic measurement campaigns and ensure data quality throughout collection and processing.

  • Coordinate offshore and coastal monitoring programs with multidisciplinary project teams.

  • Participate in fieldwork as required depending on project needs.

Marine Animal Acoustics

  • Support studies evaluating marine mammal, fish, sea turtle, and invertebrate responses to underwater sound.

  • Identify species presence using passive acoustic monitoring (PAM), vocalizations, and acoustic signatures.

  • Analyze behavioural responses to underwater noise exposure.

  • Support marine mammal observation (MMO) and passive acoustic monitoring programs where appropriate.

  • Assist with controlled exposure experiments and research initiatives where required.

Data Analysis & Signal Processing

  • Process, analyze, and interpret large underwater acoustic datasets using Python, MATLAB, or similar analytical software.

  • Generate and interpret spectrograms, frequency analyses, and time-series visualizations.

  • Detect, classify, and catalogue biological and anthropogenic acoustic events.

  • Apply statistical analyses to evaluate relationships between underwater noise and biological responses.

  • Maintain reproducible analytical workflows and documentation.

Regulatory Support & Environmental Assessment

  • Prepare technical documentation supporting environmental assessments, permitting applications, regulatory submissions, and compliance reporting.

  • Respond to technical comments from regulators, Indigenous communities, and stakeholders.

  • Contribute to underwater noise management strategies and regulatory compliance.

  • Support dispute resolution and provide expert technical input where required.

Mitigation Planning

  • Develop practical mitigation strategies to reduce underwater noise impacts.

  • Recommend mitigation measures including bubble curtains, exclusion zones, timing windows, ramp-up procedures, operational restrictions, quieter technologies, and adaptive management approaches.

  • Monitor and evaluate mitigation effectiveness through field monitoring and reporting.

  • Translate modelling results into practical recommendations for clients and regulators.

Project Delivery

  • Prepare clear, defensible technical reports suitable for environmental assessments, permitting, peer review, and client reporting.

  • Develop technical figures, modelling documentation, and supporting appendices.

  • Coordinate with project managers to manage scope, schedules, budgets, technical resources, and deliverables.

  • Perform QA/QC reviews of internal and external technical work.

  • Streamline modelling, data processing, and reporting workflows to improve efficiency and consistency.

Leadership & Business Development

  • Mentor junior staff on underwater acoustics modelling, data processing, technical writing, and quality assurance.

  • Support proposal preparation, scope development, budgeting, and client presentations.

  • Build strong client relationships and identify opportunities to expand underwater acoustics services.

  • Contribute technical thought leadership through publications, conference presentations, workshops, and industry engagement.

  • Maintain awareness of emerging research, technologies, and best practices in underwater acoustics and marine ecology.

Working @ SLR

With us, there is no doubt you'll grow your subject-matter expertise and industry knowledge. We care about investing in our employees for the long run, and if you ask our team, they'll tell you that's just one of the many benefits of working here. We want to be a place where you can experience career growth and satisfaction for many years.

Here's what else you'll enjoy as part of our team:

  • Competitive total compensation package including comprehensive benefits, vacation, and wellness initiatives.

  • Full-time permanent role with opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

Qualifications, Education & Professional Experience

The successful candidate will possess:

  • Minimum of five years of consulting experience in underwater acoustics supporting environmental assessments, permitting, compliance, or marine infrastructure projects.

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Acoustics, Ocean Engineering, Marine Science, or a related discipline. Master's degree preferred.

  • Professional registration (P.Eng., PE, or equivalent), or eligibility for registration.

  • Strong understanding of underwater sound propagation, acoustics theory, source characterization, frequency-domain analysis, exposure assessment, and environmental acoustics.

  • Demonstrated experience developing underwater sound propagation models and documenting assumptions, sensitivity analyses, uncertainty assessments, and reproducible modelling workflows.

  • Experience designing and implementing underwater acoustic monitoring programs including hydrophone deployment, calibration, instrumentation, and field data collection.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience processing large underwater acoustic datasets using Python, MATLAB, R, or similar software.

  • Experience generating spectrograms, time-series analyses, signal processing, automated detection, acoustic classification, and statistical analyses.

  • Experience applying passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) techniques and marine mammal acoustic detection systems.

  • Understanding of marine fauna behaviour and responses to underwater sound, including behavioural disturbance, masking, stress responses, and habitat considerations.

  • Familiarity with marine mammal, fish, and sea turtle impact criteria and environmental assessment frameworks.

  • Experience integrating species distribution, hearing sensitivity, and biological datasets into acoustic assessments.

  • Experience preparing technical reports suitable for environmental assessments, peer review, and regulatory submissions.

  • Experience developing underwater noise mitigation strategies including bubble curtains, exclusion zones, operational controls, adaptive management, and monitoring plans.

  • Experience supporting marine mammal observation (MMO) programs or passive acoustic monitoring programs is considered an asset.

  • Offshore or coastal fieldwork experience is considered an asset.

  • Experience working with multidisciplinary teams including marine biologists, ecologists, oceanographers, and environmental scientists.

  • Experience working with regulators, Indigenous communities, government agencies, and industry stakeholders is highly desirable.

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and project management abilities.

  • Demonstrated mentoring and technical leadership experience.

  • Proven client relationship and business development experience, including proposal preparation and scope development.

  • Publication record, conference presentations, or research contributions related to underwater acoustics or marine ecology are considered assets.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the country of hire.

  • Ability to travel throughout North America, including offshore work and cross-border travel where required.

SLR strives to build diverse teams that reflect the communities we work in and encourages applications from traditionally underrepresented groups including women, visible minorities, Indigenous Peoples, people identifying as 2SLGBTQI+, veterans, and people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Transaction Coordinator – California Real Estate & Compliance | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Industry: Residential Real Estate

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a detail-oriented Transaction Coordinator to manage the administrative, documentation, and compliance side of California residential real estate transactions.

You’ll support agents from the time a purchase agreement is executed through the close of escrow, ensuring transaction files remain organized, deadlines are tracked, required documents are completed, and all parties stay informed.

This is an operations-focused role requiring strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to confidently manage multiple transactions at different stages.

What You’ll Own

Transaction & File Management

  • Open and manage transaction files from executed purchase agreement through close of escrow
  • Review contracts, addenda, disclosures, and supporting documentation for completeness
  • Maintain accurate transaction files according to brokerage recordkeeping and compliance requirements
  • Prepare and organize documents for review, approval, and signature
  • Keep transaction records current throughout the entire contract-to-close process
  • Manage multiple active files while maintaining accuracy and organization

Deadlines & California Compliance

  • Track critical transaction deadlines, including:
    • Contingency periods
    • Inspection windows
    • Loan contingencies
    • Appraisal contingencies
    • Close-of-escrow dates
  • Proactively alert agents when action is required
  • Collect and confirm required California disclosure forms and transaction documents
  • Help ensure files meet California and brokerage compliance requirements
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or incorrect documentation before it creates delays
  • Follow up on outstanding compliance items until resolved

Communication & Coordination

  • Serve as a coordination point between:
    • Real estate agents
    • Escrow and title officers
    • Lenders
    • Clients
    • Vendors
    • Other transaction parties
  • Keep relevant stakeholders informed about transaction progress
  • Communicate outstanding requirements and upcoming deadlines
  • Follow up on pending documents, signatures, and approvals
  • Help resolve administrative bottlenecks that could delay closing
  • Keep transactions moving smoothly from contract through close

Documents & Transaction Support

  • Prepare and route documents for electronic signature
  • Use platforms such as DocuSign, DocuSign Rooms, Dotloop, or similar systems
  • Coordinate home warranty orders when required
  • Track repair documentation and related transaction items
  • Assist with vendor scheduling and coordination
  • Support agents with administrative needs related to active transactions
  • Maintain accurate records throughout each transaction

Requirements

  • 1–3+ years of experience as a Transaction Coordinator, Escrow Assistant, or in a similar real estate transaction-support role
  • Working knowledge of California residential real estate transactions
  • Familiarity with California contracts, timelines, and disclosure requirements
  • Strong understanding of the transaction process from executed contract through close of escrow
  • Experience managing multiple transactions, files, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Experience with transaction-management and electronic-signature platforms
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to proactively monitor deadlines and follow up on outstanding items
  • Ability to work independently without constant supervision

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting multiple real estate agents or an entire brokerage team
  • Experience with DocuSign Rooms, Dotloop, or similar transaction-management platforms
  • Familiarity with California disclosures such as:
    • TDS
    • NHD
    • SPQ
    • AVID
  • Experience coordinating with escrow/title companies and lenders
  • Previous experience in a real estate brokerage or transaction-coordination environment

Tools & Platforms

DocuSign | DocuSign Rooms | Dotloop | Transaction Management Platforms | Electronic Signature Tools | Real Estate Documentation Systems | Email & Scheduling Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are exceptionally organized and comfortable managing multiple deadlines
  • Understand the importance of accuracy in California real estate transactions
  • Quickly notice missing, incomplete, or incorrect information
  • Proactively follow up instead of waiting to be reminded
  • Communicate professionally with agents, clients, lenders, and escrow/title partners
  • Are comfortable working with contracts, disclosures, and transaction documents
  • Can remain calm while several transactions are moving simultaneously
  • Take ownership of your files from contract through closing
  • Can work independently in a remote environment
  • Understand that small documentation errors can create significant transaction or compliance issues

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing active transactions and identifying upcoming contingencies, inspection deadlines, outstanding disclosures, or documents requiring signatures.

Throughout the day, you’ll communicate with agents, lenders, escrow/title officers, and clients; route documents for electronic signature; update transaction files; follow up on missing paperwork; and make sure upcoming deadlines are clearly communicated.

In short: you keep every transaction organized, compliant, and moving from signed contract through close of escrow.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and completeness of transaction files
  • On-time tracking of transaction deadlines
  • Completion of required California disclosures
  • Number of missing or outstanding documents
  • Timeliness of follow-ups
  • Accuracy of electronic-signature routing
  • Brokerage compliance readiness
  • Successful coordination with agents, lenders, and escrow/title partners
  • Reduction in preventable transaction delays
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent transactions accurately
  • Successful contract-to-close execution

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Initial Screening with Pavago
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Real Estate Transaction Coordinator or Escrow Assistant with knowledge of California residential transactions, contracts, disclosures, compliance, and contract-to-close coordination, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today if you’re organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and confident managing multiple transactions from executed agreement through closing.

Who Thrives Here

jobs.description:
Welcome to OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe, smart, and environmentally responsible.

We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto, Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX and see how far you can go.

We believe the future of our products sits at the intersection of AI and design. Our ambition is to become an AI-native organization, where intelligent systems and human-centered design come together to create faster, smarter, and more meaningful customer experiences. We’re rethinking how products are built, how experiences are shaped, and how teams deliver impact.

A key part of this transformation is creating the right foundations and infrastructure to enable high-quality experiences at scale - where design systems, patterns, and workflows are structured, scalable, and AI-readable, unlocking new levels of speed, consistency, and innovation.

The role

    We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Design System team, working across our Real Estate products. You'll play a key role in evolving our design system, helping designers and engineers across the business design and build with greater consistency, quality and pace.

    You'll work day to day within a small, dedicated pod, spanning web and app. But the system serves designers across multiple tribes, each shipping their own product work. You'll work within our contribution model, helping teams outside the pod propose, adopt and evolve components without fragmenting the system.

    We're looking for someone with strong craft, attention to detail, and curiosity about systems thinking and AI-assisted workflows. You'll help create a coherent product experience across our brands while developing your own design systems practice.

Key responsabilities:

  • Design and evolve reusable components, patterns and foundations within our design system, reducing duplication and improving consistency across tribes

  • Define component behaviour, states and variants, working directly with engineering to ship them

  • Run and improve the contribution model: the process and standards that let designers outside the core pod propose and ship components without breaking system coherence

  • Support design work from problem framing through to documentation and handover, using research and feedback from teams to inform decisions

  • Create clear documentation and specifications covering variants, edge cases and usage guidance

  • Collaborate closely with engineers on token strategy and the practical link between Figma and production code

  • Resolve conflicts between a tribe's local need and the system's long-term coherence

  • Work with product design teams to identify gaps and embed stronger systems thinking across products

AI-enabled Design Systems:

  • Use AI-assisted tooling as part of your daily workflow, from research through to prototyping and component definition

  • Contribute to making the system well-structured for AI-assisted workflows, including tokens, documentation and reusable patterns

  • Know when to override AI output with your own design judgment, and be able to explain why

What we're looking for:

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining a design system at scale, not just documenting one

  • Experience running or contributing to a contribution model, or a clear point of view on how you'd build one

  • Strong technical fluency: you understand how your decisions translate into code, and work with engineers as a peer, not a handoff

  • Sharp judgment on trade-offs: when to enforce consistency, when to allow exceptions

  • Strong communicator, able to justify design system decisions to stakeholders who don't share your priorities, and bring other designers along rather than dictate to them

  • Comfortable with AI-assisted tools, with an interest in applying them in practical ways to improve speed, quality and consistency

Required experience

  • A portfolio demonstrating strong product and systems thinking, with evidence of shipped impact, not just documented patterns

  • Experience working in Figma, including component libraries, variables and tokens, alongside experience with built or coded prototypes

  • Experience working closely with engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable outcomes

  • Experience or strong interest in AI-assisted design or development workflows

Hiring Process

    First Stage - Recruiter Screen

    This is your first interview with our Talent Acquisition team. We’ll explore your background, skills, and experience, as well as your approach to autonomy, ownership, and critical thinking. It’s also a chance to discuss your aspirations and ensure alignment with our culture and values.

    Second Stage - Portfolio Review

    In this stage, you’ll meet with the Hiring Manager and a Designer from the team. We’ll explore your process thinking and approach to design through a case study of your choice. This is also a great opportunity to discuss how you collaborate with others and how your values align with our team culture.

    Third Stage - AI Sandbox Challenge

    This is a dynamic and interactive session where you’ll have the chance to demonstrate your thought process in action. It’s designed to give us insight into how you approach challenges, integrate AI into your workflows, and apply your skills in a practical setting.

    We aim to make this process clear, collaborative, and reflective of the way we work as a team.

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us.

Privacy Data disclaimer

jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Senior Product Designer to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) digital modernization initiatives spanning workflow improvement, automation, dashboards, AI-enabled experiences, digital tool adoption, and continuous improvement. This discovery-first, outcomes-oriented role will lead human-centered product design from problem framing and user research through prototyping, validation, implementation support, and post-release learning.

The Senior Product Designer will work directly with Government users, operational stakeholders, product and program leaders, engineers, data teams, AI/ML specialists, training resources, and support teams to understand how work is actually performed. The role will investigate workflow friction, manual burden, information gaps, workarounds, adoption barriers, and unmet needs before proposing a solution, ensuring design decisions are grounded in evidence rather than assumptions.

Research is an integral part of the role. The designer will plan and conduct interviews, contextual inquiry, workflow observation, concept testing, usability testing, and other appropriate qualitative or mixed-method research. Findings will be synthesized with product analytics, adoption metrics, support trends, operational data, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities, prioritize improvements, and measure whether released capabilities are producing the intended user and mission outcomes.

The successful candidate must be comfortable moving between research, service and workflow design, interaction design, prototyping, measurement, and implementation collaboration. The ideal candidate can bring structure to ambiguous problems, facilitate difficult tradeoffs, create trustworthy and accessible AI-enabled experiences, and establish repeatable research, design, measurement, and continuous-improvement practices across the VA portfolio.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery and product research to identify high-value opportunities for workflow improvement, automation, dashboards, AI-enabled capabilities, and digital tool adoption.
  • Plan and conduct interviews, contextual inquiry, workflow observation, concept testing, usability testing, and post-release feedback around clear research questions and decision needs.
  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative evidence into user needs, pain points, opportunity areas, design principles, and prioritized recommendations.
  • Map current-state and future-state workflows, user journeys, service interactions, information flows, handoffs, exceptions, and workarounds across complex operational environments.
  • Translate validated user needs into product concepts, user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, design specifications, acceptance considerations, and backlog-ready requirements.
  • Design AI-enabled experiences that support transparency, user control, confidence calibration, feedback, exception handling, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Design usable dashboards and data-rich interfaces that help users understand status, trends, priorities, exceptions, and required actions without unnecessary cognitive burden.
  • Define and use product measures such as adoption, task completion, feature utilization, satisfaction, support demand, workflow time, and other relevant outcome indicators.
  • Triangulate research findings with product analytics, usage data, help desk trends, operational measures, training feedback, and stakeholder observations to guide prioritization.
  • Lead iterative prototype validation and usability testing, documenting what was learned, what changed, unresolved risks, and the evidence supporting major design decisions.
  • Apply Section 508, WCAG, inclusive-design, and accessibility principles throughout research, design, prototyping, testing, and handoff activities.
  • Partner with product, engineering, data, AI/ML, architecture, security/privacy, QA, training, change/adoption, and support teams to ensure designs are feasible, testable, supportable, and aligned to enterprise constraints.
  • Communicate research findings, design rationale, evidence, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to Government stakeholders, delivery teams, and executive audiences.
  • Mentor designers and researchers and maintain reusable research templates, design patterns, evidence libraries, and measurement practices that strengthen team maturity and reduce repeated discovery.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in human-centered design, human-computer interaction, UX/product design, service design, interaction design, psychology, information science, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in product design, UX, human-centered design, service design, user research, or related digital-product roles, including responsibility for complex enterprise or workflow-oriented products.
  • Portfolio demonstrating an end-to-end user-centered design process, including research-informed decisions, workflow or service understanding, iterative prototyping, usability validation, and clear design documentation.
  • Demonstrated experience independently planning and leading user research using interviews, contextual inquiry, observation, concept testing, usability testing, or mixed-method approaches, with strong synthesis skills.
  • Experience designing complex workflow, dashboard, automation, data-heavy, or decision-support products in environments where users must interpret information and take action efficiently.
  • Experience designing or evaluating AI-enabled products, intelligent automation, responsible AI patterns, or human-in-the-loop workflows with attention to trust, transparency, feedback, and oversight.
  • Experience defining or using product metrics, adoption measures, usage analytics, user feedback, or support data to evaluate product performance and guide iteration.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous mission or operational needs into research questions, design hypotheses, prototypes, testable requirements, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong facilitation and collaboration skills across product, engineering, data, AI/ML, training, support, security, and senior stakeholder communities.
  • Proficiency with Figma/FigJam and working familiarity with complementary research, mapping, prototyping, collaboration, and work-management tools such as Miro, Axure, Jira, Confluence, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
  • U.S. citizenship is required. Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.

Desired:

  • 10+ years leading product design, service design, UX research, or human-centered transformation in complex enterprise, federal, healthcare, or other regulated environments.
  • Prior VA, VHA, federal health, or other Government experience involving digital modernization, workflow redesign, automation, dashboards, adoption, training, or product improvement.
  • Experience with AI-assisted decision support, intelligent automation, generative AI, conversational experiences, or agentic workflows and associated human-factors considerations.
  • Experience reducing manual burden or fragmented workflows through research-led digital product or service redesign, including service blueprints, opportunity registers, research repositories, or improvement roadmaps.
  • Advanced Section 508/WCAG, accessibility testing, or inclusive-design experience for users with diverse access needs and assistive technologies.
  • Relevant certification or advanced training such as Nielsen Norman Group UX Certification, Human Factors International CUA/CXA, UXQB CPUX, IAAP CPACC/WAS, LUMA Institute, or comparable credentials; advanced degree preferred.

jobs.title: Power Engineer, Utility Interconnection
jobs.excerpt: DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems.
jobs.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Power Engineer – Utility Interconnection

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

SALARY

DLB recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges.  In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

JOB SUMMARY

DLB is expanding its energy storage engineering services and is seeking a Power Engineer – Utility Interconnection to support and help grow this practice. This role is responsible for the engineering delivery of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), microgrid, and other inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnections across utility, renewable, data center, and industrial markets, from concept through construction, commissioning, and energization. 

The Power Engineer – Utility Interconnection will provide technical input, support engineering decisions, and represent the firm with clients, utilities, and partners.  This position is hands-on, blending detailed engineering execution with quality-focused delivery and support of business growth.

The Power Engineer – Utility Interconnectionworks with a high degree of independence on day-to-day work and receives general direction on new projects, tasks, or assignments. Will execute projects, tasks, or assignments of complex scope.  May coordinate activities of other personnel.

The Power Engineer – Utility Interconnection will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Energy Storage Engineering (40%)

  • Serve as an engineering contributor for Battery Utility Interconnection System (BESS) projects, performing advanced engineering work with general oversight. Perform detailed design, analysis, and engineering of BESS, microgrid, and other inverter-based resource (IBR) systems, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, utility requirements, industry standards, codes and regulations
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate BESS and IBR designs seamlessly into larger electrical systems, including substation, generation, and grid interconnection infrastructure
  • Support technical scoping, design, and utility/developer coordination for Battery Utility Interconnection System (BESS), microgrid, and other inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnections at the medium- and high-voltage level, including protection philosophy, interconnection studies, and compliance with IEEE 1547 / IEEE 2800
  • Contribute to engineering approaches, design standards, and technical risk management.
  • Support project delivery as engineer of record (or in support of the EOR), contributing to technical accuracy, constructability, and code compliance.
  • Apply and help maintain engineering standards, design criteria, and quality expectations for Utility Interconnection work.

Energy Storage Design Activities (25%)

  • BESS one-line, three-line, and AC/DC schematics
  • Physical layouts, equipment arrangements, and site plans for containerized/modular BESS installations
  • DC architecture including battery racks, inverters/power conversion systems (PCS), and medium-voltage collection systems
  • Grounding systems and electrical safety designs
  • Protection & control philosophies, relay schemes, and coordination
  • BESS/microgrid interconnection one-lines, protection & control schemes, and anti-islanding / transfer trip logic
  • Fire detection/suppression and thermal management coordination with mechanical disciplines
  • Develop and review equipment specifications for major BESS components including battery modules, power conversion systems (PCS), transformers, switchgear, protection relays, and communications/SCADA systems.
  • Perform complex engineering studies with general guidance
  • Perform and/or direct short-circuit, arc flash (IEEE 1584), harmonic (IEEE 519), power flow, and EMT/transient (e.g., PSCAD or equivalent) studies, including fault, harmonic, and dynamic contribution from BESS and other inverter-based resources
  • Support interconnection application processes and LGIA/SGIA coordination with utilities, developers, and BESS vendors
  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and utility requirements while identifying and helping resolve technical conflicts and ambiguities.
  • Utilize AutoCAD and Revit software to prepare drawings and visual aids
  • Support timely and effective coordination of the project design team, including resource forecasting 
  • Identify potential project scope changes and aid in development of strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines 

Project Execution / Pre-Construction / Client Interface (25%)

  • Support execution of the firm’s client value system and help assure that the project is executed in accordance with company policies and standards
  • Work closely with clients to understand their specific project requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure client satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle
  • Support resolution of design, construction, and field issues, escalating to leadership when business or contractual risk requires involvement.
  • Support construction, testing, commissioning, and energization through RFIs, field engineering, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Participate in technical reviews, design meetings, and client presentations.
  • Prepare project design and construction documents 

Reporting (10%)

  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders 
  • Update and maintain shop drawing and RFI log
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities and lead the strategic use of technology, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency through workflow automation, reduced manual effort, and improved accuracy in forecasting, documentation, reporting, and quality processes.
  • Support adoption of emerging technologies - including advanced analytics, data visualization tools, and digital construction management platforms - to strengthen readiness, quality assurance, and project controls.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure technology solutions align with DLB standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity.
  • Support a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology to optimize performance and scalability.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Knowledge of medium- and high-voltage electrical systems including BESS, microgrid, and IBR configurations, protection & control philosophies, and utility-scale grounding and electrical safety design
  • Knowledge of various electrical topologies and distribution systems
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable electrical codes and standards, specifically NESC, NEC, NFPA (including NFPA 855 for battery Utility Interconnection systems), ANSI, and utility interconnection standards, along with IEEE 1547 and IEEE 2800 (interconnection of inverter-based resources), IEEE 1584 (arc flash), IEEE 519 (harmonics), and IEEE 80 (substation grounding grid design), with ability to apply requirements through code analysis and system design.
  • Knowledge of power systems engineering / design software including short-circuit, arc flash, harmonic, and power flow analysis tools (e.g., ETAP, SKM, or ASPEN), equipment sizing, and EMT/transient simulation (e.g., PSCAD or equivalent)
  • Strong working knowledge of Battery Utility Interconnection Systems (BESS), microgrids, and inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnection requirements, including protection coordination, anti-islanding/transfer trip schemes, and utility interconnection processes (LGIA/SGIA)
  • Hands-on experience with protective relay platforms (e.g., SEL or equivalent), including settings development, coordination, and field commissioning support
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet tight deadlines under pressure.
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation.
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and serve as a client-facing point of contact.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, facility and other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds  

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 20%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states 
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license in Electrical Engineering.
  • 5+ years of progressive Utility Interconnection or power systems engineering experience, with demonstrated depth in protection & control (P&C) design (8+ years preferred).
  • Experience supporting engineering delivery on medium- to high-voltage BESS, microgrid, or IBR interconnection projects, including in an engineer-of-record support capacity.
  • Hands-on protective relay experience (SEL or equivalent platform), including settings development and coordination.
  • Direct experience navigating LGIA/SGIA processes and utility interconnection requirements.
  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary BESS or power systems design and working with utilities and/or owner engineering teams on utility, renewable, data center, or industrial projects.

Preferred / Strong Plus

  • Direct, hands-on experience on at least one BESS, microgrid, or inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnection project, from interconnection application/study through protection design and commissioning.
  • Working knowledge of IEEE 2800 and/or IEEE 1547 interconnection standards for inverter-based resources.
  • Electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation experience using PSCAD or equivalent tool.
  • Familiarity with NFPA 855 or battery Utility Interconnection fire protection and life safety design.

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. jobs.excerpt: What Makes Us Stand Out:Granum is the leading software company devoted to serving landscapers and arborists across North America, providing intuitive, industry-specific solutions designed to help them improve and grow their businesses while impressing their customers.
jobs.description:
What Makes Us Stand Out:

Granum is the leading software company devoted to serving landscapers and arborists across North America, providing intuitive, industry-specific solutions designed to help them improve and grow their businesses while impressing their customers. Granum brings together three of the most trusted software names in the industry — LMN, SingleOps, and Greenius — into one powerful software ecosystem. More than just a software company, Granum works alongside its clients to implement systems for estimating, scheduling, crew training, invoicing, and payments, blending technology with hands-on onboarding and human support. The company's mission is to help industry professionals unlock their potential and achieve their most important goals, all united by the belief that its clients’ success is not just a milestone, but a shared mission.

As a team, we’re on a mission to reshape an age-old industry, and we’re looking for people who thrive on challenging and meaningful work. Our environment is highly collaborative, innovative, and supportive, with a shared commitment to having fun while making an impact. We live by our core values: We Before Me, Bias to Act, The Extra 1%, Accountable to Outcomes, Unconditional Transparency, and Forgiveness. If this resonates with you, we’d love to meet you and explore how you can help us build the future of the green industry!

Our culture and growth has been recognized with multiple awards, it’s a great time to join!

  • Comparably 2024 #23/100 Best (small/ medium sized companies) Leadership Teams
  • Comparably 2024 #63/75 (small/ medium sized companies) Happiest Employees
  • #9 Atlanta Business Chronicle's 2024 Best Places to Work (Our second year in a row!)
  • #6 of Built In’s 2024 Best Places to Work: Top 50 start-ups in Atlanta (Our second year in a row!)
  • Inc Magazine’s 2023 Best Places to Work
  • Inc. 5000: #131 of 2024 Southeast Regional America’s Fastest Growing Companies. (Our third year in a row!)
  • Inc 5000 America's fastest-growing private companies (Our third year in a row!)
  • Certified Great Place to Work Canada 2024

Principal Architect

We're hiring a Principal Architect to lead Granum's Architecture team and help drive the development of our technical roadmap. This is a hands-on player/coach role in which you'll lead a small team of architects and work in the code alongside them. You'll report to the CTO and work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Platforms, Product, and feature-pod leaders.

Our products are real, mature, and used every day by landscape professionals to run their operations. That means the interesting problems aren't greenfield; instead they are about executing a clean go-forward architecture and pulling a large, living codebase toward it without stopping the business. You'll help drive the application and system architecture across the portfolio, plan and develop platform upgrade tooling and processes (Angular, .NET, shared libraries), and reduce the technical debt that spans teams. Your job will be to provide the stable, secure, scalable foundation that feature teams build on by reducing systemic friction and clarifying technical direction so teams can deliver value quickly and confidently.

We're also an AI-native engineering org. We expect agents to do a lot of the heavy lifting on code, and part of your job will be to make our architecture legible to both engineers and coding agents, which includes clear patterns, good context, and docs that live where they belong. If you think the future of this craft is orchestrating and reviewing rather than typing every line, you'll fit right in. This is a role for someone who has real opinions about architecture but holds them loosely enough to serve the team. We believe in YAGNI, KISS, boring technology, and community solutions over custom builds. Good architecture here means less complexity for the pods, not more.

What You'll Own

  • Technical Roadmap Execution. Turning Granum's architecture roadmap into sequenced, visible work. That includes spotting cross-team dependencies during quarterly planning, before pods run into them mid-sprint.

  • Standards and the foundation. Architectural standards and guardrails, and the patterns for how we build a component and wire it into the existing app. Each component should do one thing well and be well tested.

  • Platform and technology stewardship. Planning and coordinating major upgrades (Angular, .NET, shared libraries), evaluating new technologies, and driving down cross-team technical debt.

  • Deployment and delivery enablement. Deployment patterns and shared CI/CD guidance that let teams own the deployment of their own code with system-wide consistency and safety.

  • Security posture. Application security and how identity and access work, and how our APIs are exposed and secured.

  • The AI-native development model. Defining how humans and agents interact in our process, and making sure our architecture supports agentic development.

  • The Architecture Pod. Leading, growing, and setting the operating rhythm for the Architecture Pod, and keeping it focused on foundation work.

What You'll Need

  • A track record as a hands-on architect. You've led the architecture of a non-trivial, production SaaS platform and driven a real codebase from where it was to where it needed to be. You can still read and write code credibly; you're a leader who architects, not an architect who's stopped building.

  • Depth across our stack. You have deep .NET experience including modernizing legacy .NET Framework systems. Angular, Azure, and AWS experience is a plus.

  • Systems and integration architecture. You think naturally about how applications and services fit together (integrations, data flow, deployment topology) and how to evolve them safely over time.

  • API architecture. You understand how to expose, secure, and version APIs, who's integrated and how, and how to change an API surface without breaking the people who depend on it.

  • A security-first instinct. You reason about auth, access, and exposure by default, and treat security as a property of the architecture rather than a later add-on.

  • Systems thinking and pragmatism. You fight complexity. You default to boring, well-understood technology and community solutions over bespoke builds, and you can tell the difference between architecture that unblocks teams and architecture that just looks impressive.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted development. You're comfortable with agentic coding tools as a primary development mode, and you have views on how to make a codebase and its patterns work well for both engineers and agents.

  • Product and Customer Focus. You've worked closely with product managers and tie technical decisions to customer outcomes. You see Product as a partner, not an obstacle.

  • Leadership. You've led engineers through feedback and unblocking. This includes setting direction, growing people, and running a healthy team rhythm.

Reasons why you would love it here!

  • Join a team culture that’s all about collaboration, support, and having fun while making a real impact every day.
  • In the U.S., we offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with multiple plan options, plus additional add ons like HSA/FSA accounts, disability and life insurance, and more.
  • In Canada, we provide an employer-funded HSA-based benefits plan with drug, dental, and mental health coverage - giving you a flexible way to manage your healthcare needs.
  • We're committed to your financial future, with 401(k) matching for U.S. employees and RRSP matching for those in Canada.
  • We invest in your growth through tailored career development conversations and support for tools, courses, and resources to help you thrive.
  • And when it comes to work-life balance? We offer unlimited Paid Time Off, paid company holidays, and a company-wide winter break from December 24 to January 1 - so you can truly recharge.

Granum does not sponsor work authorization needs; candidates must have proper work authorization to work for any employer in Canada or the U.S, without sponsorship from the company.

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Director, Global Trade Compliance
jobs.excerpt: Overview of Position Reporting to the AVP, Connected Living Compliance, this position is responsible for leading Assurant's global trade compliance program and ensuring compliance with all applicable import, export, sanctions, and customs regulations.
jobs.description:
Overview of Position


Reporting to the AVP, Connected Living Compliance, this position is responsible for leading Assurant's global trade compliance program and ensuring compliance with all applicable import, export, sanctions, and customs regulations. In addition to enterprise related trade activities, this role actively supports the movement of mobile devices, device components, service parts, accessories, and related technologies across global markets while enabling efficient customer, carrier, OEM, repair, refurbishment, and logistics operations.


The Director serves as a strategic advisor to Connected Living leadership and business stakeholders, balancing compliance obligations with customer commitments, operational efficiency, and commercial objectives.


This role will also partner, coordinate, and align global trade compliance activities and strategies with the Director, Global Supply Chain Compliance.


What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?


Global Trade Compliance Leadership (45%)


  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Assurant's global trade compliance program.
  • Establish governance, policies, procedures, and internal controls covering import, export, sanctions, and customs compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
    • OFAC sanctions requirements
    • U.S. Customs regulations
    • International customs laws and regulations
    • Foreign trade regulations in countries where Assurant operates
  • Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on global trade risks and opportunities.
  • Identify and implement value-creation opportunities, including duty drawback, free trade agreements, foreign trade zones, tariff engineering, and other lawful duty mitigation strategies.

Import Compliance and Customs Management (20%)


  • Oversee global customs compliance for mobile devices, service parts, accessories, and technology.
  • Ensure accurate:
    • HTS classifications
    • Country-of-origin determinations
    • Customs valuation
    • Duty assessment
  • Manage customs brokers and trade service providers.
    • Identify and implement duty savings strategies and opportunities.
  • Support optimization of global supply chain costs and customs efficiency.

Export Controls and Sanctions Compliance (20%)


  • Oversee export classification activities for devices, components, software, and technology.
  • Ensure compliance with export controls.
  • Lead restricted-party screening and sanctions compliance programs.
  • Provide guidance regarding cross-border shipments, technology transfers, and international business transactions.
  • Manage export licensing requirements and government authorizations when required.
  • Drive global alignment for HTS classification, country of origin, customs valuation, and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) determinations.
  • Maintain awareness of export-controlled technology, software, encryption, and restricted-access information requirements applicable to Assurant operations.
  • Assess and manage export control risks involving restricted destinations, restricted parties, military end users, military end uses, and controlled technologies, software, or technical data; develop procedures for end-use/end-user due diligence, escalation, licensing analysis, and transaction holds where required.

Risk Management and Compliance Governance (10%)


  • Conduct enterprise-wide trade compliance risk assessments.
  • Develop and maintain trade compliance controls and monitoring programs.
  • Lead internal audits and compliance reviews.
  • Establish compliance metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Investigate compliance incidents and manage corrective actions.
  • Lead government audits, inquiries, disclosures, and remediation activities.
  • Assists in remediating trade compliance issues as necessary, including but not limited to putting together project plans, connecting resources to find solutions, documenting resolutions, and documenting remediation plans.
  • Supports internal compliance audits and assists with managing external audits or inquiries from government agencies Maintains accurate data and recordkeeping to include collecting and retaining records in response to third-party inquiries relating to Assurant compliance practices and business activities.

Training and Culture (5%)


  • Develop and deliver trade compliance training and awareness programs.
  • Ensure employees understand their responsibilities related to international trade activities.
  • Maintain training records and support audit readiness.

Number of Direct Reports


  • 1-2 including a Compliance Analyst

Financial Responsibility


  • Signoff on responsible expenses, input on annual budget.

What are the requirements needed for this position?


Experience


  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in global trade compliance.
  • At least 5 years of leadership experience.
  • Experience supporting multinational import/export operations.
  • Experience managing customs and export compliance programs.
  • Experience supporting technology, telecommunications, consumer electronics, mobile device, repair/refurbishment, or logistics industries preferred.

Education & Certifications


  • Bachelors’ degree required, Master’s or JD preferred

Preferred Certifications


  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB)
  • Certified Export Specialist (CES)
  • Certified Customs Specialist (CCS)
  • Certified U.S. Export Compliance Officer (CUSECO)

Preferred Technical Expertise


  • EAR
  • OFAC sanctions compliance
  • Customs valuation
  • HTS classification
  • Country-of-origin analysis
  • Free Trade Agreements
  • Duty drawback
  • Foreign Trade Zones (FTZ)
  • Reverse logistics operations
  • Mobile device repair and refurbishment supply chains

Leadership Competencies

The candidate will be able to provide examples of successfully demonstrating the following leadership competencies:


  • Internal client-orientation with a constructive approach to resolution of issues. A style which builds alliances within the organization.
  • Ability to establish credibility with business owners, including senior and executive leadership, and influence through professional communication, work product, etc.
  • Solutions-oriented, demonstrated growth mindset.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships with clients, colleagues and stakeholders of various levels and areas throughout the organization.
  • Ability to lead change efforts through effective communication and persuasion.
  • Creative, resilient, and flexible style and approach to handling complex issues with high tolerance for ambiguity
  • Demonstrated leadership experience on leveraging data to drive actionable insights for risk or compliance programs
  • Clear written, visual and verbal communication skills, including ability to adjust messages dependent on audiences ranging from front-line employees to executive
  • Cultural competency and executive-level presence to work with the business and regional leadership teams around the world
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. Ability to interpret rules and guidelines, and then conceptualize and implement into policies, procedures, and controls.
  • Excellent and demonstrated project management skills, and attention to detail in leading projects and activities in a global organization. Ability to prioritize and simultaneously execute on multiple projects and ability to organize and analyze complex information and data
  • Sound and independent judgment, and demonstrated prudence and maturity
  • Commitment to driving a culture of ethics and integrity
  • Cultivate a high-performing trade compliance team through coaching, mentoring, accountability, and development of trade compliance professionals.

Skills


The candidate will be able to demonstrate proficiency in the following skills:


  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite with specific emphasis in Word, Excel, PowerPoint
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced environment with several simultaneous deliverables
  • Program of project management skills

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?


  • Experience in mobile or technology industries
  • Ability to use AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, etc
  • Supply chain and vendor risk management experience
