jobs.description:
Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Position Overview


The Director of Client Strategy & Growth serves as a strategic partner to the Practice Leader, with a dedicated focus on expanding market opportunities, strengthening client relationships, developing new business opportunities, and identifying what clients will need next across the mortgage industry.

This individual will combine deep mortgage industry expertise, an established network of industry relationships, strong client relationship skills, and a strategic growth mindset to help expand Baker Tilly's Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice across Mortgage Quality Control, Compliance, Servicing Quality Control, and related advisory services.


The Director will work closely with the Practice Leader to enhance the practice's ability to pursue new opportunities, deepen existing client relationships, increase market visibility, and proactively identify solutions to emerging client needs.


This role is intentionally different from a traditional Business Development position. The individual will collaborate with Baker Tilly's Business Development professionals while bringing the mortgage industry knowledge, executive relationships, client insight, and subject matter credibility necessary to develop opportunities and advance strategic client conversations.

The role is also designed to complement and enhance the Practice Leader's responsibilities. Overall practice strategy, operations, financial performance, service delivery, quality, client accountability, and people leadership remain the responsibility of the Practice Leader.


Primary Responsibilities


Strategic Growth & Market Development

  • Partner with the Practice Leader to identify, develop, and advance growth opportunities across the mortgage industry.
  • Leverage established industry relationships to create introductions and new opportunities with mortgage lenders, servicers, investors, and other market participants.
  • Identify prospective organizations and decision-makers that align with the practice's capabilities and strategic growth objectives.
  • Develop relationships with executive-level decision-makers and influencers throughout the mortgage industry.
  • Support the development of strategic pursuits from initial relationship development through solution discussions, proposals, and presentations.
  • Bring mortgage subject matter expertise and industry credibility into prospective client conversations.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the practice into new segments, relationships, and areas of the mortgage lifecycle.
  • Partner with the Practice Leader on targeted market strategies based on industry developments, client needs, and emerging opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Baker Tilly Business Development professionals to complement firmwide sales efforts with mortgage-specific relationships, market intelligence, and subject matter expertise.

Client Relationship Expansion & Client Success

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across existing clients.
  • Enhance the Practice Leader's ability to maintain proactive executive engagement across a growing client portfolio.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's business model, strategic priorities, challenges, and future objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships through additional Mortgage Risk Advisory services.
  • Proactively identify additional ways Baker Tilly can provide value beyond the client's current scope of services.
  • Support strategic client discussions and executive business reviews focused on future needs, industry developments, and opportunities.
  • Gather client feedback and market intelligence that can help strengthen relationships and identify future opportunities.
  • Help ensure clients continue to view Baker Tilly as a trusted advisor and strategic partner rather than solely a service provider.
  • Support client retention through proactive relationship development, responsiveness, industry insight, and continued value creation.

Strategic Client Insights & Growth Opportunities

  • Leverage client discussions, industry trends, engagement results, and market intelligence to identify opportunities for deeper client engagement and practice growth.
  • Partner with the Practice Leader to identify emerging client needs and determine where additional services, solutions, or advisory support may create value.
  • Recognize trends across the client base that may signal broader market opportunities or the need for new or expanded service offerings.
  • Use knowledge of a client's business, strategic priorities, and challenges to proactively bring forward ideas and opportunities beyond the current engagement.
  • Help develop executive-level conversations that shift relationships from individual services to broader strategic discussions around risk, compliance, quality, servicing, technology, and business priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to connect clients with additional capabilities across the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice and broader Baker Tilly organization.
  • Gather market and client intelligence that helps the Practice Leader determine where the practice should focus future growth efforts.
  • Identify recurring client challenges that could be developed into scalable service offerings, advisory solutions, or targeted market initiatives.
  • Help turn successful client solutions and outcomes into relevant market stories, thought leadership, and conversations with prospective clients.
  • Proactively identify "what's next" for key clients—what challenges they are likely to face, what support they may need, and where Baker Tilly can engage before a formal need or opportunity is identified.

Mortgage Industry & Market Strategy

  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of developments across the mortgage lifecycle and the challenges affecting lenders, servicers, investors, and other industry participants.
  • Monitor regulatory, agency, economic, technology, and market developments that could create new client needs or business opportunities.
  • Translate industry developments into potential client conversations and market opportunities.
  • Identify emerging areas where the practice can develop or expand capabilities to address changing client needs.
  • Maintain awareness of competitor capabilities, market positioning, and service offerings to help identify opportunities for differentiation.
  • Bring forward ideas regarding AI, automation, analytics, technology, and other emerging capabilities when they can create client value, support strategic growth, or create new service opportunities.
  • Help the Practice Leader continuously evaluate where the mortgage market is heading and how the practice can remain ahead of changing client needs.

Industry Presence & Strategic Relationship Development

  • Maintain and expand a strong network of relationships throughout the mortgage industry.
  • Represent the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice at relevant conferences, associations, industry events, and client meetings.
  • Build relationships with mortgage executives, technology providers, industry organizations, investors, and other strategic market participants.
  • Identify opportunities for strategic introductions, partnerships, and industry collaboration.
  • Support thought leadership, webinars, industry discussions, and other opportunities that increase visibility for the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice.
  • Identify opportunities for the Practice Leader and other Baker Tilly leaders to engage with key industry decision-makers.
  • Use industry relationships and market knowledge to identify prospective clients and emerging opportunities before they become formal pursuits.

Critical Skill Set

The ideal candidate will possess a unique combination of deep mortgage industry expertise, established relationships, strategic growth capabilities, client relationship skills, executive presence, and market awareness.


Deep Mortgage Lifecycle Expertise

The individual must possess comprehensive knowledge of the end-to-end mortgage lifecycle, including:

  • Mortgage origination and loan manufacturing
  • Processing and underwriting
  • Closing and post-closing
  • Mortgage Quality Control
  • Regulatory compliance
  • Operational and credit risk
  • Servicing
  • Default servicing and loss mitigation
  • Investor and agency requirements
  • Vendor oversight
  • Mortgage technology and operational workflows

The individual should understand how these areas intersect and be able to recognize client challenges and opportunities across the mortgage lifecycle rather than having expertise limited to a single function.


Established Mortgage Industry Relationships

Deep, current industry relationships are a critical requirement for this position.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • An established network of executive-level relationships throughout the mortgage industry.
  • Current relationships with mortgage lenders, servicers, investors, technology providers, industry organizations, and other key market participants.
  • Relationships with senior decision-makers and influencers responsible for mortgage operations, quality control, compliance, risk, servicing, technology, and related functions.
  • A strong professional reputation and demonstrated credibility within the mortgage industry.
  • The ability to leverage trusted relationships to create introductions, open doors, initiate strategic conversations, and identify opportunities for Baker Tilly.
  • Active involvement and continued visibility within the mortgage industry rather than relying solely on historical relationships.
  • The ability to build new relationships while maintaining and expanding an existing industry network.

Strategic Growth & Opportunity Development

  • Demonstrated ability to identify and develop business opportunities through relationships, industry knowledge, and consultative engagement.
  • Ability to recognize opportunities before a formal RFP or buying process begins.
  • Strong understanding of how to move an opportunity from an industry or client conversation into a meaningful strategic pursuit.
  • Ability to identify opportunities within both existing and prospective client relationships.
  • Consultative approach focused on understanding business challenges and developing solutions rather than transactional selling.
  • Ability to connect client needs with capabilities across Mortgage Risk Advisory and the broader Baker Tilly organization.
  • Strong market awareness and ability to recognize where industry changes may create future demand.

Client Success & Executive Relationship Management

  • Demonstrated ability to develop trusted, long-term relationships with executive-level clients.
  • Strong understanding of client success and proactive relationship management.
  • Ability to understand a client's broader organization, priorities, challenges, and future direction.
  • Ability to recognize opportunities beyond the current scope of an engagement.
  • Strong listening and consultative problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to navigate complex or sensitive client discussions while maintaining strong relationships.
  • Strong executive presence and credibility with senior mortgage industry leaders.

Strategic & Commercial Acumen

  • Ability to understand the business drivers of mortgage lenders and servicers and how market conditions affect their priorities.
  • Strong understanding of how client challenges translate into advisory opportunities.
  • Ability to evaluate the potential value and strategic fit of new opportunities.
  • Ability to identify patterns across clients and the market that could lead to scalable service offerings.
  • Strong understanding of competitive positioning and differentiation.
  • Ability to balance client needs, market opportunities, and Baker Tilly capabilities when developing potential solutions.

Technology, AI & Emerging Market Awareness

While this is not an innovation or technology leadership position, the individual should maintain awareness of technologies changing the mortgage industry.

The ideal candidate should have:

  • Working knowledge of AI, automation, analytics, and emerging mortgage technologies.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Platform [IC3]
jobs.excerpt: Who we areOur mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Hours & location

🌎 While we hire almost anywhere in the world, we have a preference for someone to reside in the following locations for this role. However, if you feel qualified, we welcome you to apply regardless of location. No matter what, working hours must overlap with EST for at least 20 hours/week.

Preferred locations:

  • EST
  • Europe

Why this job is exciting

Source code is at the heart of Sourcegraph. We support multiple code hosts and retrieve, store, index, and serve source code - to end users, admins, and other internal services.

This role gives you the opportunity to solve complex, challenging, and highly technical problems for our customers, both internally and externally, help unleash the potential and productivity of our Engineering teams, and delight our customers with industry-leading quality software.

The Platform team primarily focuses on building a fully managed platform for using Sourcegraph, Sourcegraph Cloud, our SaaS offering. As a member of the Platform team, you will work closely with both external customers and internal stakeholders to meet their needs. You will:

  • Develop inter-cloud connectivity solutions to support enterprise customers from highly regulated industries to use Sourcegraph Cloud.
  • Build a control plane to orchestrate a fleet of single-tenant Sourcegraph Cloud instances.
  • Expose complex infrastructure as API to support internal customers to iterate faster.
  • Dive into upstream dependencies (e.g., CDK for Terraform, Terraform providers for GCP) to debug and patch non-trivial problems.
  • Be an advocate for building reliable services and work with leadership to help product teams achieve operational excellence.
  • Participate in on-call rotation to uphold our contractual SLA commitments.

📅 Within one month, you will…

  • Onboard onto the Sourcegraph architecture, tooling, and development workflow.
  • Build a solid understanding of the team’s areas of ownership, technical challenges, and problems the team solves for our customers, and know how all of these align with the top-level company goals.
  • Actively participate in team meetings, sharing ideas and insights to contribute to the overall team goals.
  • Start contributing to the team goals and deliverables by shipping new features, debugging issues, and fixing bugs.

📅 Within three months, you will…

  • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the Cloud infrastructure, its underlying technologies, and its integration within the Sourcegraph ecosystem.
  • Lead initiatives contributing to team goals through both discovery and delivery phases, collaborating directly with product and design partners, other engineering teams, and non-technical stakeholders from different departments.
  • Contribute to the architectural design and implementation of new features or improvements, actively shaping the future direction of Cloud infrastructure based on customer needs.
  • Lead initiatives contributing to team goals on the roadmap by going through the entire product development lifecycle discovery, design, implementation, and delivery.
  • Participate in our on-call rotation.

📅 Within six months, you will…

  • Be defining long-term technical vision and strategies for new product development, scaling existing services, and managing technical debt. These plans will consist of multiple smaller milestones that you will deliver iteratively with the team.
  • Collaborate with the Engineering Manager on defining the team’s growth strategy based on the long-term product vision, the technical vision, and the team’s needs.
  • Seek feedback from customers and stakeholders to identify opportunities for further improvements or new features, actively iterating on the Cloud infrastructure to ensure it continues to meet our high bar.

About you

You bring a product mindset in balancing architectural flexibility and philosophy with meeting immediate customer demand. You are an experienced software engineer who seeks to solve problems by writing code rather than through one-off operations. You are passionate about user experience and self-service. You balance maintaining and designing high-impact systems with a pragmatic understanding of how to make appropriate tradeoffs (e.g., cut scope, low-tech vs. custom complex solutions) to ship quickly and iterate when necessary.

Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in Go, or other strongly typed languages.
  • Knowledge in one of the public cloud platform providers (GCP, AWS, Azure)
  • Experience with Terraform (or similar IaC solutions) and Kubernetes to build tooling and automation.
  • Skilled at debugging distributed systems, followed by designing and implementing solutions to those problems. This means you should know your way around various OS-level primitives, e.g., network, CPU, and memory.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and empathetically, especially in writing and documentation.
  • Preferred time zone between UTC-8 and UTC+2

Nice to haves:

  • Built services and exposed them as API for external consumption (e.g., gRPC).
  • Comfortable implementing system-level software (e.g., custom transport protocol) if needed or has contributed to Kubernetes controllers/operators.
  • Published blog posts and/or tech talks about your work.
  • Experience working on small high-performing teams, preferably tech startups.

Level

📊 This job is an IC3. You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

Compensation

💸 We pay above-market salaries because we want to hire exceptional people who can focus on building great products, not worrying about paying bills. As an open and transparent company, our compensation philosophy and pay bands are visible to every Sourcegraph teammate, and we strive to make our approach equitable, explainable, and competitive.

Your base salary is determined by the IC3 pay band for your location zone (1-4). Our pay bands are informed by market data and designed to ensure competitive compensation wherever you live. During the recruiting process, we'll discuss the range applicable to you based on job level, relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and location zone.

💰The starting salary for the IC3 pay band in each zone is:

  • Zone 2: $148,000 USD
  • Zone 3: $111,000 USD
  • Zone 4: $74,000 USD

📈 In addition to competitive cash compensation, we offer meaningful equity (because when Sourcegraph succeeds, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.

Interview process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all!

We expect the interview process to take 4.75 hours in total.

👋 Introduction Stage - we have initial conversations to get to know you better…

  • [30m] Recruiter Screen
  • [30m] Hiring Manager Screen

🧑‍💻 Team Interview Stage - we then delve into your experience in more depth and introduce you to members of the team, including cross-functional partners…

  • [Async] Take-home exercise
  • [60m] Take-home exercise walkthrough + System Design
  • [60m] Pairing Exercise
  • [60m] Resume Deep Dive
  • [60m] Cross-functional Team Collaboration Interview / Values Interview

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically…

  • [30m] Leadership
  • We check references and conduct your background check

Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.

Learn more about us

You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.

We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.

Sourcegraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

Sourcegraph participates in E-Verify for U.S. Employees.

jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION OF RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Processing and Preparing Manuscript Submissions for Peer Review: Monitor EIDs manuscript submission portal for new and revised manuscript submissions; Check for application of journal submission guidelines based on author-selected article type; Add line counts and double line spacing to articles when needed; Ensure the journals Author Checklist is complete and submitted with each article; Re-order author files as necessary to comply with journal style; Establish that all author submitted files display fully and without error in articles PDF view,, including resaving problematic figures as needed to provide correct visual for reviewer use. ; Resave tables with excessive page breaks or length at a reduced size and alternative page orientation for readability.
  • Supporting Copy Editors Assigned to Accepted Articles: Processing papers upon preliminary eXtyles software training; Authenticating references and formatting tables; Proofreading support include, but is not limited to, journal style adherence, grammar, spelling accuracy, confirmation of editorial changes made or needed, and flagging of inconsistencies in order, quality, appearance, counts, etc. of figures, tables, or videos supporting each article.
  • Supporting EIDs Manuscript Submission Process: Assisting authors, associate editors, and peer reviewers with their accounts in EIDs ScholarOne/Manuscript Central submission portal by verifying email and account name information, documenting issues; and informing the editor-in-chief, deputy editor-in-chief, or managing editor of the issues via an email as necessary; Documenting inquiries from authors concerning status of their manuscripts; Receiving new or revised files directly from authors linked to papers in progress and adding them to submitted manuscripts or routing them to copy editor assigned; Forwarding emails to appropriate staff regarding journal submissions questions or corrections; Responding to phone calls and emails related to customer inquiries, mailing lists, or other aspects of EIDs operations by answering questions or offering guidance within one business day; Collecting information needed to fix issues; Informing the managing editor of problems or issues that require his or her intervention; Performing day-to-day peer review coordination by checking the new submissions received daily in ScholarOne to ensure EIDs requirements for formatting, word count, and graphics standards are met; Advancing for review those submissions that adhere to the critical guidelines for manuscripts; Notifying the editor-in-chief via email of the precise nature of any major problems with the submission so he or she can determine whether to reject, assign, or return the submission to the authors for correction.
  • Supporting the Journal Administrator in the maintenance of multiple mailing lists for the annual EID Calendar distribution: Responding to requests for address changes and additions and then making these changes in the associated Excel documents and/or in ScholarOne accounts when applicable; Cleaning up the Excel reports from ScholarOne run annually to capture names, emails, and addresses of reviewers for the current year by removing duplicate entries, adding missing key address details and resolving address contradictions while making necessary updates to related ScholarOne accounts as needed. Managing bounce backs when calendars are not delivered by attempting to contact subscribers one time via email for correct address and remove from lists if no response is received.
  • Other Areas Requiring Support for Journal Administrator: Responding to messages related to undeliverable emails generated by ScholarOne by contacting the account creator for correction and resending the previously undelivered email after making the address correction in ScholarOne; Forwarding the Editorial Assistants response to any author inquiry on a manuscript overdue by one day or more to the Journal Administrator to add to the weekly report to the deputy editor-in-chief; Providing date extensions to Copy Editor or Production Checklists as needed; Running select ScholarOne reports identified by the Journal Administrator; Assigning accepted manuscripts for publication to copy editors upon request; Monitoring the journals EIDeditor mailbox on a rotating schedule.
  • Meeting attendance when Working Remote: Planning availability to attend weekly Team Staff Meetings on Thursday (with a monthly meeting option on the CDC campus if local); Attending monthly Production and Copy Editor Meetings.
  • Clerical and Office Tasks: Supporting the editor-in-chief, deputy editor-in-chief, and managing editor by scheduling and preparing for meetings, organizing files, assisting with correspondence, and carrying out other similar tasks; Preparing handouts, agendas, and other materials for staff meetings, projects, and presentations; Securing meeting spaces for regular EID staff meetings and special meetings; Faxing, copying, and preparing materials upon request; Keeping notes when needed for high-level meetings; Responding to requests for sourcing needed office supplies. Handling special shipping needs (e.g., FedEx, UPS), by preparing shipping labels and arranging drop-off of shipments at the appropriate pick-up locations. Assisting with inventory maintenance record of past printed journals by volume/issue; Ensuring stock of journals is safely stored in archives for future inventory counts.
  • Supporting EIDs Communications and Production Activities: Creating letters to an articles Corresponding Author for upcoming podcasts; Working with EID production staff to review and proofread images, tables, photographs, maps, and other graphics; Working with production staff by proofreading PDFs of journal contents; Proofreading correspondences, communications materials, presentation materials, and other content upon request; Maintaining spreadsheet directory of information for EIDs cover art.

REQUIRED DEGREE/EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION:

  • A degree in journalism, English, communications, or science is preferred.
  • Those with experience in scientific publishing and/or project management could be considered.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Active communication is essential for this remote position, requiring a self-directed candidate who is both process-driven and practices open communication with all journal staff, including asking questions and sharing insights.
  • Ability to meet deadlines consistently, prioritize assignments, and handle both incoming inquiries about the processes of the EID journal.
  • The ideal candidate is detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills.

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience in scientific/technical/medical proofreading is a plus.
  • Expert command of language, grammar, and syntax is desired.
  • Experience using Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.) is desired.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are desired.
  • Flexibility and team-player mentality is desired.

jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEWA thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is scaling and maturing our audience engagement practice into a unified, data-driven, cross-platform growth and engagement engine, and lifecycle management is at the center of that transformation. This role owns the lifecycle activation tools, with a mandate to replace manual, campaign-by-campaign execution with scalable, AI-enabled (where appropriate) processes, and their work focuses on key touchpoints of engagement such as email acquisition, repeat engagement and donation conversion/retention. This role works in daily partnership with Data, Editorial, Marketing, Design, Engineering and Product teams with a mission to make every relationship touchpoint personalized, measurable, user-friendly and tied to business outcomes.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Lead the product roadmap for NPR's audience lifecycle and martech ecosystem (including Piano.io and Salesforce Marketing Cloud), translating stakeholder requirements into prioritized engineering backlogs.
  • Martech Operationalization & Tooling: Build, configure, and operationalize internal-facing audience activation tools, establishing intuitive self-serve processes, user permissions, and governance guardrails for content and marketing leads.
  • Audience Journey Optimization: Partner with cross-divisional teams to design scalable automation rules and capabilities that enhance the full listener journey—from email discovery and content re-engagement to recurring donation conversion and win-back.
  • Data Integration & Measurement Alignment: Collaborate with Data and Analytics teams to enhance customer data platform (CDP) segmentation, tracking taxonomy, and attribution modeling to measure the direct impact of activation campaigns.
  • Newsletter Product Infrastructure: Drive technical development and platform enhancements for the NPR editorial newsletter suite in close coordination with newsroom and product leadership.
  • AI & Workflow Efficiency Integration: Evaluate and deploy practical, responsible AI and automation capabilities within lifecycle workflows to minimize repetitive manual execution.
  • Diverse Audience Engagement: Support audience diversification goals by designing personalization and segmentation workflows that welcome and sustain cross-generational and diverse audiences across digital touchpoints.
  • Standard Operating Procedures & Enablement: Author product documentation, establish lifecycle governance best practices, and conduct internal training sessions to ensure cross-departmental adoption of activation tools.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of digital product management experience managing complex platforms, with a track record of driving measurable business or audience outcomes.
  • Substantive experience managing enterprise marketing automation platforms, customer data platforms (CDPs), or audience lifecycle suites (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Piano.io, Braze, Segment).
  • Demonstrated experience translating complex cross-departmental requirements into structured user stories, technical specifications, and prioritized roadmaps.
  • Proven track record leading technical software migrations, vendor integrations, or enterprise tooling rollouts.
  • Strong background in data-informed product development, including experience with digital analytics, cohort tracking, and structured A/B testing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience within a media organization, digital publishing company, non-profit, or subscription/membership-driven enterprise.
  • Practical experience implementing AI-enabled automation or algorithmic segmentation within marketing workflows.
  • Familiarity with user privacy regulations, consent frameworks, and modern consumer data compliance standards.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Systems Thinking: Ability to synthesize inputs from across a federated matrix of stakeholders into a coherent product architecture and execution plan.
  • Internal Tool & Platform Enablement: Deep empathy for internal users, balancing self-service flexibility with structured organizational guardrails.
  • Data Literacy & Attribution: Fluency in customer segmentation logic, data pipelines, retention funnels, and performance reporting.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Superior written and oral presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
  • Iterative Problem Solving: Ability to prioritize high-leverage product enhancements and maintain roadmaps through periods of organizational or technical evolution.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Marketing, or related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent technical and product management capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

jobs.description:
Job Summary

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.

The Senior Director, Business Development will own new business development for Fuze Health, building and managing a pipeline of pharmaceutical manufacturer partners interested in alternative channel, hub services, and pharmacy programs. Reporting to the VP of Business Development & Partnerships, this person will be responsible for transitioning existing relationships and deals in flight, sourcing new opportunities, running the sales process end-to-end, and closing manufacturer relationships that expand Fuze Health’s footprint in the specialty and alternative channel pharmacy space.



Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a qualified new-business pipeline of pharmaceutical manufacturer prospects for hub services, specialty pharmacy, and alternative channel (DTP/DTE) programs.

  • Prospect and cultivate relationships with manufacturer decision-makers, including commercial, trade, and market access leadership.

  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, and contract close.

  • Develop and deliver compelling proposals and presentations that translate manufacturer needs into Fuze Health’s service offerings.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Pharmacy & Hub Operations, Clinical Services, Legal, and Finance to structure deals that are operationally and financially sound.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting in the CRM; provide regular updates to the VP of Business Development.

  • Track industry trends, competitive activity, and regulatory developments affecting alternative channel and hub services models.

  • Represent Fuze Health at industry conferences and manufacturer-facing events to build brand awareness and generate leads.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of business development, sales, or partnerships experience in pharmaceutical manufacturer services, specialty pharmacy, or hub services, with prior experience at the Director level or above.

  • Working knowledge of alternative channel models, including DTP and DTE program design.

  • Demonstrated track record of sourcing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with pharmaceutical manufacturers.

  • Strong understanding of pharmacy operations, trade/distribution, or patient access services.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to senior manufacturer stakeholders.

  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment.

  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with prospects and partners.

  • Undergraduate degree

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA or Masters with focus on healthcare

  • Existing relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturer commercial, trade, or market access teams.

  • Experience selling into or partnering with specialty pharmacies, 3PLs, or patient hub providers.

  • Prior experience at a growth-stage healthcare services or pharma services company.



Additional Information

Additional Physical Job Requirements

Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. The role also requires the ability to effectively communicate through verbal interactions, discern auditory information, and visually perceive details to perform essential job functions.


Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and similar applicable state laws, it is Fuze Health’s policy to provide reasonable accommodation to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship.


This position requires occasional travel therefore you must be able to sit for extended periods of time on airplanes and/or in vehicles, lift and carry luggage independently, navigate long distances through airports and other travel locations independently, and adjust to different time zones and climates.


Salary and Benefits –

Salary Range: $144,000 - $180,000

Commission Eligible: Yes

Travel: Yes - Required up to 40% of the time

Location Requirement:

  • Fuze Health is limited to individuals residing in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Vermont, Virginia, Washington (WA), Wisconsin

  • Contribute to portfolio discussions with a focus on alpha generation, downside risk, and risk-adjusted return potential.

Research Diligence, Market Monitoring & External Engagement:

  • Maintain current knowledge of developments affecting covered companies, relevant industries, competitors, and broader market conditions.

  • Conduct ongoing due diligence through earnings calls, regulatory filings, industry publications, channel checks, expert conversations, and other primary and secondary research sources, as appropriate.

  • Develop and maintain productive research relationships with company management teams, investor relations professionals, and industry contacts.

  • Prepare concise written materials and verbal presentations summarizing research findings, investment theses, and portfolio implications for internal discussion.

Technology, Data & Research Process Enhancement:

  • Use Excel and relevant investment research platforms effectively to support modeling, valuation, screening, monitoring, and investment documentation.

  • Incorporate AI-enabled tools and workflows into the research process to enhance efficiency in information synthesis, document review, workflow automation, and idea development, while applying sound judgment and source validation.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of research templates, monitoring processes, and analytical workflows that strengthen the team’s overall investment process.

Qualifications, Skills and Requirements:

  • Demonstrated passion for long-term investing and bottom-up fundamental research.

  • Strong financial statement analysis, DCF valuation knowledge, and financial modeling skills.

  • Ability to assess business quality, competitive advantage, management execution, capital allocation, and long-term value creation.

  • Sound business judgment and the ability to form independent, evidence-based investment views.

  • Intellectual curiosity, skepticism, initiative, and a desire to generate differentiated insights rather than rely on consensus views.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex analysis into clear, decision-useful conclusions.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a high-accountability, team-oriented investment environment.

  • High attention to detail, strong organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic market environment.

  • Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with common investment research tools and data platforms; experience with Bloomberg, FactSet, or similar systems is preferred.

  • Practical ability and willingness to use AI tools productively within the investment research workflow; experience with LLM-based research, prompt design, or workflow automation is a plus, but not a substitute for fundamental judgment.

Education, Training and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.

  • Two to Five years of relevant experience in buy-side or sell-side equity research, investment management, or a comparable analytically rigorous role.

  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining financial models and valuation analysis.

  • Experience covering or analyzing public companies and translating research into investment recommendations.

  • Advanced degree or CFA designation is a plus.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Position Title: Corporate Relations & Exhibits Manager

Department: Exhibits

Reports to: Events Director

About the Organization:The American Association of Critical-Care Nurses (AACN) is the largest specialty nursing organization in the world, representing the interests of more than 550,000 nurses who are charged with caring for acutely and critically ill patients. AACN is dedicated to creating a healthcare system driven by the needs of patients and families where acute and critical care nurses make their optimal contribution.Visit us online at.

AACN is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination against or harassment of any person employed by or seeking employment with AACN on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex and gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions, gender identity, gender expression, and sexual orientation), ancestry, national origin, age (40 or older), disability (mental and physical), military or veteran status, marital status, medical condition, or genetic information and any other basis protected by federal, state or local law or ordinance or regulation.

Application Instructions:Interested individuals can visit ourCareers Pageand apply for theCorporate Relations & Exhibits Managerrole. Any questions can be directed to:. This position is remote. Some travel is required.

Position Purpose:The Corporate Relations & Exhibits Manager provides strategic leadership for the exhibits team, driving the growth and execution of AACN’s National Teaching Institute & Critical Care Exposition® (NTI). Accountable for the full sales lifecycle of exhibits and corporate sponsorships, this role manages partner relationships, oversees financial budgeting, and implements efficient systems to deliver an exceptional exhibitor experience. This position serves as the primary liaison for corporate partners and is responsible for optimizing show management to ensure both commercial success and operational excellence.

This role has strategic ownership of the exhibits and sponsorship growth strategy within NTI, translating organizational priorities and market opportunities into strategies and plans that drive revenue growth, exhibitor engagement, and sponsorship performance. The role has accountability for revenue forecasting and variance management, cost forecasting and variance management, cost containment strategies and efficiencies; revenue-maximizing and enhancement strategies; alignment with strategic roadmap and business priorities.

Main Accountabilities & Results:

  • Provides revenue and business development leadership of NTI exhibits and sponsorships.

    • Leads revenue forecasting and monitors exhibit and sponsorship performance against established goals, analyzing trends and variances and identifying actions to maximize revenue and improve financial performance.

    • Develops annual business plans and strategic recommendations for exhibits and sponsorships, aligning revenue opportunities, customer needs, market conditions, and operational priorities with AACN's strategic direction.

    • Builds and maintains strategic industry alliances, corporate relationships, and partnerships that drive revenue growth and expand exhibit and sponsorship opportunities.

  • Leads financial and operational management of exhibit and sponsorship programs.

    • Leads financial planning and ongoing budget management for exhibits and sponsorship programs, including revenue forecasting, expense management, variance analysis, and identification of opportunities to maximize revenue and improve financial performance.

    • Monitors financial performance against established goals and develops corrective actions to address revenue, expense, and profitability variances.

    • Accountable for achieving annual exhibit and sponsorship revenue targets and managing associated program expenses.

    • Negotiates and manages contracts and agreements with exhibitors, sponsors, vendors, and other corporate partners within established organizational guidelines.

    • Identifies and mitigates financial, operational, vendor, and customer experience risks associated with exhibits and sponsorship programs.

    • Makes decisions regarding exhibit and sponsorship priorities, sales approaches, resource allocation, processes, and customer experience within established organizational goals, policies, and budget parameters.

  • Provides leadership of the exhibits team.

    • Builds and improves team eﬀectiveness. Assures integration of team norms into the work processes and relationships.

    • Develops positive, working relationships among AACN team members to optimize organizational outcomes and increase matrix team eﬀectiveness.

    • Provides for eﬀective leadership in developing and maintaining optimum team function through coaching, modeling, and creating opportunities for individual and group development.

  • Leads cross-functional projects as assigned, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities, effective resource utilization, and successful delivery of intended outcomes.

    • Gathers, analyzes, and leverages exhibitor and sponsor feedback, market insights, and performance data to identify opportunities and implement improvements that strengthen engagement, retention, and the overall customer experience.

    • Develops and manages strategic relationships with third-party vendors supporting exhibit sales and services; evaluates performance, identifies opportunities for improvement, and ensures vendor partnerships deliver quality, value, and business results.

    • Identifies, evaluates, and implements innovative strategies, processes, and approaches to increase exhibit and sponsorship sales, strengthen market positioning, and improve business performance.

    • Develops new business opportunities by identifying and cultivating prospective exhibitors, sponsors, corporate partners, events, and other revenue-generating opportunities aligned with AACN priorities.

    • Provides oversight and coordination of outsourced advertising sales activities, monitoring performance, aligning priorities and sales objectives, and addressing opportunities or issues to support revenue goals and partner outcomes.

    • Monitors industry trends, competitive activity, customer needs, and market opportunities to inform exhibit and sponsorship strategies and identify opportunities for growth and innovation.

    • Identifies, assesses, and mitigates financial, operational, vendor, and customer experience risks associated with exhibit and sponsorship programs.

    • Upholds the organization’s talent philosophy and values.

    • Performs other duties as assigned.

Skills Required:

  • Demonstrated sales leadership and business development experience, with the ability to develop and execute strategies that grow exhibit sales, sponsorship revenue, corporate partnerships, and customer engagement.

  • Strong consultative sales, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to understand customer and partner needs, develop compelling solutions, negotiate effectively, and cultivate long-term relationships with exhibitors, sponsors, corporate partners, and vendors.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategies and business plans that translate organizational priorities, market opportunities, customer insights, and industry trends into measurable revenue and business outcomes.

  • Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to analyze sales, financial, customer, and market data; identify trends, risks, and opportunities; and use insights to inform decisions and improve performance.

  • Experience managing revenue, budgets, resources, and competing priorities, including revenue forecasting, financial performance monitoring, variance analysis, and identification of opportunities to maximize revenue and improve efficiency.

  • Ability to make sound decisions and exercise independent judgment regarding sales strategies, resource allocation, processes, priorities, customer and partner needs, and operational issues within established organizational guidelines.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed environment, influence stakeholders, align priorities and resources, and drive successful outcomes across functions and organizational levels.

  • Ability to lead and optimize systems, processes, and workflows, using data and technology to improve sales effectiveness, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business results.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex relationships and business partnerships, including third-party vendors and external stakeholders, while balancing customer needs, organizational objectives, financial considerations, and operational requirements.

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to present recommendations, communicate complex information clearly, facilitate productive discussions, and influence decisions with diverse audiences.

  • Proficiency with Google Suite and Microsoft Office Suite, with the ability to use technology and data effectively to support planning, analysis, communication, and business decisions. As well as Asana and Personify/a2z platforms.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or a related field. Certified Exhibition Management (CEM) and/or Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) strongly preferred.

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in exhibits and sponsorship sales within associations, nonprofits, professional societies, membership organizations, or related environments.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing strategies to maintain and grow exhibitor participation, engagement, and retention.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing strategies to manage and grow event sponsorship programs and revenue.

  • Experience managing budgets, resources, and complex projects, with an understanding of financial performance, revenue goals, and resource allocation.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, complex projects, and competing deadlines while exercising sound judgment and achieving established outcomes.

  • Strong relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and customer service skills, with the ability to build and maintain productive relationships with corporate partners, exhibitors, sponsors, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Physical Requirements:

The demands described here represent those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential responsibilities of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Frequent walking and standing may be required, particularly during conferences, exhibitions, and other events. The position may require prolonged periods of standing and walking on exhibit floors and interacting with exhibitors, sponsors, vendors, and attendees. The position also requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods, communicate and interact with others in person, by phone, and electronically, and operate standard office equipment and keyboard. Requires mental stamina for problem solving, prioritizing multiple tasks, interpreting and applying oral and written instructions, and responding effectively in a fast-paced event environment. Ability to travel is required.

Total Compensation:

The target pay range for this role is$137,977 - $172,472

** We offer a 37.5-hour workweek with 3 different schedule options. In addition to the salary range listed, we offer a wealth of benefits to make working at AACN even more rewarding. Benefits include generous paid time off, low-cost health plans for medical and mental health services, dental, and vision, company-paid life and short-term disability insurance, a variety of other benefits, and a retirement savings program with employer matching and additional company contribution. AACN is committed to a people-centered culture of workplace excellence and belonging, and offers various alternative and flexible work arrangements to support work/life balance for our team members.

Бонуси за досягнення.

jobs.description:
About xCures

The best of medicine should belong to everyone. Nobody dreams of becoming good at being a patient. We have people to love, things we want to do, and plans we hope to keep. Illness already asks enough of us.

xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people.

xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from.

Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful.

We are building for the lives people want to live.

Here’s Where You’ll Make An Impact:

xCures is deepening its work with chronic care programs and telehealth channel partners, and this role puts a clinician at the center of it. Reporting to the Vice President of Scientific and Medical Affairs, you will be the clinical voice in those partner relationships. You will speak directly with clinicians and clinically trained leaders on the partner side, peer to peer. You will translate what their care teams need into what the xCures Clinical Clarity Engine can deliver, then carry it back to the platform teams. The reach goes well beyond any single clinic.

The platform supports care for thousands of patients across the country every day, and your judgment shapes how that history reaches decision-makers. If you want your clinical experience to influence care at that scale, this is where you will make that impact.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the clinical liaison across chronic care and telehealth channel partner relationships, defining data needs, setting expectations, and translating clinical and operational requirements into workable plans that fit platform capabilities.
  • Act as the subject matter expert on chronic disease management and clinical data during partner meetings and external engagements.
  • Lead partner conversations on data quality and extractor validation, explaining how the Clinical Clarity Engine surfaces the chronic disease history a care team needs (diagnoses, medications, labs, comorbidities), with every data point traced to its source document.
  • Support partner programs by advising on the interpretation, provenance, and internal use of the clinical data the platform produces through its validated extractors.
  • Bring partner requirements to internal Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to shape chronic care features and data offerings.
  • Collaborate with channel partners on case studies of new and emerging health technology, and lead joint publications and thought leadership with partners and external clinicians.
  • Represent xCures at conferences and health tech venues, presenting how the platform advances chronic care through emerging health technology, in support of the business development team.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Active clinical licensure as a Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA); an MD, DO, or other advanced clinical degree also qualifies.
  • Superior written and verbal communication, with the credibility to lead the conversation when presenting to senior executives at health systems and technology companies.
  • Working knowledge of chronic disease management across common conditions (e.g., diabetes, cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease).
  • 4+ years of combined clinical practice and stakeholder-facing experience (medical affairs, clinical liaison, or clinical program roles).
  • Ability to translate complex clinical and scientific concepts into clear, actionable guidance for diverse audiences.
  • Working knowledge of electronic medical records and the healthcare data landscape (e.g., HIE, QHIN, TEFCA).
  • Understanding of data quality principles, validation processes, and how to assess the provenance and limits of clinical data.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders, including clinical leaders, executives, and internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Product, Engineering, Business Development).
  • Track record of managing multiple complex, unrelated projects at once, with strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Comfort working remotely and with virtual collaboration platforms.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, growth-phase startup environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Direct clinical experience caring for patients with chronic conditions.
  • Experience working with structured clinical data.
  • Experience supporting telehealth or virtual care organizations, or working within a channel partner model.
  • Familiarity with value-based care, population health, or chronic care management programs.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory landscape governing clinical data use in healthcare.

Location

jobs.description:
Corporate Governance & Company Secretarial Specialist

ACE Money Transfer | ACE Group

1. About the Role

ACE Money Transfer is looking for an organised, detail-driven Corporate Governance & Company Secretarial Specialist to support our Legal Manager and Company Secretary in managing corporate governance, statutory compliance and board activities across the Group.

You will handle the documentation, tracking and coordination that keep governance processes running smoothly. That includes supporting board and committee meetings, helping with statutory filings and registers, tracking compliance deadlines and maintaining governance and policy records. You will work with Ireland and UK governance requirements and coordinate with internal departments, auditors and regulators.

The role is central to keeping ACE well governed, compliant and audit-ready. It suits a governance professional who enjoys structure, accuracy and seeing every action through to completion.

2. Responsibilities

Board & Committee Support

  • Help schedule board and committee meetings and coordinate attendance.
  • Support the preparation and formatting of board packs.
  • Compile and circulate documents within agreed timelines.
  • Take draft minutes during meetings and help format the final versions.
  • Maintain meeting records, attendance logs and action trackers.

Governance & Compliance Support

  • Maintain governance calendars for Ireland and the UK, where applicable.
  • Track compliance deadlines and send reminders to relevant stakeholders.
  • Help prepare governance reports and updates.
  • Support the coordination of board evaluations and governance reviews.

Statutory Filings & Corporate Records

  • Help prepare and submit statutory filings, such as Companies Registration Office (CRO) filings in Ireland.
  • Maintain and update statutory registers, including directors, shareholders and others.
  • Keep corporate records accurate, organised and up to date.
  • Support the upkeep of document repositories and filing systems.

Legal & Policy Documentation

  • Draft basic corporate documents, including board resolutions, meeting minutes, and standard forms and templates.
  • Track document status and follow up on pending approvals.
  • Maintain logs of legal and governance documents.
  • Help the Legal Manager and Company Secretary coordinate the drafting and review of corporate policies.
  • Keep central records of all policies at Group and entity level.
  • Track policy renewals, approvals and adoptions, making sure updates are timely and versions are controlled.

Risk & Compliance Tracking

  • Maintain governance trackers, such as compliance logs and risk registers.
  • Follow up with internal stakeholders on outstanding actions.
  • Escalate overdue items to the Company Secretary when needed.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate with internal departments to collect governance inputs.
  • Log and track queries from auditors, regulators and internal teams.
  • Make sure responses are followed up and properly documented.

Reporting & Administration

  • Help prepare periodic governance and compliance reports.
  • Keep reporting schedules aligned with board timelines.
  • Make sure all documentation is accurate and complete.

Process & Documentation Management

  • Maintain standard templates for governance documents.
  • Keep documents properly organised and under version control.
  • Support continuous improvement of administrative processes.
  • Help the Company Secretary maintain custody of all governance and policy documents, keeping records accurate and accessible.

3. Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Law, Finance or a related field.
  • Working towards, or committed to pursuing, a Company Secretary or governance qualification is desirable, for example ICSA / CGI, ICSP or equivalent.
  • 3–4 years of experience in corporate governance, company secretarial support, legal or compliance roles.
  • Experience in a structured, deadline-driven corporate environment.
  • Proven experience handling documentation and trackers and coordinating multiple tasks at once.
  • Working understanding of corporate governance and compliance processes. Exposure to Irish or UK company law requirements is an advantage.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong document formatting and professional writing skills.
  • Experience managing trackers, logs and calendars with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong document management and record-keeping skills.

Soft Skills & Leadership

  • Organisation and time management: able to manage several deadlines at once.
  • Attention to detail: consistently accurate in every output.
  • Ownership: sees work through to completion without close supervision.
  • Stakeholder coordination: confident coordinating and following up with stakeholders.
  • Communication: clear, professional written and verbal communication.
  • Proactive approach: anticipates needs and raises issues early.
  • Resilience: works well under pressure and stays consistent during busy periods.
  • Discretion and professionalism: handles confidential information with integrity.

4. Job Details

  • Location: Lahore / Karachi / Islamabad, Pakistan
  • Job Type: Onsite / Remote
  • Working Hours / Shift: 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM PKT
  • Department: Legal & Company Secretarial
  • Reports to: Legal Manager and Company Secretary

5. About ACE Money Transfer

ACE Money Transfer is a UK-based multinational fintech headquartered in Manchester, United Kingdom. We provide fast, secure and affordable online remittance services to customers in 29 countries across the UK, Europe, Canada and Australia, and we enable cross-border money transfers to 100+ countries worldwide.

Every day, our platform helps people support their families, pay for education and build better futures across borders. As part of the wider ACE Group, we combine a fast-paced growth culture with strong regulatory standards and a commitment to innovation in digital payments.

At ACE you will work with talented, diverse teams across multiple regions and take real ownership of work that matters. You will also help shape the future of global money movement.

Method is part of GlobalLogic, a digital product engineering company. GlobalLogic integrates experience design and complex engineering to help our clients imagine what’s possible and accelerate their transition into tomorrow’s digital businesses. GlobalLogic is a Hitachi Group Company.

About This Opportunity

This is a proactive posting to help us build our network of talented contractors for anticipated project needs later this year. While we don’t have an active project for this role today, we expect opportunities to arise as our client and project needs evolve.

By applying, you’ll be considered for future contract and project-based opportunities that align with your skills, experience, and areas of expertise. Our Talent team will review your background and keep your information on hand, and we’ll reach out directly if an upcoming project looks like a strong match.

Because these opportunities are project-based, timing, scope, duration, and hours may vary depending on the specific engagement. For this type of work, we typically anticipate hourly rates in the range of $84-$127/hour, depending on the project scope, required expertise, and experience level. Specific project details and the applicable rate will be discussed with you when we connect about a potential opportunity.

About Our Team

Our Product Design team works closely with Method clients and team members – Product, Development, and QA – to conceptualize and craft seamless user experiences that support business objectives.

You will be involved in product strategy from the very beginning, offering your knowledge and unique expertise to help shape product direction and turn ideas and concepts into a workable design. You will produce wireframes, prototypes, style guides and hi-fidelity designs to explore, experiment and ultimately advocate for simple, elegant solutions to complex problems.

You must be able to balance pixel-perfect attention to detail with low-fidelity design choices. At Method, we firmly believe that user feedback and data evolve products. Meetings and presentations are necessary to build consensus and achieve buy-in, but working software is the ultimate validation of any single approach.

Qualifications:

  • Experience leading the design efforts for one or more successful – successfully shipped or successfully downloaded – online or mobile products. You know great UX, and you can walk us through your portfolio and tell a compelling story about the hard decisions and compromises you had to make along the way.
  • Strong understanding of HTML, Javascript, and CSS. You won’t necessarily be shipping production markup, styling, or code, but you see prototypes as just another means of communication. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.

We are seeking an experienced and creative Technical Program Manager - Remote (on-site travel as needed) - to join our dynamic program team. As a Technical Program Manager at Clarity Innovations, you will play a pivotal role in the development and success of the team products and projects. You will act as the bridge between our stakeholders, SOCOM development and program teams, and end users; to ensure the delivery of high-quality products and projects that meet both business and customer needs. This role requires a strategic mindset, unrelenting communication skills, and a passion for driving program excellence.

The Technical Program manager will work as an integral part of the team toward the following established overall goal: Building, expanding, and sustaining a resilient distributed command and control architecture leveraged across the cloud platform, gateway routing, cross-domain mechanisms, and USSOCOM programs of record.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the Program Vision: Clearly define and articulate the long-term vision and goals/deliverables for the program, aligning them with the overall mission support strategy and follow-on field support plan. Tell a compelling story for audiences of all levels including senior executives and commanders. Establish the program’s vision, strategy, outcome-driven integrated roadmap, and product/project/program backlog; including (1) sensor integration efforts, (2) resilient gateway routing solutions, (3) tactical data management, and (4) DevSecOps/cybersecurity/cloud support.

Facilitate and Communicate: Drive the narrative in both verbal and written communication. Facilitate meetings with team members and stakeholders, communicating effectively at the senior, most executive levels, using methods your audience will participate in. Communicate the program vision, strategy, integrated roadmap, and backlog to different audiences with a tailored message they will understand to ensure deliverables meet performance measures, on time, and within scope.

Decision Making and Problem Solving: Make timely and informed decisions on program supported features, scope, and priorities based on input from stakeholders, expert analysis, and feedback. Identify pain points and opportunities for the team and be proactive in actioning towards resolutions.

Work Prioritization: Lead and influence a balanced cross-functional team in daily activities to execute against a vision. Maintain and prioritize the program backlog, ensuring that it reflects the highest mission value and is aligned with the program vision.

User Story Creation: Document and package detailed operational requirements and experiences. Write clear and detailed user stories with acceptance criteria to communicate product/project requirements to the development team. Champion user-centered design philosophy within the internal product/project team and externally with customers. Collect requirements and manage the requirements traceability matrix for each project within the program.

Strategic Stakeholder Communication: Act as a bridge between stakeholders and the development team, ensuring that stakeholders' needs and expectations are understood and incorporated into the program backlog. Communicate sophisticated ideas, anticipating potential objections, and persuading others, often at senior levels, to adopt a different point of view.

Other Important Areas of Responsibility include:

Release/Deployment Planning ● Acceptance Testing ● Feedback Handling ● Risk Management ● Team Resource Management ● Lean Project Management ● Team Collaboration ● Quality Management

Minimum Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Business, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.)
  • At least 10 years of relevant work experience in Program/Product Management.
  • Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of Lean Project Management principles.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience with leading projects/programs from idea to market/IOC to FOC
  • Experience with user-centered design, concept and usability testing, and other research methods
  • Experience in stakeholder management, communication, and presentation
  • Experience working in a balanced team to build, measure, and learn
  • Experience working in a rapid and iterative development environment
  • Experience balancing customer and user feedback to create a desirable solutions
  • U.S. Citizenship: Must be eligible to hold a Common Access Card (CAC), and Secret security clearance is required

Preferred:

  • Knowledge of US Air Force emerging technologies
  • Experience providing input on program decisions through user research, customer development, and iterative feedback loops
  • Experience in the design and/or development of full-service applications
