Because this position may be performed in multiple locations and may be subject to different contract requirements, the salary ultimately offered may vary based on the applicable location and contract. The posted range is not a guarantee of a specific starting salary or an indication that an offer will be made at any particular point within the range.

Total Rewards

In addition to competitive base pay, Clarity provides a Total Rewards package designed to attract and retain exceptional professionals committed to excellence. Our benefits reflect the value we place on skilled individuals who drive our impact in critical digital missions.

At Clarity, a career means joining a high-performing team advancing vital work in the digital landscape. We encourage you to consider the total value of joining us—competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and resources that support your growth and impact.

Our Total Rewards package includes performance-based bonuses, extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, substantial paid time off and holidays, flexible work arrangements where possible, and a range of income protection benefits. We are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and ability to contribute to essential digital missions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Position Title: SCADA Engineer III – Critical Infrastructure

Position Location: Remote – United States; limited project-based travel required (On-site presence primarily for design reviews, FAT, IST, commissioning strategy, or critical technical escalations) OR Atlanta, GA OR Dallas, TX

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior SCADA Engineer – Level III is a high-level individual contributor responsible for designing, developing,

and supporting SCADA systems across mission-critical infrastructure projects.

This role focuses on system design, development, integration, and execution, operating under established

standards and architecture while contributing technical expertise across multiple projects. Senior SCADA Engineers

are expected to work independently on complex scopes while escalating higher-risk architectural decisions as

needed.

While predominantly remote, this role includes on-site engagement during critical milestones such as factory

acceptance testing (FAT), integrated systems testing (IST), commissioning, and high-risk troubleshooting events.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

SCADA System Design & Development (40%)

  • Design and develop SCADA systems in accordance with project requirements and STC standards
  • Translate design intent, sequences of operation, and operational requirements into maintainable SCADA configurations, scripts, and logic
  • Develop SCADA code, templates, and reusable components as assigned
  • Configure alarms, graphics, and data models consistent with established architecture
  • Review and refine SCADA implementations for performance, reliability, and consistency

Project and Cross-Discipline Coordination (25%)

  • Coordinate SCADA engineering efforts with Project Managers, Engineers, Field Leadership, and commissioning teams
  • Participate in design reviews, coordination meetings, and commissioning planning
  • Support integration with third-party systems, packaged equipment, and external vendors
  • Identify technical risks within assigned scope and propose mitigation strategies

Quality, Testing, & Commissioning Support (20%)

  • Support FAT, IST, and commissioning activities as required
  • Perform peer reviews of SCADA configurations and development work within assigned scope
  • Assist with troubleshooting during commissioning and live system cutovers

Mentorship & Technical Growth (15%)

  • Participate in knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

  • Strong understanding of:

o SCADA architecture and data modeling

o Alarm management and HMI/graphics philosophy

o System integration and communications

o Commissioning workflows, IST, and live cutovers

  • Ability to independently execute complex SCADA scopes with limited oversight
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable supporting multiple projects concurrently in a fast-paced environment

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential

functions.

Preferred (Not Required):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents

The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $11.40 - $23.80 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license.

  • Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test – National Component with Uniform State Content.

  • Physically located in and working remotely from Illinois.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO

The Consumer Marketing Analytics team provides powerful consulting along with key reporting and insightful analyses to the Hallmark Brand business. We focus on using data to understand our consumers, leveraging a vast number of sources to our advantage. We focus on complete storytelling to form an understanding of what has happened and use trends and analysis to drive future decisions. We are looking for motivated individuals who love exploring data to uncover hidden trends and developing new experiments to help meet our consumers where they are, with the right message, at the right time, and ultimately drive the business forward.

WHAT YOU’LL DO & HOW IT SHAPES OUR SUCCESS

The Privacy Governance Administrator serves as a key steward of Hallmark's privacy program across Hallmark Media and Hallmark Product & Retail, helping ensure privacy principles are embedded into business operations, technology decisions, and data practices. This role provides governance, oversight, and operational leadership across the privacy landscape, partnering closely with Legal, Information Security, Information Technology, Procurement, Data & Analytics, and business leaders to ensure personal data is managed responsibly, ethically, and in compliance with applicable laws and company policies.

You will drive the execution of critical privacy processes, including Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs), data inventories, and data mapping, privacy impact assessments, vendor privacy reviews, and ongoing privacy governance activities. Acting as a trusted advisor to business teams, you will apply sound judgment and risk-based decision making to help teams navigate complex privacy requirements while balancing business objectives, customer expectations, and regulatory obligations.

Success in this role requires strong discernment, attention to detail, and the ability to influence outcomes across a diverse stakeholder landscape. The ideal candidate excels at translating privacy requirements into practical business solutions, identifying and mitigating risk, and fostering accountability for responsible data practices throughout the organization. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about shaping how privacy is operationalized at scale, connecting people, processes, and technology to strengthen trust, enable innovation, and advance Hallmark's commitment to protecting consumer data.

What You'll Do:

Lead Privacy Risk, Compliance & Assessment Activities:

  • Lead Privacy Assessments (PAs), Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and other privacy reviews for products, technologies, vendors, and business processes.
  • Serve as a key privacy stakeholder in third-party risk management activities, partnering with Legal, Procurement, and Information Security.
  • Maintain oversight of privacy risks, remediation plans, and compliance obligations across the enterprise.
  • Monitor evolving privacy laws and regulations, translating requirements into actionable business guidance and operational controls.
  • Lead the coordination of audits, regulatory inquiries, and compliance reviews, driving timely remediation and ensuring identified privacy risks are addressed effectively.

Own Privacy Governance & Program Operations:

  • Drive the execution, governance, and continuous improvement of Hallmark's enterprise privacy program.
  • Partner across Legal, Information Security, Information Technology, Procurement, Marketing, Product, Media, Data & Analytics, and other business functions to embed privacy into business operations.
  • Lead Privacy Council operations, including governance decisions, action planning, and accountability tracking.
  • Maintain privacy policies, standards, procedures, operating practices, and governance documentation.
  • Develop privacy scorecards, metrics, and executive reporting that provide visibility into program health, risks, and performance.

Steward Data Governance & Privacy Transparency:

  • Govern records of processing activities, data inventories, data maps, and related privacy documentation within OneTrust.
  • Partner with business leaders, application owners, and data stewards to maintain an accurate understanding of how personal information is collected, used, shared, retained, and protected.
  • Ensure privacy records, controls, and governance processes evolve as new products, technologies, vendors, and business capabilities are introduced.

Own Data Subject Rights Operations:

  • Administer and continuously improve Hallmark's Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) and consumer rights processes.
  • Direct cross-functional efforts to identify, validate, collect, and deliver responsive information within regulatory timeframes.
  • Monitor volumes, trends, performance metrics, and compliance obligations to ensure a scalable and effective consumer rights program.

Advance Privacy Awareness & Incident Response:

  • Promote privacy awareness and responsible data stewardship throughout the organization.
  • Develop practical guidance and communications that help teams make informed privacy decisions.
  • Support the governance, investigation, documentation, and remediation of privacy incidents and data breaches.

Success in this role requires leadership through influence, strong judgment, and the ability to drive outcomes across a highly matrixed organization.

You will:

  • Exercise sound judgment and a risk-based approach when evaluating privacy issues and business decisions.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Legal, Security, Technology, Analytics, and business teams.
  • Drive accountability and execution across cross-functional initiatives.
  • Communicate complex privacy requirements in clear, practical business terms.
  • Balance regulatory obligations, business objectives, and consumer trust. Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen privacy controls, governance processes, and operational effectiveness.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • Bachelor's degree or 4 years of professional work experience.
  • At least 10 years of experience in data, analytics, data management, data governance, information management, compliance, risk management, or related disciplines.
  • At least 3 years of experience supporting or leading data privacy, compliance, privacy governance, privacy-by-design, data governance, or regulatory initiatives.
  • Experience managing projects or programs, including developing action plans, coordinating work across multiple stakeholders, tracking deliverables, and meeting established deadlines.
  • Experience leading cross-functional governance, compliance, operational, or transformation initiatives that require driving accountability, managing remediation activities, and influencing outcomes across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience documenting and analyzing data flows, system integrations, records of processing activities (ROPA), data maps, and the lifecycle of personal information across business processes and technology systems.
  • Ability to translate legal, regulatory, and policy requirements into practical business actions, operational controls, and process improvements.
  • Experience analyzing data, managing projects and priorities, resolving complex issues, and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Your resume will stand out if you have the following:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Management Information Systems, or a related data, technology, or business discipline.
  • Experience with OneTrust, including Data Mapping, Data Subject Rights (DSAR), Assessment Automation, and related privacy governance modules.
  • Experience supporting Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Privacy Assessments (PAs), vendor privacy reviews, privacy-by-design initiatives, or enterprise compliance programs.
  • Professional privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPM, CIPT, or equivalent.
  • Experience with privacy governance frameworks, records of processing activities, data inventories, consent management, or enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience working with modern data platforms and ecosystems, including cloud data platforms, customer data platforms (CDPs), data warehouses, or data governance technologies.
  • Familiarity with privacy and governance technologies such as OneTrust, TrustArc, BigID, Collibra, Alation, or related platforms.
  • Experience in retail, consumer products, media, entertainment, subscription businesses, or other data-intensive and consumer-focused industries.

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States. If based in Kansas City, this position offers a hybrid work arrangement, giving you the best of both worlds: collaborating in person at Hallmark Headquarters in Kansas City, MO and enjoying the flexibility of working remotely. Some meetings required in-person, many can be remote.
  • The salary range for this role is $104k - $130k. Final compensation varies based on several factors
  • This role is eligible for Hallmark’s Annual Incentive Plan. More information will be shared during the interview process.

Cayenta, a division of Harris; is seeking a Consulting Manager who will lead Cayenta CIS software implementation and professional services engagements from inception through go-live and stabilization.

This role manages a team of Application Consultants (AppCons) delivering utility and municipal customer information system (CIS) implementations - spanning billing, customer service, field operations, and integrations with adjacent systems such as Customer Self-Service Portal), MWM (mobile workforce management), and ERP/financial systems. This role drives delivery methodology, provides solution oversight, ensures projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, and maintains high client satisfaction across the utility and municipal client base.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean.

Salary:

90K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

Team Leadership, Mentorship & Resource Optimization

  • Lead, mentor, and coach Application Consultants (AppCons) and project resources across all consulting tiers to achieve project and business unit objectives.
  • Provide solution oversight across multiple concurrent Cayenta CIS implementations and mentor all consultants within that portfolio, with the goal of enhancing consultant skills to deliver the best possible project outcomes.
  • Allocate and balance AppCon resources across concurrent client engagements, optimizing utilization and billable ratios while preventing burnout - particularly during peak go-live and cutover periods.
  • Foster an agile, accountable team culture focused on problem-solving, continuous learning, and career growth within the Cayenta consulting tier structure.
  • Assist functional managers with mid-year and year-end performance evaluations (e.g., formal feedback through Workday).
  • Monitor overall team performance by tracking and analyzing statistics and trends (utilization, billability, ticket/incident volume in CayStone), providing reporting to the senior Management Team.

Implementation Methodology & Execution

  • Drive standard, repeatable delivery frameworks - including Cayenta's fit-to-standard configuration approach, pre-configured utility/municipal industry templates, and training-first user adoption - rather than defaulting to custom, waterfall-style delays.
  • Lead the effort on complex or "greenfield" CIS solutions and custom modifications on projects or in new markets (e.g., new utility types, new regulatory/rate environments, first-time integrations).
  • Review proposed solution architecture - including CIS configuration, integration design (CSS Portal, MWM, Financial Systems, AMI/MDM, IVR), and data conversion approach - for projects under their purview; able to influence internal and client resources when difficult decisions need to be made.
  • Own and drive continuous improvement of Cayenta's implementation methodology - evaluate what is and isn't working across active projects, partner with Directors on formal changes, revise methodology as agreed, update documentation, and train staff.
  • Lead client workshops to explain the Cayenta CIS product and gather requirements for configuration or customization as required.
  • Partner across departments (including Project Managers) to ensure smooth sales-to-services handoffs and seamless post-go-live transitions to Customer Support.
  • Conduct post-implementation retrospective summaries and coordinate handoffs per standard Cayenta methodology.

Financial & Budget Oversight

  • Establish, track, and manage Cayenta CIS implementation project budgets, cost estimations, and allocations.
  • Monitor project health, milestone completion, expected go-lives, and variance reporting to support monthly Estimate to Complete (ETC) aligned with percentage of completion (POC), in coordination with Finance.

Client Engagement & Escalation Management

  • Positively contribute to client relationship management with utility and municipal clients; coach project resources on good client relationship management (CRM) practices.
  • Maintain regular, transparent communication with executive sponsors (e.g., client VPs, Directors, CFOs/Controllers) and client steering committees, providing consistent status updates.
  • Proactively identify delivery risks (e.g., data conversion issues, integration defects, rate/billing configuration gaps), conduct mitigation planning (including implementation "pre-mortems"), coordinate change control documentation, and resolve client escalations swiftly.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships across the utility/municipal client portfolio.

Knowledge Sharing & Training

  • Apply broad knowledge across numerous Cayenta CIS client implementations and configurations to new situations - essentially "has seen it all" across utility and municipal deployments.
  • Be highly involved in planning and delivering internal training sessions for other Cayenta consultants, as well as the Harris user conference (as requested).

Operational Modernization & Efficiency

  • Champion modern, AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot, etc.) to streamline administrative burdens - such as Statement of Work drafting, status report generation, test case documentation, meeting summaries, and variance analysis - enabling the team to focus on proactive client delivery and strategic relationship management.
  • Develop and implement best practices, standards, and processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness of the Cayenta professional services team.

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in a professional services or consulting role, ideally within utility/municipal software implementations (CIS, billing, customer service, or related ERP/EAM systems).
  • 4+ years of experience in a senior/managing consultant role, with a track record across 4 or more complex CIS implementation projects (or 20+ successful upgrades) - or 2+ years of formal leadership experience for candidates coming from a people-management track.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent software implementation projects for utility or municipal clients.
  • Working knowledge of the utility customer-to-cash lifecycle (meter-to-cash, billing, collections, customer service) and/or public sector implementation environments.
  • Financial Acumen: Demonstrated capability in managing project P&L, budget forecasting, consultant utilization, and contract scope control.
  • Methodologies & Tools: Practical knowledge of software implementation methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid); experience with PSA/project and test management tools (e.g., Jira, CayStone/SpiraTest, ServiceNow, Power BI, Excel).
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage executive client relationships and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.

What would make you stand out:

  • Direct experience with Cayenta CIS or comparable utility/municipal CIS platforms.
  • Familiarity with adjacent Cayenta ecosystem products (SilverBlaze customer self-service portal, MWM mobile workforce management) and common client-side integrations (IFS, AMI/MDM, IVR, print/lockbox vendors).
  • Familiarity with modern productivity and AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar AI assistants) for reporting, plan generation, status reports, and workflow acceleration.
  • Comfort exploring and adopting new AI-enabled workflows to improve service delivery efficiency.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!

About Cayenta:

Cayenta is a leading provider of enterprise resource management solutions in the local government, utility and financial industries. Cayenta’s products, services and customer relationships provide the foundation for continued innovation and growth.

About Harris:

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a contract Digital Marketing Specialist to own and optimize our presence across the full ecosystem of third-party websites, portals, and partner platforms. This is a highly operational yet strategically important role: the way we appear on authorized training partner sites, technology vendor portals, and enterprise supplier platforms directly influences discoverability, credibility, and conversion for a significant portion of our business. You will be responsible for ensuring that our course catalog, training schedules, organizational profiles, and promotional content are accurate, complete, and competitively positioned across every external platform where buyers and partners encounter us. This role works in close coordination with the Partner Marketing Manager, Regional Marketing Leaders, Web Product Owner, and Sales teams to ensure external presence is current, on-brand, and optimized for performance.
Key Responsibilities
Authorized Training Partner Portal Management
  • Own the day-to-day management of our presence on authorized training partner platforms for vendors including Microsoft, AWS, Cisco, and other active partners — ensuring profiles, course listings, and organizational information are accurate and up to date at all times
  • Manage the regular upload and maintenance of training schedules across all authorized training partner sites, coordinating with internal scheduling, operations, and regional teams to ensure data accuracy and timeliness
  • Monitor partner portal guidelines and platform updates, proactively adjusting listings and content to remain compliant with partner program requirements and maximize visibility within each platform’s search and discovery features
  • Optimize course and program listings on partner portals for discoverability — applying best practices for titles, descriptions, keywords, categories, and metadata within the constraints of each platform
  • Track and report on performance metrics available within partner portals (e.g., profile views, listing impressions, click-through rates) and use insights to drive continuous improvement
Customer & Enterprise Supplier Portal Management
  • Manage our presence on enterprise customer supplier portals,
procurement platforms, and vendor management systems, ensuring our organizational profile, capability statements, and service offerings are complete, current, and competitively framed
  • Coordinate with Sales and Account Management teams to identify supplier portals where we are registered or should be registered, maintaining a comprehensive inventory of active platform relationships
  • Ensure that portal-specific content — including company descriptions, service categories, certifications, geographic coverage, and contact information — is optimized to support buyer discovery and procurement qualification
  • Monitor renewal cycles, compliance requirements, and registration deadlines across all active supplier portals, proactively flagging and resolving issues before they impact access or visibility
  • Work with internal stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Operations) as needed to gather documentation required for supplier portal registration, recertification, or profile updates
Third-Party Directory & Listing Management
  • Maintain and optimize our presence across third-party training
directories, review platforms, industry listings, and aggregator sites that influence buyer research and course discovery
  • Develop and implement a structured auditing process to regularly assess the accuracy, completeness, and quality of our listings across all active third-party platforms
  • Identify gaps in our third-party presence — including platforms where we are absent or underrepresented — and make recommendations for new registrations based on traffic, audience relevance, and partner program requirements
  • Manage customer review and ratings presence on applicable platforms, coordinating with the Customer Marketing Manager on strategies to encourage and respond to reviews where platform policies permit
  • Ensure consistency of brand name, logo usage, messaging, and contact information across all external platforms, flagging discrepancies and driving resolution
Content Coordination & Asset Management
  • Serve as the internal coordinator for all content and assets needed to populate and maintain third-party platforms — including course descriptions, instructor bios, promotional banners, logos, and certification badges
  • Partner with the Content Marketing Manager and Web Product Owner to adapt our content for use on external platforms, ensuring consistency of messaging while conforming to each platform’s format and character constraints
  • Maintain a centralized asset library and platform inventory that documents login credentials, content versions, update schedules, and performance notes for every active third-party presence
  • Coordinate with the Partner Marketing Manager to ensure that MDF-funded or co-branded promotional content is correctly deployed and displayed across relevant partner portals in alignment with partner approval requirements
  • Support localization efforts by working with Regional Marketing Leaders to adapt listings and content for region-specific partner platforms and supplier portals across NAM, EMEA, and MEA
Reporting & Process Improvement
  • Maintain a comprehensive inventory of all active third-party platform relationships, documenting platform type, access credentials, content versions, update frequency, and performance data
  • Develop and deliver regular reporting on third-party presence health — covering listing completeness scores, update cadences, and available performance metrics — for review by marketing and sales leadership
  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase the efficiency and accuracy of training schedule uploads, profile updates, and content deployments across multiple platforms simultaneously
  • Evaluate new tools, automation opportunities, or integration capabilities that could streamline third-party portal management and reduce manual effort over time
  • Document standard operating procedures for all recurring portal management tasks, ensuring continuity and consistency as the program scales
Ideal Candidate
  • 3+ years of experience in digital marketing operations, channel marketing, or a closely related role with demonstrable responsibility for managing third-party platform presence
  • Hands-on experience managing listings or profiles on authorized training partner portals (e.g. Microsoft Partner Network/MCAPS, AWS Training Partner Portal, Cisco Learning Partner portal) is strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with enterprise supplier portals and procurement platforms (e.g. Ariba, Coupa, Jaggaer, or comparable systems) is a significant advantage
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong operational mindset — this role requires high accuracy across a large volume of data and platform updates
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple platforms, update cycles, and stakeholder inputs simultaneously without errors or missed deadlines
  • Comfortable working with structured data, including training schedule exports, course catalog feeds, and content specifications in various formats (CSV, XML, platform-native templates)
  • Proficiency with digital asset management tools and content libraries; experience with Brandfolder or comparable DAM platforms is a plus
  • Collaborative working style with the ability to coordinate across marketing, sales, operations, and external partner contacts to gather inputs and drive timely updates
  • Strong written communication skills with an eye for how content reads and performs in a variety of external platform contexts
  • Experience in the technology training, professional development, or certification industry is a strong advantage

jobs.title: Workday FSI Financials Lead Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Join Kainos and Shape the Future At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact.
jobs.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

As an Workday FSI Financials Lead Consultant at Kainos, you will lead a finance workstream and take responsibility for the quality of its design, configuration and delivery. You will work directly with customer finance teams, turn sector requirements into practical Workday solutions and guide consultants through implementation. You will also strengthen our sector capability through tested model-tenant scenarios, reusable delivery assets and contributions to customer demonstrations.


The initial emphasis is insurance, including carriers, brokers and reinsurers, with opportunities across wider financial services. Your core specialism will be Financials, preferably record to report and FDM, supported by collaboration with data, integration and Accounting Center specialists.


Key responsibilities


  • Lead workstream discovery and design workshops. Understand the customer’s accounting processes, reporting needs and controls, document requirements and acceptance criteria, and identify decisions requiring architectural input.
  • Design and configure your Financials area, including business processes, accounting rules, worktags and reports as relevant to your specialism. Align detailed choices with the agreed FDM and overall solution.
  • Apply FSI understanding to real business scenarios. In insurance, trace premium, claims, commission or reinsurance flows through source data, accounting, reconciliation and reporting with the relevant specialists.
  • Own workstream deliverables, estimates and short-term plans. Allocate and review consultant tasks, track dependencies, communicate progress and escalate scope, quality or delivery risks early.
  • Define source mappings, accounting requirements and control totals with integration, Prism Analytics and Accounting Center teams. Validate outputs and ensure exceptions, corrections and reconciliation are covered.
  • Build prototypes and configuration documentation; prepare and execute tests, investigate defects, and support customer user acceptance testing. Include business exceptions and reporting evidence alongside standard transactions.
  • Support data migration, cutover rehearsals and go-live readiness, including opening balances and reconciliation. Provide training, operating procedures and handover to customer and support teams.
  • Build and maintain sector recipe cards, test packs and model-tenant scenarios. Record assumptions and test evidence, and make each asset’s readiness and limitations clear to colleagues.
  • Support presales workshops and demonstrations with the architect and sector team. Coach consultants, share delivery lessons and identify opportunities to improve processes and use approved automation.

Working relationships and accountability


You will work with the solution architect, project manager, capability leader, FSI sector team and specialist consultants. You own the quality and completion of your workstream. The architect resolves decisions affecting the overall solution, while the project manager coordinates the programme plan and budget. Sector contributions will be planned alongside customer delivery commitments.


Experience and capabilities


We are looking for a consultant who combines strong configuration skills with accounting understanding, reliable workstream leadership and the ability to build confidence with customer finance teams.


Essential requirements


  • Practical Workday Financials implementation experience, including leadership of a functional workstream through design, configuration and testing, with experience of go-live or substantial post-deployment change.
  • Strong hands-on capability in at least one Financials area. For the initial role, a record-to-report, financial accounting or FDM specialism is preferred, with an understanding of adjacent processes.
  • Direct experience supporting finance operations or transformation in an FSI organisation, or delivering a finance workstream for an FSI customer. Ability to connect sector requirements to configuration and test scenarios.
  • Sound accounting knowledge, including journal processing, general ledger and subledger reconciliation, period-end close and financial reporting; ability to investigate differences rather than rely only on system outputs.
  • Practical knowledge of FDM and worktags, business process configuration, Workday reporting and calculated fields, plus experience preparing or validating data loads and financial reconciliations.
  • Ability to lead workshops, document requirements and decisions, estimate work, manage workstream dependencies and explain issues clearly to finance users and the wider delivery team.
  • Evidence of reviewing others’ work, coaching consultants and maintaining delivery quality. Understanding of access controls, segregation of duties and the evidence needed to support finance controls.
  • Relevant current or previous Workday Financials certification, with commitment to maintain or renew required certifications and build knowledge of the relevant FSI subsector.

Desirable experience


  • Insurance experience involving premium or claims accounting, commissions, reinsurance, broker settlements or management and statutory reporting.
  • Hands-on experience or certification in Workday Prism Analytics or Accounting Center. Ability to work with these teams and validate their accounting outputs is valuable even where another specialist owns the build.
  • A recognised accountancy qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA, or equivalent professional experience; exposure to multi-entity, multi-currency or intercompany processes.
  • Experience creating demonstrations or reusable delivery assets, using test automation, or supporting Financials optimisation and managed services after deployment.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

Partnering closely with Brand, Compliance, Supply Chain, Creative, and Commercial teams, and with external manufacturers, laboratories and packaging partners, you will ensure every product is commercially viable, compliant, profitable and scalable. This role is ideal for someone who is commercially minded and highly organised, with a passion for developing exceptional beauty products.   • Optimise the product portfolio through reformulation, product enhancements, premiumisation, range rationalisation, and margin improvement.

Technical Development, Claims & Consumer Validation

  • Manage formulation and reformulation programmes with manufacturing partners, from technical brief through to commercial production.

  • Evaluate ingredients, formulations, packaging compatibility, performance, manufacturability, and cost to ensure products meet consumer, technical, and commercial requirements.

  • Lead product benchmarking, consumer testing, and validation programmes to inform development and support substantiated product claims in partnership with Brand and Compliance.

Supplier Management & Commercialisation

  • Manage OEM, ODM, laboratory, and packaging partners, leading supplier performance, commercial negotiations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Partner with Brand, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Creative teams to deliver commercially viable products and packaging across retail, wholesale, DTC, and marketplace channels.

  • Define product specifications, quality standards, and production readiness, using post-launch performance and consumer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

Programme Management & Leadership

  • Lead project governance, critical paths, budgets, risks, and development documentation, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to agreed objectives.

  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to resolve challenges, maintain momentum, and ensure successful product launches.

  • Champion continuous improvement across product development processes, fostering a collaborative, consumer-centric, and data-driven innovation culture.

  • 2–6 years’ experience in beauty, cosmetics, skincare, personal care or wellness product development, with proven end-to-end ownership of multiple concurrent NPD projects.

  • Strong hands-on experience in formulation and reformulation, consumer and competitor benchmarking, product evaluation and claims substantiation.

  • Experience working with global manufacturers, laboratories and packaging suppliers, with sound knowledge of stability, compatibility, scale-up and commercial manufacturing processes.

  • Strong commercial judgement, including experience balancing consumer performance, cost, margin, speed to market and omnichannel requirements.

  • Excellent project, critical path and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passion for beauty innovation, consumer behaviour and category growth, supported by confident use of insight, trend and performance data.

The Financial Services Event Specialist helps bring OneDigital's events and experiences to life across Wealth, Retirement and Executive Benefits. Success requires exceptional organization and follow-through, a strong understanding of compliance and sponsorship requirements, comfort managing multiple stakeholders, and the ability to set clear expectations around the timelines, inputs and approvals required to deliver events successfully.

Event Planning & Execution

Event Marketing & Activation

  • Partner with Growth Marketers to translate approved event opportunities and objectives into actionable event plans.

  • Support more customized and high-profile experiences in partnership with broader Marketing team.
  • Coordinate lead capture and post-event activities, including attendee reporting, surveys, follow-up communications and other agreed-upon activation.

Conferences, Sponsorships & Cross-Business Events

  • Partner with the Financial Services event center of excellence (COE) to coordinate conference participation, sponsorship activations, speaking engagements and strategic partner events.
  • Manage sponsorship deliverables, benefits, registrations, speaker requirements, branding opportunities and deadlines within established sponsorship agreements and investment parameters.

Compliance & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Maintain a strong working understanding of Financial Services compliance requirements and coordinate required reviews and approvals for invitations, presentations, collateral and external-facing event communications.

Tracking, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain accurate tracking of Financial Services events, conferences and sponsorships, including investment, attendance, engagement and available outcome data.

  • Prepare event recaps and help identify patterns and learnings that inform which event plays should be repeated, refined or scaled.

jobs.description:
Location: within European time zones.

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) acquires, launches and develops leading pet and equestrian marketplaces around the world. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we're on a mission to transform it by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through technology. We're a driven, ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by investors such as Verdane. We've been profitable since our first year, so we don't rely on investor capital to grow.

The opportunity

CLM is changing, and we want to rethink what it looks like when AI, automation and customer data sit at the heart of how we work. Our CRM covers email, push, in app and SMS for buyers and breeders across our marketplaces, with more markets joining as the group grows.

As our CRM & Lifecycle Manager, you'll own key parts of the customer lifecycle with our Head of CLM, across strategy, data, automation and execution. You'll spot where engagement can improve, design new journeys and experiments, and build the workflows that bring them to life.

You'll also help shape how the CLM itself works. Successful experiments become repeatable systems, and work that doesn't need a person gets automated.

Your edge is building fast and measuring everything. You use AI daily for research, analysis, segmentation, copy, personalisation and testing, so running several markets does not mean several times the work.

What you will do

  • Own the customer lifecycle. Design journeys for buyers and breeders that respond to what they do, across email, push, in app and SMS.

  • Turn data into action. Dig into behavioural data, spot opportunities and turn them into relevant experiences.

  • Automate the repetitive. Turn manual CRM processes into automated workflows, so time goes to higher value work.

  • Test what AI makes possible. Experiment with personalisation, content and segmentation, measure the results and take what works into production.

  • Build for scale. Create reusable journeys and processes, ready for new markets as the group grows.

  • Work across the business. Partner with product, data, engineering and marketing on the customer experience and the infrastructure behind it.

Requirements

Must have experience

  • 4 or more years in CRM or lifecycle marketing, preferably in house, with campaigns you personally built that moved a metric you can name. Marketplace, consumer app or ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Hands on experience in Customer.io or a comparable platform such as Braze, Iterable or Klaviyo. You're comfortable with segmentation logic, events, attributes and journeys that branch.

  • A habit of measuring. You set up tests properly, read results critically and sanity check a number before anyone else does.

  • Daily, active use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for building, copy, QA, localisation and workflow automation. You have a clear view of what to automate and what stays human.

  • Fluent English, written to a standard that needs no editing before it reaches a customer.

  • Able to own CRM as a team of one when needed: briefing agencies and freelancers, holding them to account, and saying "not this week" to requests with a clear reason.

Preferable experience

  • HTML and Liquid for email templates.

  • SQL, or working with a data warehouse and product analytics.

  • Marketing automation beyond the CRM, such as webhooks or tools like n8n.

  • A CRM platform migration.

  • A two sided or reputation exposed marketplace, such as pets, dating, fintech or the gig economy.

You will thrive here if you

  • Have the mindset of a hands on builder rather than a delegator.

  • Believe process serves outcomes, not the other way around.

  • Value clarity, candour and collaboration.

  • Take a roadmap and run with it, without needing daily direction.

  • Are curious beyond CLM and happy to pick up other marketing projects.

  • Are excited by the challenge of scaling one of Europe's most impactful consumer marketplaces.

What we offer

  • Direct access to founders and country leads.

  • A profitable, growing business rather than a slide deck.

  • A diverse team of more than 100 colleagues across the world.

  • Competitive compensation.

jobs.excerpt: About Us and Why We’re Hiring At Terra Energy, we’re not just developing renewable energy projects—we’re building a streamlined, scalable operation that can grow efficiently across multiple markets.
jobs.description:
About Us and Why We’re Hiring

At Terra Energy, we’re not just developing renewable energy projects—we’re building a streamlined, scalable operation that can grow efficiently across multiple markets.

As we expand in Texas, permitting has become a critical part of our success. Every project depends on accurate submissions, strong relationships with local jurisdictions, and the ability to navigate regulatory requirements without delays.

That’s why we’re looking for a Permitting Coordinator—someone who doesn’t just process permits, but takes ownership of the entire lifecycle and helps us build a more efficient, reliable system.

If you enjoy working with regulations, creating structure, and making complex processes run smoothly, this role is for you.

The Role

This role sits at the core of our operations.

You’ll be responsible for managing the full permitting process across our renewable energy projects in Texas—from initial submission to final approval and Permission to Operate (PTO).

You’ll work closely with internal teams and external authorities to ensure every project is compliant, on time, and properly documented.

This is a detail-driven role with high operational impact—ideal for someone who is organized, proactive, and comfortable navigating regulatory environments.

What You’ll Be Doing

Leading the Permitting Process

You’ll manage the end-to-end permitting lifecycle, ensuring every application is submitted accurately and moves efficiently through approval stages.

You’ll track multiple permits across different jurisdictions, proactively identifying and resolving delays or missing information.

Coordinating Across Teams

You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Sales, Project Management, Scheduling, and Inspection teams to ensure projects are fully ready for submission and aligned with current requirements.

Managing Compliance & Documentation

You’ll ensure all permits meet Texas regulatory, technical, and safety standards.

This includes reviewing documentation such as drawings, engineering stamps, and scopes of work, as well as maintaining accurate records across internal systems.

Working with External Authorities

You’ll act as the main point of contact with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), utilities, and third-party partners—facilitating submissions, answering questions, and pushing approvals forward.

Optimizing Processes

You’ll help define and improve permitting workflows by creating SOPs, reducing errors, and identifying ways to speed up approvals.

You’ll also support system improvements and automation efforts to make processes more scalable.

Training & Knowledge Sharing

You’ll act as a resource for internal teams—sharing updates on regulatory changes, providing training, and helping prevent recurring permitting issues.

What We’re Looking For

You’re someone who thrives in structured environments—or enjoys creating structure where it doesn’t exist yet.

You’re detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces without losing track.

You likely:

  • Have prior experience with permitting processes in Texas
  • Understand local, state, and utility regulatory requirements
  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Can manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • Communicate clearly with both internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Are comfortable reviewing technical documentation (drawings, plans, etc.)
  • Enjoy improving processes and making systems more efficient

How You’ll Work at Terra Energy

We’re a fast-growing company, and while we move quickly, we rely on strong operational foundations.

You’ll have ownership over your area, direct collaboration with multiple teams, and the opportunity to improve how permitting is handled as we scale.

We value people who are proactive, solution-oriented, and focused on getting things done the right way.

Compensation & Details

  • Salary: $50,000 USD annually
  • Location: Remote (United States)
  • Reports to: Operations Manager
  • Department: Operations

What Success Looks Like

  • Permits are submitted accurately and approved on time
  • Minimal delays due to missing or incorrect documentation
  • Strong relationships with local jurisdictions and utilities
  • Clear, organized tracking of all permitting activities
  • Improved workflows that reduce turnaround times

In Summary

This role is for someone who brings order to complexity.

If you’re excited about managing critical processes, working with regulations, and playing a key role in getting projects across the finish line—this is that kind of opportunity.

Recruitment Process

  • Initial Contact (HR) – Quick intro and role overview
  • HR Interview – Experience and overall fit
  • Hiring Manager Interview – Technical and role deep dive
  • Offer Letter – Final offer and next steps

jobs.title: Chief Technology & Product Officer
jobs.excerpt: About Agentic Defense Solutions Inc Agentic Defense Solutions exists to solve the real problem in mission-critical AI: not better models, but the operational trust layer that makes AI governable, auditable, and safe to deploy in high-consequence environments.
jobs.description:
About Agentic Defense Solutions Inc

Agentic Defense Solutions exists to solve the real problem in mission-critical AI: not better models, but the operational trust layer that makes AI governable, auditable, and safe to deploy in high-consequence environments.

Our Mission

Most people think the challenge in mission-critical AI is better models. It isn't. The real problem is there is no control plane for how AI reasons, makes decisions, and executes operations in high-consequence environments.

Agentic Defense Solutions builds the ARIA product family: the operational trust layer for AI where decisions have real-world impact. From the ARIA Platform foundation to the ARIA Hermes application, we provide the infrastructure that makes AI governable, auditable, and safe to deploy so that warfighters, analysts, operators, and decision-makers can leverage AI with confidence.

We believe that AI accountability shouldn't be an afterthought. It should be the foundation. ARIA enforces policy, keeps an immutable audit trail, supports human-in-the-loop, and is built for air-gapped and classified deployment from day one.

About the role
Agentic Defense Solutions, Inc. is seeking a Chief Technology & Product Officer (CTO/CPO) to own the technical and product direction of the company as we build the operational trust layer for AI in high-consequence environments.

This is not a traditional executive role where product strategy and engineering execution are delegated several layers down. We are looking for a deeply technical product and engineering leader who can move comfortably between company strategy, product architecture, customer problems, engineering execution, and the code when necessary.

You will own the evolution of the ARIA product family: defining what we build, why we build it, how the platform is architected, and how our engineering organization delivers it.

The central technical challenge is significant. AI systems are rapidly moving from generating information to reasoning, making decisions, invoking tools, and executing actions. In mission-critical environments, those systems need a control plane that determines what AI can do, how it reasons, which data and tools it can access, when humans must intervene, and how every consequential action can be reconstructed and defended.

That is what we are building.

You will work directly with the CEO and founding team to turn that vision into a category-defining product and technical platform.

What you'll do

Product Strategy & Direction

  • Own product strategy and roadmap across the ARIA product family, translating the company's mission and market opportunity into a coherent product portfolio.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our users — analysts, operators, engineers, decision-makers, and mission leaders — and turn their hardest problems into scalable product capabilities.
  • Decide what belongs in the core platform, what belongs in applications, what should be enabled through partners and integrations, and what we should deliberately not build.
  • Establish product discovery and development processes that allow us to move quickly without becoming a collection of customer-specific features.
  • Work directly with customers and prospective customers to understand workflows, validate product direction, and identify capabilities that can become repeatable platform primitives.
  • Define product success metrics and use customer behavior, deployment experience, and market feedback to continuously refine priorities.
  • Maintain a strong point of view about the evolution of enterprise and mission AI, agentic systems, AI infrastructure, and human-machine collaboration.

Technology & Architecture

  • Own the technical architecture and long-term technology strategy for ARIA.
  • Define the architecture for a platform capable of orchestrating AI reasoning, tools, data, policy, human approvals, memory, and execution across complex workflows.
  • Ensure ARIA can operate across cloud, hybrid, disconnected, air-gapped, and classified environments without fragmenting into separate products.
  • Drive architectural decisions around agent orchestration, model abstraction, data and knowledge infrastructure, distributed systems, APIs, security boundaries, observability, policy enforcement, and auditability.
  • Ensure the platform remains model-agnostic and capable of taking advantage of rapid advances in foundation models, open-source models, inference infrastructure, and agent frameworks.
  • Establish technical standards that allow the platform to scale dramatically in customers, workloads, data volume, integrations, and engineering contributors.
  • Make thoughtful build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions and prevent unnecessary technical complexity.
  • Maintain a high bar for reliability, security, performance, developer experience, and maintainability.

AI & Agentic Systems

  • Lead the company's technical strategy for agentic AI and AI-assisted decision systems.
  • Drive how ARIA approaches reasoning, planning, tool use, context management, memory, evaluation, human-in-the-loop control, and multi-agent workflows.
  • Build systems that make probabilistic AI useful inside environments that require deterministic controls and accountable outcomes.
  • Establish rigorous approaches to AI evaluation, testing, observability, failure analysis, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure customers can understand not simply what an AI system produced, but the reasoning context, evidence, policies, tools, approvals, and actions that led to an outcome.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging models, frameworks, research, and infrastructure and determine where advances should materially change our product or architecture.

Engineering Leadership

  • Build and lead a world-class engineering organization capable of moving with startup speed while delivering software suitable for mission-critical environments.
  • Recruit exceptional engineers, technical leaders, product leaders, and designers as the company scales.
  • Establish an engineering culture centered on technical excellence, ownership, velocity, intellectual honesty, and pragmatic execution.
  • Develop engineering leaders and create an organizational structure that can scale without introducing unnecessary management layers or bureaucracy.
  • Own engineering planning, prioritization, quality, technical debt, and delivery.
  • Establish the development practices, architecture review processes, testing standards, release processes, and operational disciplines necessary to maintain velocity as the platform grows.
  • Remain technically engaged. You do not need to be the person writing every feature, but you should be capable of reviewing architecture, challenging implementation decisions, debugging difficult problems, prototyping ideas, and earning the respect of exceptional engineers.

Customer & Mission Engineering

  • Work directly with customers to understand complex operational environments and translate those requirements into scalable product architecture.
  • Participate in technical demonstrations, architecture discussions, design sessions, and strategic customer engagements.
  • Partner with mission and deployment teams to ensure lessons from implementations rapidly influence the core product.
  • Help customers understand how ARIA fits into their existing data, AI, security, and operational ecosystems.
  • Serve as a senior technical voice with government, commercial, technology, and strategic partners.
  • Balance the urgency of solving immediate customer problems with the discipline required to build a repeatable software platform.

Executive Leadership

  • Serve as a core member of the executive team and help shape company strategy beyond the boundaries of product and engineering.
  • Partner directly with the CEO on company strategy, market positioning, product narrative, organizational design, recruiting, partnerships, and capital allocation.
  • Translate complex technology into a compelling vision for customers, employees, partners, investors, and the broader market.
  • Represent the company's technical vision externally with customers, partners, industry leaders, and the technical community.
  • Help define and defend the category ADS intends to create: the operational trust layer for AI in high-consequence environments.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive software engineering, product engineering, or technology leadership experience, with substantial experience building and leading high-performing engineering organizations.
  • Experience serving as a senior engineering or product/technology leader — such as CTO, CPO, VP Engineering, VP Product, Head of Engineering, Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, or equivalent — with meaningful ownership of both technical direction and product outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience taking sophisticated enterprise software products from concept through production and significant customer adoption.
  • Exceptional technical depth in modern software architecture, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, or similarly complex enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI systems, including LLMs, agent architectures, retrieval and context systems, tool use, model evaluation, and the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated ability to make consequential architectural decisions while balancing speed, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience building and managing exceptional engineering teams, including recruiting senior technical talent and developing engineering leaders.
  • Strong product instincts and demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into coherent, scalable products.
  • Experience working directly with sophisticated enterprise customers and navigating the tension between customer requirements and product strategy.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an early-stage environment where strategy, architecture, recruiting, customer conversations, and hands-on problem solving frequently happen in the same day.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of shipping.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI/ML platforms, developer platforms, data infrastructure, security platforms, workflow/orchestration systems, or other technically sophisticated enterprise software.
  • Experience building products that sit between infrastructure and applications and become foundational components of a customer's technology stack.
  • Experience scaling a product and engineering organization through a period of rapid company growth.
  • Experience with security-sensitive, regulated, mission-critical, or high-availability environments.
  • Familiarity with deployment into government, defense, intelligence, critical infrastructure, or other high-consequence environments.
  • Experience with disconnected, edge, on-premises, or air-gapped deployment models.
  • Experience developing platforms or ecosystems that enable third-party developers, partners, or customers to build on top of a core product.
  • Demonstrated technical thought leadership through open-source contributions, patents, publications, speaking, or recognized leadership within a technical community.

Prior national security experience is valuable, but it is not required. We care more about your ability to build exceptional technology, understand difficult customer problems, lead extraordinary engineers, and learn a complex mission domain quickly.

The Person We're Looking For

  • You are probably uncomfortable being described as purely a CTO, purely a CPO, or purely an engineering executive.
  • You have strong opinions about architecture, but you care about whether customers actually use what you build.
  • You can spend the morning debating the architecture of an agent runtime, the afternoon working through a mission workflow with a customer, and the evening helping recruit an exceptional engineer.
  • You understand that great product organizations do not simply implement requirements. They develop a point of view about the problem, identify the primitives underneath individual customer requests, and build systems that become more valuable as more use cases are added.
  • You are excited by the technical possibilities of AI but skeptical of systems that cannot explain, constrain, evaluate, or govern their behavior.
  • Most importantly, you want to build.

We would rather do three things properly now than six things partially.

We are open to hiring this role at either the Manager or Director level based on the selected candidate's experience, leadership scope, and organizational impact. Both levels share the same core responsibilities, with placement reflecting the candidate's demonstrated ability to lead initiatives and drive organizational outcomes. This is a full-time, salaried position reporting to the Chief People Officer.

A Day in the Life

This year, FY27, you will:

  • Develop and execute an integrated talent management and development strategy aligned with organizational goals and values
  • Own the performance management cycle end to end in Lattice — goal setting, check-ins, review cycles, and calibration — and make it a process managers use rather than a process they complete
  • Own engagement and culture. Design and run how we listen, turn the results into action plans that sit with the leaders who can act on them, and follow through until something changes
  • Keep the existing learning stack running — Litmos, Articulate/Rise — and administer training where it is needed today, while assessing what we should consolidate
  • Partner with the Chief People Officer on talent gap and capacity planning, bringing data that shows where the organization is thin before it becomes a vacancy
  • Collaborate with leaders to assess organizational capability needs and implement programs that build critical skills and leadership pipelines
  • Own our manager guides from your first day. The step-by-step guides managers use to coach, document, and correct performance will be written before you start. Measuring whether managers use them, where they get stuck, and whether they are producing better outcomes is yours — and so is revising them when the evidence says they are not working
  • Lead, coach, and develop two Talent Development professionals
  • Utilize workforce analytics and talent metrics to assess program effectiveness and determine what is working and what is not. Encoura uses Lattice and Domo

FY28 you will design:

  • A succession planning and talent review approach: critical roles, critical talent, honest bench strength, and a defensible view of who is ready for what
  • A leadership development program for a manager population formed from three legacy organizations, many of whom are managing at Encoura for the first time
  • A consolidated learning program with the content, vendors, and analytics behind it
  • An approach for our Student Success population — a high-volume, largely hourly and seasonal workforce whose supervisors need different tools than our corporate managers

Role Progression

  • Within 1 month, you'll: Know the talent team and will have partnered with the CPO to create the FY27 team objectives. Have met the leaders whose groups are undergoing change and planned how best to support them.
  • Within 3 months, you'll: Have the FY27 performance cycle designed and scheduled, have a measurement approach in place for the manager guides, and have an agreed approach to engagement with the Chief People Officer.
  • Within 6 months, you'll: Have the performance cycle running, have a first engagement read with action plans owned by named leaders, and have an FY28 talent roadmap that leadership can fund.

About You

  • Level will be determined by experience and demonstrated scope:
    • Manager level: 5+ years in talent management, organizational development, or learning and development, including hands-on design and delivery of performance or leadership programs, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
    • Director level: 8+ years of progressive experience in talent management, organizational development, or related HR functions, including ownership of enterprise-wide talent programs and experience leading a team.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field with equivalent experience; Master's degree preferred
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running a performance management cycle that managers across an organization actually completed, and a clear view of why it worked
  • Experience owning employee engagement end to end — not just fielding a survey but turning results into action that leaders carried and that employees could see

WHAT DO WE HAVE TO OFFER?

We are a team in every sense, and we support each other and work collaboratively to achieve our goals together.

It is our goal that you will be compensated for your hard work and commitment, so if you’d like to work for one of the top Logistics providers in the world then let’s work together to help you find your new role.

What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We are hiring a design lead: a player-coach for someone who still loves to design while also having a passion to make other designers better.

This role sit within Roo’s product team, which owns product and design craft across the company. The product team supports a number of squads (aka business units), the cross-functional teams accountable for driving the success of the key pillars of our marketplace. Designers are aligned to one or more squads to deliver meaningful business impact but formally sit within the product team to ensure we are creating a cohesive product experience across squads. Holding that tension well is at the core of this job.

As a player-coach, you'll spend real time in Figma owning a few projects end-to-end to drive measurable business impact for one or more business units. At the same time, you’ll help set the quality bar across our full product surface by defining what design excellence means at Roo, and making it stick.
