About Homeward

Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience. We’re a fast-paced, remote-first real estate startup that partners with real estate agents to offer innovative products and services, helping clients buy with cash, sell with certainty, and time their move, regardless of the market.

Founder and CEO Tim Heyl, owner of one of the fastest-growing agent teams in the country, started Homeward in 2018 to fix the antiquated and broken real estate process. Today, we offer bundled cash offers, mortgage, and title services in 13 states, enabling buyers and sellers to move with certainty and convenience.

We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them.

About The Opportunity

Homeward is looking for an Analytics Engineer to help build, strengthen, and scale the data foundation that powers decision-making across the business.

This role is ideal for someone who is a confident, self-sufficient data professional with deep experience in data modeling and a passion for turning complex data into reliable, usable products. You’ll own critical pieces of our data pipeline and architecture while partnering closely with analysts, technical teams, and business stakeholders to ensure our data is accurate, dependable, and easy to consume.

A major focus of this role will be data reliability and scalability. We need someone who can identify why pipelines and models are breaking, build solutions that address the root cause, and create an architecture that can scale as our business and use of AI evolve. Most importantly, you take ownership. When you see an opportunity to make our data infrastructure more reliable, scalable, or useful, you're motivated to figure out how to make it better.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape how Homeward structures, governs, and delivers data—enabling analysts, business users, applications, and AI-powered tools to work from consistent and trusted information.

NOTE: Due to current team needs, we are only accepting candidates based in Latin America. This is intended to be a long-term contract position. It is not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship or relocation.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the health and reliability of our data pipelines, proactively identifying issues and implementing durable solutions to prevent ingestion failures and downstream disruptions.
  • Design, develop, test, and optimize scalable dimensional data models and data marts using dbt.
  • Structure data models around abstract business definitions, creating a reliable connection between business logic and technical implementation.
  • Help architect our data environment for AI-readiness, ensuring data is structured, documented, governed, and accessible in ways that support emerging AI use cases.
  • Evaluate and implement tooling and validation processes to ensure dbt models and AI-enabled data workflows produce accurate and trustworthy outputs.
  • Partner closely with Product and Technology teams on internal application and system changes, identifying upstream and downstream data dependencies and minimizing disruption.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand analytical needs and translate them into scalable solutions within our analytics platform.
  • Develop deep domain expertise across key areas of Homeward's business and serve as a technical point of contact for associated data models, metrics, and workflows.
  • Establish monitoring, testing, documentation, and data-quality practices that improve confidence in our data.
  • Identify opportunities to improve our overall data architecture and recommend practical solutions rather than waiting for requirements to be fully defined.

What You'll Bring:

  • Strong experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a similar data-focused role.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and dimensional data modeling, with demonstrated experience designing scalable analytical datasets.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production data models and semantic layers using dbt.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or supporting data ingestion and transformation pipelines, including diagnosing failures and improving pipeline reliability.
  • Experience designing data architecture that balances scalability, maintainability, usability, and business needs.
  • Experience with AWS or a comparable cloud data environment.
  • Experience with modern BI and analytics tools such as Looker, Hex, Tableau, or equivalent platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Python and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  • Understanding of data governance principles, including metric definitions, data quality, documentation, lineage, and access.
  • Familiarity with modern AI/LLM applications and AI-enabled data tooling, with an understanding of how data architecture needs to evolve to support AI use cases.
  • Ability to translate business concepts and definitions into clear, maintainable technical models.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently investigate ambiguous or complex data issues.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Compensation & Details:

  • Contractor engagement
  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Computer reimbursement
  • Fully remote, LatAM-based, meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours.

Value-Driven Employee Experience

THE GOLDEN RULE. It’s simple: Treat others the way we want to be treated. Whether we’re dealing with colleagues or customers, we don’t prioritize money or growth over people, and we practice empathy at every opportunity.

CALM FOCUS. We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM. Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

OverviewofRole:

The Senior Director, Regulatory Affairs, CMC, provides global regulatory leadership and strategic oversight for Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) activities across the portfolio. This role is accountable for defining and executing global CMC regulatory strategy for biologics (large molecules) throughout all phases of development and commercialization.

The Senior Director partners closely with CMC, Supply Chain, Quality, Technical Operations, and Regulatory colleagues to ensure compliant, high‑quality, and timely global submissions. This role leads regulatory CMC strategy for development programs and marketing applications, oversees preparation and maintenance of CMC regulatory filings, and serves as a senior regulatory authority in interactions with global Health Authorities.

Roleand Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for global CMC regulatory activities across assigned programs and the broader portfolio.
  • Define and execute global CMC regulatory strategy to support clinical development, licensure, and lifecycle management of biologic products.
  • Represent Regulatory CMC at the senior project team and governance levels, providing strategic guidance to enable successful product development and approval.
  • Lead cross‑functional collaboration with CMC, Supply Chain, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs to develop and align global regulatory strategies and submission plans.
  • Oversee the planning, development, and finalization of high‑quality CMC regulatory documents to meet global regulatory requirements.
  • Provide executive oversight of internal CMC submission review and approval processes to ensure compliance, quality, and alignment with company strategy.
  • Lead regulatory CMC activities related to Health Authority interactions, including meeting strategy, briefing document oversight, and responses to information requests.
  • Ensure proactive assessment of regulatory impact related to CMC changes, deviations, and lifecycle management activities; direct preparation of associated regulatory submissions.
  • Oversee timelines, resource planning, and prioritization of regulatory CMC activities in alignment with corporate and development objectives.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on global CMC regulations and guidance, advising internal stakeholders on regulatory expectations and risk mitigation.
  • Identify, lead, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance Regulatory CMC processes, systems, and cross‑functional effectiveness.
  • Escalate significant regulatory risks or compliance issues to senior leadership and provide clear recommendations for resolution.
  • Maintain current knowledge of global CMC regulatory trends, emerging guidance, and Health Authority expectations, and translate these into strategic insights for the organization.

jobs.description:
College Board – Technology – Infrastructure & InfoSec

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).

Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team 

The College Board Product Security team is a close-knit and enthusiastic group of technologists with a thirst for knowledge in security and cloud. We collaborate closely to investigate and solve problems and have strong alignment with our product teams to be a step ahead in securing the organization’s suite of products. We are an agile organization, embracing AI and cloud-native systems, and are focused on improving speed and security of service delivery in support of our important mission. Our team comes from a wide variety of backgrounds as well as experience within the security space and we work to ensure everyone on the team has a voice.


Product Security Engineers work closely with product and engineering teams as well as other organizational stakeholder groups to achieve product and security business objectives. They support threat modelling, architecture design, and implementation of secure development practices. In addition, they help define organizational security standards and organizational capability and tooling adoption decisions.


About the Opportunity  

As a Senior Product Security Engineer, you will embed with assigned product and engineering teams to own security across the full development lifecycle, from feature-level design review and threat modeling through vulnerability remediation and production monitoring. This includes a heavy focus on securing AI features built into College Board's products, implementing AI-native security tooling and features, and assessing and mitigating the risks that AI development tools introduce into the software supply chain. You will join planning and grooming sessions as the team's security partner, translating compliance and requirements and security risks into guidance engineers can act on.


You will lead risk assessments, provide prioritization advice, and drive mitigation of risks. Alongside that product or engineering team work, you will coach developers on security practices, including the responsible use of AI coding tools.


This role is equal parts hands-on security engineering and organizational enablement. Your work will directly protect platforms that serve millions of students and educators worldwide.


In this role, you will:

Partner with Product and Engineering Teams (50%)

  • Serve as the security partner for assigned product and engineering teams; join planning, grooming, and design sessions to advise on security architecture and flag risk early.
  • Own threat models and risk assessments for assigned products; communicate security risks and mitigation plans to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Own the security engagement lifecycle for each assigned product, from design review and documentation through production deployment and monitoring.
  • Lead vulnerability reviews and remediation; assess exploitability to set accurate risk priority.
  • Apply knowledge of emerging best practices in AI security, CB's security policies, and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27002, PCI, PII) to guide product teams.
  • Write and review security design documentation and code; give and receive direct feedback in design reviews.
  • Ensure assigned products meet Product Security Framework requirements; identify gaps and drive remediation.

Elevate Product Security (25%)

  • Coach product teams and junior engineers through discussions, code reviews, and hands-on training to advance secure SDLC practices.
  • Grow and mature the AI Product Security program; develop security controls and guidance in the use of AI in software engineering, in our products, and in our security program.
  • Document and share emerging security patterns; keep your knowledge accessible to the full team.
  • Stay current with industry trends; apply what you learn to improve the partner program.

Drive Operational Improvement (25%)

  • Deploy and operate security tooling across cloud environments; integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Contribute to roadmap planning and strategic direction: identify security risks and opportunities, escalate issues with cross-team scope, and synthesize feedback to inform priorities.
  • Define and track KPIs that measure product security maturity and partner team posture; use the data to prioritize work and report progress.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies; manage assigned epics and assess roadmap timelines and risk.
  • Work with the Information Security team on incident response and operational initiatives.

About you, you have:

  • 5–8 years of product security experience, including ownership of the full security engagement lifecycle—from threat modeling and architecture review through vulnerability remediation and production monitoring.
  • Application security expertise across secure SDLC, CI/CD pipeline security, cloud environments (AWS preferred), and common frameworks including OWASP and CIS.
  • Strong knowledge of emerging security trends in AI and agentic AI in software engineering and software products; the ability to identify industry patterns in AI risks and apply them to your day-to-day work.
  • Knowledge of audit and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27002, PCI, PII), especially as they relate to the use of AI, and skill at translating them into clear guidance for engineering teams.
  • Proficiency reviewing and improving application architecture for security, testability, and maintainability; hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, and AWS is a plus.
  • The ability to establish strong working relationships with product owners and engineering teams; experience shaping backlog prioritization and roadmap decisions from a security perspective.
  • An emerging security strategy instinct: you identify risks and opportunities across team boundaries, start shaping security direction, and communicate implications clearly.
  • Expertise in more than one technical domain and a commitment to keeping knowledge documented and shared, so the team never relies on one person.
  • Evidence-based judgment in candidate evaluation; consistent standards across resumes and interviews.
  • Ability to travel 3–5 times per year to College Board offices in New York or Reston, VA.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. 
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.

About Our Process 

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck, we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $153,000 - $166,000
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the Role & TeamIn this role, you will be responsible for driving automation initiatives that deliver measurable business value across all of Penn Entertainment. Your work will span the full lifecycle of automation, from identifying opportunities to delivering and optimizing solutions. While automation is the primary focus, you will also consider AI-supported solutions where they align with the company’s overall AI strategy. You will partner closely with a small team of RPA specialists, AI strategists, and business leaders to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

About the Work

  • Identify and assess opportunities for automation and process improvement across business units.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand pain points, gather requirements, and prioritize initiatives based on business impact.
  • Work hands-on with internal development teams and external vendors to design, build, and implement automation solutions.
  • Ensure all automation and AI-supported solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with company objectives and standards.
  • Maintain a portfolio of automation initiatives, balancing quick wins with longer-term strategic projects.
  • Lead structured discovery sessions and maintain a self-service intake process for automation ideas.
  • Evaluate and prioritize opportunities using standardized criteria such as effort, risk, return on investment, compliance, and technical feasibility.
  • Oversee the delivery of automation solutions, ensuring clear communication and alignment with internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage vendor relationships, including selection, onboarding, and performance tracking for external automation and AI solution providers.
  • Collaborate with engineering, data, security, and product teams to ensure seamless integration and operational readiness.
  • Define and track key performance indicators such as hours saved, error reduction, cycle-time improvement, compliance, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Stay informed about emerging automation and AI technologies and recommend new approaches when appropriate.
  • Support a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence across the organization.
  • Other duties as required. 

About You

You are a self-motivated professional with a passion for operational efficiency and a proven track record in automation and business process improvement. You thrive on identifying opportunities to eliminate waste and deliver measurable value. You are comfortable working independently, but you also excel at building strong partnerships with internal development teams and external vendors.

  • At least 5 years of experience designing, building, and managing automation solutions (workflow automation, or scripting), with hands-on expertise in at least one leading platform (for example, UiPath or Power Automate).
  • Ability to evaluate existing processes and identify opportunities for improvement, increased efficiency, and automation.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering business efficiency improvements through automation, with clear examples of measurable impact.
  • Experience collaborating with internal engineering or development teams to deliver technical solutions.
  • Experience managing relationships with external vendors or solution providers, including selection, onboarding, and performance management.
  • Familiarity with evaluating and implementing AI-supported solutions for process improvement, and an understanding of how to align these with a company’s overall AI strategy.
  • Strong program management and stakeholder influence skills, with the ability to prioritize initiatives and drive projects to completion.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to translate technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in regulated or high-scale industries (such as gaming, fintech, or entertainment) is a plus.
  • A strategic mindset, a collaborative approach, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Fun, relaxed work environment.
  • Education and conference reimbursements.
  • Parental leave top up.
  • Opportunities for career progression and mentoring others.

$110,000—$150,000 CAD

As an AI Tutor specialized in multilingual audio capabilities, you will contribute to SpaceXAI's mission by training and refining Grok to excel in voice interactions, speech recognition, and auditory experiences across diverse languages, accents, and cultural contexts. Your work will focus on curating and annotating high-quality audio data to enhance Grok's global accessibility, enabling natural spoken interactions for users worldwide, bridging language barriers through accurate speech processing, and improving the AI's handling of multilingual audio nuances.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Use proprietary software to provide labels, annotations, recordings, and inputs on projects involving multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, speech samples, and auditory elements in various languages.
  • Translate and localize text strings (UI copy, prompts, responses, and other written content) from English into Serbian, ensuring linguistic accuracy, natural phrasing, and cultural appropriateness.
  • Support the delivery of high-quality curated audio data that ensures clear, natural spoken output, accurate representation of linguistic and prosodic details (such as intonation, rhythm, and accent), and professional audio standards.
  • Collaborate with technical staff to develop tasks that improve AI's ability to handle speech modulation, accent variation, noise in real-world recordings, and multilingual audio processing.
  • Work with technical staff to improve annotation tools for efficient audio workflows.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Native proficiency in Serbian with exposure to diverse accents, dialects, or regional variations.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B2 level) with clear, natural vocal delivery and pronunciation suitable for audio recording purposes.
  • Strong auditory perception to identify nuances in speech, accents, pronunciation, intonation, and audio quality across languages.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multilingual audio content, including evaluating speech accuracy, cultural vocal expressions, and contextual interpretation in spoken form.
  • Demonstrated ability to transcribe audio with high accuracy across accents and varying audio quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate and localize text accurately between English and Serbian, preserving meaning, tone, and cultural nuance.
  • Comfort providing high-quality voice recordings and feedback on audio samples in multiple languages.
  • Strong comprehension skills and the ability to make independent judgments on ambiguous or varied audio material, including noisy or accented speech.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, analytical, detail-oriented, and organizational skills, with the ability to articulate audio-related feedback effectively.
  • Commitment to developing AI that masters sophisticated multilingual audio capabilities.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Deep understanding and taste of what good/useful Audio data is.
  • Strong command of advanced transcription and annotation practices, including handling disfluencies, accents, and prosodic features (intonation, stress, rhythm, emotion, etc) with high consistency and accuracy.
  • Background in linguistics (e.g., phonetics, phonology, sociolinguistics), speech sciences, cognitive science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with demonstrated ability to analyze accent variation, pronunciation differences, and multilingual speech patterns.

  • Portfolio (strongly preferred for advanced candidates): Voice samples, annotated transcripts, or audio-related work demonstrating quality, methodology, and attention to detail.
  • Candidates with professional experience in voice, linguistics, speech data, or speech evaluation and research are especially encouraged to apply.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

As a member of the Digital Data Networks (DDN) business in TE Connectivity you will play a key role in the design of products for high-speed products in the connector, cable assembly, and/or radio system industry—targeting high-speed communications and connectivity within datacenters and wireless infrastructure.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Internal Cables & Connectors Reliability & Testing (R&T) Leader will lead a dedicated team of R&T engineers and will have responsibility for driving standardized Design for Reliability Engineering (DfRE) and Robustness Validation (RV) Methodologies for all Internal Cable & Connectors Products in the DDN Portfolio. He/she and their team will work extremely closely with customers, Product Development Engineering (PDE) teams, Manufacturing Process Development Engineering (MPDE) teams, Field Application Engineering (FAE) and Advanced Quality Engineering (AQE) to deeply understand the end application requirements and the associated “mission profile”. They will partner with the Global R&T COE to drive the application of standardized methodologies and alignment on all Reliability Testing and Test & Validation plans for each of the assigned new product development programs. They will identify unique product line test needs and application testing requirements and work with the R&T COE to develop custom Test System & Software as required to support the unique testing requirements for each product line. In addition, he/she will also partner with the Global R&T COE to co-develop Reliability Test Plans and Test & Validation Plans aligned with TE’s LeanPD stage gate approach for product development.

The Internal Cable & Connectors R&T Leader will oversee integrating reliability considerations during technology & product evaluation, NPI product development from receipt of Customer Spec (“mission profile”) through Product Release into mass production. DfRE Experts in the Global R&T COE will help determine the appropriate test strategy to collect data using destructive Highly Accelerated Life Test (HALT) or Highly Accelerated Stress Tests (HAST) techniques to evaluate product reliability. Based on collected data and in close collaboration with PDE teams, they will identify weak design/process features or components and work closely with PDE and AQE on the development of corrective actions and improvement plans, engaging with material and component experts to evaluate improvements of the corrective actions by technics such a stress/accelerated screening.

Role Responsibilities

ENGINEERS ON INTERNAL CABLE & CONNECTORS R&T TEAM WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Integrate reliability considerations during technology & product evaluation, NPI product development from receipt of Customer Spec (Mission Profile) through Product Release into mass production.
    • Contribute towards requirement engineering. Understand the load requirements clearly to derive inner load and stresses.
    • Drive reliability planning tailored to environmental and use conditions, integrating contingency planning and business impact.
    • Analysis of test data. knowledge on data acquisition methods and system.
    • Apply accelerated test models and test-to-failure strategies to determine reliability limits and identify failure modes.
    • Perform the initial FIT estimation based on data from standards such as Siemens Norm SN-29500. Calculate final FIT value based on test data.
    • Analyze customer requirements, application requirements and mission profile to determine the optimal validation test to evaluate reliability of DDN products.
    • Design and develop detailed Test & Validation (T&V) Plans for Early Validation Testing (EVT), Design Validation Testing (DVT) and Process Validation Testing (PVT); coordinate all Validation Testing internally or externally, publish validation test reports.
    • Design and develop Packaging Test & Validation Plans; coordinate all Validation Testing internally or externally, publish validation test reports
    • Lead corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes for reliability issues across products.
    • Contribute to or manage a centralized database of reliability test plans, models, and field data to promote reuse and faster decision-making.
    • Present reliability status and risks to executive leadership, influencing design decisions and investment in robustness.
    • Leverage on accelerated test methods to explore design margins and to enable fast selection of concepts.
    • Provide guidance on sample size requirements and duration for reliability testing by utilizing reliability statistics.
    • Act as a champion for reliability culture, fostering a proactive and metrics-driven mindset within cross-functional teams.
    • Analyze data from those optimal validation tests to calculate reliability and identify risks or failures. Calculate MTTF based on test to failure evaluation.
    • For identified risks, support definition of mitigation plans and implementation to improve reliability.
    • For identified high risk failure modes and actual failures, support definition of corrective actions and their implementation to improve reliability.
    • Communicate and interact with customer reliability experts to report on reliability analysis.
    • Participate in design reviews and facilitate the reliability section of the design review.
    • Establish a database of reliability tests, models to be re-used across projects.

What your background should look like

 Bachelor/ Master’s degree in technical discipline (Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics)
 10+ years of Experience a high-speed hardware engineering role serving telecommunications market or data center applications.
 Seasoned people leader, experience managing engineering teams in global corporate matrixed environment.
 Must also have many years of experience working with test equipment, test systems, test labs, development and deployment of HALT/HAST testing, Test & Validation Plans, development of custom test systems and performing “application tests.” Must have a good balance between theory and practice.
 Experience interacting with global cross-functional engineering teams in multi-site global organization.
 Experience with high-speed test equipment (Digital Sampling Oscilloscope, Vector Network Analyzer, Bit Error Rate Tester, TDR, Pattern Generators, Power Supplies, etc.)
 In depth familiarity with IEEE 802.3: The cornerstone for Ethernet networking. Recent iterations (e.g., 802.3ck) define standards for 100 Gb/s, 200 Gb/s, and 400 Gb/s operation over copper and fiber, as well as Next-Gen (800G/1.6T) data center requirements.
 Expertise with electronic assembly product development and validation of hardware and software.
 Excellent English, both verbal and written, and the ability to interact professionally with customers, leadership, stakeholders, cross functional teams and subject matter experts.
 Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills and ability to make decisions when presented with a series of challenges, conflicts and constraints. Ability to drive to big picture goals and milestones while valuing and maintaining strong attention to the details.
 Knowledge on FIT estimation methodology, statistical analysis for reliability calculation such as Weibull-analysis or 2-statistics, application of Bayes theorem, random failure principle, FMEDA, FTA
 Reliability Engineering training from company, ASQ, TUV, Reliasoft or equivalent
 Experience with custom product development, working closely with customers to define mission profile of the end application and optimizing reliability strategy based on customer needs.
 Experience in running statistical analysis for reliability calculation for mechatronic products.
 A high curiosity in understanding how systems/products work along with a reverse engineering mindset.
 Willingness to travel as required, ~20%

WE VALUE -
+ DFSS Blackbelt or DFSS Green Belt Certified
+ Standards Knowledge - ANSI/TIA-942 Standard, ANSI/TIA-568-E Standard, ISO/IEC 11801 Standard, ISO/IEC 24764 Standard, EIA-364 1000B, IPC Standards for Interconnecting and Packaging Electronic Assemblies, UL Standards for Data Center Component Level Certifications (i.e. UL 1977, UL 444, UL 817, UL 2416).
+ Knowledge in data center architecture, connectors, sockets, wire harnesses, High-Speed connectivity products, electronics, measurement & signal processing.
+ Experience in product development for data center applications
+ Experience in product development, test & validation of connectors & sockets, High-Speed interconnect solutions.

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. jobs.description:
Our Client, SimpleTrials, is growing again!

About the Company

SimpleTrials is entering an exciting new stage of expansion, supported by double-digit year-over-year growth and a recent recapitalization. We are hiring a Director of Customer Success to own the post-sale customer experience and turn our installed base into a durable source of retention and expansion revenue.

SimpleTrials is a SaaS company serving clinical trial teams worldwide. Our configurable CTMS (Clinical Trial Management System) and eTMF (electronic Trial Master File) platform helps sponsors, CROs, and research sites manage studies, documentation, and reporting without the cost and complexity of traditional enterprise software.

We have a proven product and customers across the United States, Europe, and APAC. Many of those customers use only part of what the platform can do. Our next stage of growth depends on retaining our customers, deepening their adoption, and surfacing expansion opportunities as they get more value.

Position Summary

The Director of Customer Success will report to the CEO and lead both customer success strategy and execution. This is a hands-on role for someone who is energized by building strong customer relationships, reducing churn, and helping customers get the full value of the platform. This is a player-coach position: you will start with a small team of direct reports while staying hands-on with customers, with the opportunity to grow the team as the business grows.

You will own customer satisfaction and retention across our global customer base. You will design and deliver customer training that drives feature adoption, identify customers who would benefit from additional products or capacity, and pass qualified expansion leads to Sales. You will help design the upsell motion with Sales and leadership, but you will not be responsible for closing upsell deals.

The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Support to make sure customer insight shapes the roadmap and every customer has a clear path to more value.

What You'll Own

Customer satisfaction and retention

  • Own gross and net revenue retention, and build the plan to reduce churn across every region and segment.
  • Build a customer health scoring model using product usage, support activity, engagement, and renewal signals.
  • Identify at-risk accounts early and lead save plans with the right internal stakeholders.
  • Run a regular customer feedback program (e.g., NPS or CSAT) and turn the results into action.
  • Serve as the executive point of contact for key accounts and escalations.

Customer training and adoption

  • Design and deliver training programs, including webinars, live sessions, office hours, and on-demand content, so customers know what the platform can do.
  • Highlight underused features and modules that solve problems customers already have.
  • Build customer lifecycle touchpoints such as onboarding follow-ups, periodic business reviews, and release updates.
  • Partner with Marketing on customer-facing content, case studies, and references.

Expansion and upsell pipeline

  • Identify expansion opportunities through training sessions, account reviews, and usage data, and pass qualified leads to Sales.
  • Work with Sales and leadership to design the upsell motion, including lead criteria, handoff process, and follow-up expectations.
  • Track expansion leads sourced by Customer Success and report on their conversion to closed revenue.
  • Support Sales during expansion conversations with account context and customer relationships, without owning the close.

Customer insight and operations

  • Share customer feedback, feature requests, and churn reasons with Product and leadership.
  • Build the playbooks, processes, and reporting that make Customer Success repeatable as the business scales.
  • Establish regular reporting on retention, churn, health, adoption, and CS-sourced pipeline.

Team leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a small team of direct reports, setting clear goals and account ownership.
  • Define the team's structure, roles, and hiring plan as the customer base grows.

What Success Looks Like After 12 Months

  • Churn has measurably declined, and leadership has clear visibility into gross and net revenue retention.
  • A customer health score is in place, and at-risk accounts are flagged and acted on before renewal.
  • A recurring customer training program is running, and adoption of key features and modules has increased.
  • A defined upsell motion is in place with Sales, with agreed lead criteria, a clean handoff, and a steady flow of CS-sourced expansion pipeline.
  • Customer feedback regularly informs Product priorities and Marketing messaging.
  • Customer Success is operating as a strategic partner to Sales, Product, Marketing, and the CEO.

Who You Are

  • Successful experience in progressive B2B SaaS customer success roles, including at least several years managing and developing a team
  • Demonstrated track record of improving retention and reducing churn
  • Experience building customer health scoring, lifecycle programs, and CS playbooks
  • Strong ability to design and deliver engaging customer training, both live and on-demand
  • Experience partnering with Sales to identify and hand off expansion opportunities, and to build a repeatable upsell motion
  • Proven ability to identify, measure, and report on the KPIs that matter, providing meaningful, data-driven insights to the CEO
  • Comfort with CRM and customer success tools (e.g., Salesforce) and using product usage data
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex software and technical workflows
  • Comfort working directly with executive leadership and customer stakeholders at all levels
  • Willingness to travel approximately 25% as needed

Preferred Experience

  • Supporting customers in life sciences, clinical research, healthcare, or another regulated industry
  • Familiarity with CTMS, eTMF, or other clinical trial software
  • Supporting customers across the United States, Europe, and APAC
  • Working in a private equity-backed or growth-stage company
  • Building or scaling a customer success function in a growing software company

Compensation

The expected base salary range for this position is $170,000. Candidates are also eligible for an annual performance-based bonus of 20%, equity participation, and access to the company's benefits plan. The final offer will reflect the candidate's experience, qualifications, location, and the scope of the role.

Why SimpleTrials

SimpleTrials has a strong product, a committed team, and a meaningful mission: helping clinical trial teams manage complex work more efficiently so treatments can reach people faster.

This role will shape how our customers experience SimpleTrials, how much value they get from the platform, and how the company grows from within its existing customer base. The work will be visible, practical, and directly connected to the next stage of the business.

Salary: $170,000 / year

jobs.description:
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of a growing roofing company serving customers across California.

This role combines permit coordination, customer communication, invoicing, production scheduling, job documentation, and administrative support. You’ll work closely with project managers and field crews to keep roofing projects organized, compliant, and moving forward from signed contract through project close-out.

What You’ll Own

Permit Coordination

  • Manage the full permit process for roofing projects across California.
  • Track permit applications and follow up with local municipalities.
  • Ensure every job is fully compliant before work begins.

Customer Coordination

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for homeowners and commercial clients.
  • Answer inbound calls and respond to customer inquiries.
  • Keep customers informed throughout the production cycle.
  • Escalate issues requiring field decisions to the appropriate project manager.

Invoicing & Billing

  • Generate, send, and track invoices using QuickBooks.
  • Reconcile payments and maintain accurate records.
  • Flag outstanding balances to the appropriate team member in a timely manner.

Production Scheduling Support

  • Work alongside project managers and field crews to coordinate roofing project timelines.
  • Confirm material deliveries and job readiness.
  • Identify and flag scheduling conflicts before they affect crews on the ground.

Job & Document Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records in JobNimbus.
  • Keep photos, contracts, notes, and permit documentation organized.
  • Ensure the team has a reliable single source of truth for every active project.

Administrative Operations

  • Handle day-to-day office tasks, including filing and data entry.
  • Manage internal communication and administrative needs.
  • Support the smooth operation of the California team.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience in an operations coordinator, office manager, production coordinator, or administrative coordinator role.
  • Experience in construction, roofing, or a related trade is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with JobNimbus or a comparable construction CRM for job tracking and documentation.
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks for invoicing, payment tracking, and basic financial record-keeping.
  • Experience pulling building permits or coordinating permit applications.
  • Understanding of municipal permitting in California or a comparable jurisdiction.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Confidence representing a roofing company professionally on calls with customers, city offices, and contractors.
  • Ability to manage multiple active projects simultaneously.
  • Strong prioritization, organization, and record-keeping skills with minimal supervision.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You follow through without needing reminders and take ownership of tasks until they are completed.
  • You communicate proactively when something is delayed, behind schedule, or unclear.
  • You are highly precise with permit numbers, invoice amounts, job addresses, customer names, and other project details.
  • You remain calm and organized when multiple priorities require attention at the same time.
  • You know how to triage tasks, take clear notes, and keep work moving.
  • You are comfortable coordinating across teams and time zones through phone, email, and JobNimbus.
  • You are proactive about identifying potential issues before they impact customers, crews, or project timelines.

What Success Looks Like

  • Permit applications are tracked, followed up on, and completed before work begins.
  • Customers receive timely and professional communication throughout the production cycle.
  • Invoices and payments are accurately processed and tracked.
  • Project schedules, materials, and potential conflicts are proactively coordinated.
  • JobNimbus records remain accurate, complete, and up to date.
  • Project managers and field crews have the information they need to execute jobs smoothly.
  • Administrative tasks are completed reliably without constant follow-up.

Typical Day

Your morning starts by reviewing JobNimbus for new jobs, updated project statuses, and tasks that came in overnight.

You’ll check outstanding permit applications, send required follow-up documentation to city offices, and update project records accordingly. Mid-morning often brings inbound customer calls, where you’ll answer scheduling questions, provide project updates, and escalate anything requiring a field decision to the project manager.

Before midday, you may process new invoices in QuickBooks and reconcile recent payments.

Afternoons are typically focused on production coordination, confirming crew schedules, flagging material needs, and making sure upcoming roofing projects have everything in place before work begins.

You’ll work closely with project managers and field leadership, with most coordination taking place asynchronously through phone, email, and JobNimbus notes.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection

About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above Kansas. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need.

  • Leverage Zillow’s CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement.

  • Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently.

  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication.

  • Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions.

  • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

  • This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

  • 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license.

  • Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test – National Component with Uniform State Content.

  • Physically located in and working remotely from Kansas.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

BeOne is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the discovery and development of innovative drug therapies for the treatment of cancer. At BeOne we believe that access to life-changing medicine sees no borders.

The Senior Manager, Global Digital & Technology System Ownership is accountable for the day-to-day ownership, operational health, lifecycle execution, and compliant management of Global Patient Safety R&D externally developed platforms and validated systems within the global R&D technology portfolio.

This role translates the GRDTS system ownership model into disciplined execution across technical configuration, platform operations, lifecycle planning, release and upgrade coordination, access management, documentation, security activities, vendor delivery, budget inputs, and inspection-ready evidence.

The Senior Manager partners with R&D business process owners, Global Technology Solutions, Information Security, Quality, vendors, Finance, Procurement, project teams, and support functions to ensure assigned platforms remain compliant, secure, reliable, supportable, and aligned with scientific and business needs.

The successful candidate brings strong regulated-systems experience specifically in Safety systems, hands-on operational leadership, structured problem solving, and the ability to coordinate global stakeholders through platform changes, incidents, competing priorities, and complex technical dependencies.

Essential Functions of the job:

System Ownership Execution & Governance

• Execute the system ownership model for Global Patient Safety’s externally developed platforms, maintaining clear accountability for business purposes, technical health, compliance posture, roadmap, support model, and lifecycle status.

• Maintain system governance routines, decision logs, ownership records, operating controls, documentation standards, and cross-functional action tracking for validated and non-validated platforms.

• Serve as the primary operational escalation point for assigned platforms, coordinating issue prioritization, risk review, lifecycle recommendations, and stakeholder alignment.

Technical Configuration, Platform Implementation, Upgrades & Integrations

• Lead and coordinate technical configuration, platform implementation, upgrade readiness, integration changes, environment preparation, testing support, release execution, and post-release stabilization for assigned platforms for Global Patient Safety such as Argus, Case Intake system, Signal Detection platform, and Safety data mart and etc.

• Ensure implementation and change plans align with Enterprise IT standards, cybersecurity requirements, validation expectations, business readiness, data and integration needs, and operational support models.

• Manage dependencies, risks, communications, cutover activities, vendor deliverables, and stabilization actions for upgrades, integrations, enhancements, and platform modernization efforts.

System Life-Cycle Management & Roadmap Execution

• Manage lifecycle activities for assigned systems, including onboarding, capability expansion, roadmap maintenance, technical debt reduction, modernization, retirement, and transition planning.

• Convert business needs, platform needs, functions, features, technical constraints, and compliance requirements into executable roadmap items and prioritized delivery plans.

• Coordinate feature and functionality additions, edits, and enhancements with business owners, technical teams, Enterprise IT, vendors, and Quality stakeholders.

Operational Excellence for Validated Systems

• Own execution and monitoring of validated-system operations, including user access workflows, role governance, audit trail review, periodic review, security checks, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.

• Ensure operating activities are consistently performed, documented, inspection-ready, and aligned with GxP, computer systems validation, 21 CFR Part 11, internal SOPs, and Quality expectations.

• Identify and implement improvements to operational controls, review cadence, exception management, metrics, and issue closure practices.

System Documentation & SOP Management

• Create, maintain, and periodically refresh system ownership artifacts, configuration records, technical operating procedures, administration and user access SOPs, support playbooks, and other system documentation.

• Ensure documentation reflects current configuration, access models, integrations, lifecycle status, change history, operating procedures, support arrangements, and inspection-readiness needs.

• Coordinate SOP creation, review, approval, training impacts, evidence readiness, and audit response activities with Quality, business process owners, and system teams.

System Security, Patch, Certificate & SSO Coordination

• Coordinate system security and maintenance activities, including patch planning, vulnerability remediation, certificate renewals, single sign-on coordination, identity and access dependencies, and risk-based prioritization.

• Partner with Enterprise IT and Information Security to plan and execute security actions in alignment with corporate policies, system criticality, business continuity needs, validation requirements, and change controls.

• Maintain visibility of security risks, exceptions, remediation owners, due dates, evidence, and closure status through appropriate governance and escalation channels.

Budget Support, AOP & Vendor Management

• Develop annual operating plan inputs for assigned platforms, including license, maintenance, upgrade, support, vendor, implementation, and lifecycle investment assumptions.

• Manage vendor operational performance, service reviews, roadmap follow-up, escalations, contract and statement-of-work inputs, renewal preparation, deliverables, and action closure.

• Partner with Finance, Procurement, Legal, business owners, and vendors to track spend, commitments, renewals, service expectations, and delivery against agreed business priorities.

Incident, Issue & Platform Problem Management

• Lead operational response for platform incidents, recurring problems, integration failures, access issues, service disruptions, security events, and vendor delivery issues within assigned scope.

• Coordinate root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, communications, service restoration, risk documentation, escalation, and status reporting.

• Convert recurring platform issues into sustainable remediation plans, roadmap items, support model improvements, operating control changes, or vendor actions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Leadership

• Represent assigned system ownership priorities in working sessions and governance forums with R&D functions, Enterprise IT, Information Security, Quality, Finance, Procurement, and vendors.

• Lead and coach system owners, system managers, administrators, contractors, and matrixed partners in disciplined system ownership, compliant execution, technical rigor, and reliable service delivery.

• Contribute to GRDTS portfolio transparency, prioritization, audit and inspection readiness, operational metrics, and continuous improvement of technology operating practices.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with System Owners, System Managers, or other assigned GRDTS resources responsible for platform operations, lifecycle activities, documentation, and validated-system execution.

• Coordinate matrixed technical resources, vendor partners, contractors, system administrators, and project teams supporting assigned systems and platform initiatives.

Key Capabilities:

• System ownership execution: applying accountable ownership models, governance routines, lifecycle controls, operating standards, and escalation pathways for R&D platforms and validated systems.

• Platform delivery and operations: coordinating configuration, implementation, integrations, upgrades, releases, roadmap items, technical debt actions, and operational stabilization.

• Regulated systems management: executing user access workflows, audit trail review, periodic review, SOP alignment, evidence management, remediation tracking, and inspection readiness.

• Security and resilience coordination: managing patch, certificate, SSO, vulnerability, incident, continuity, and risk activities with Enterprise IT, Information Security, Quality, and vendors.

• Vendor and financial stewardship: preparing budget inputs, monitoring spend, managing service performance, supporting renewals, and tracking vendor commitments to closure.

Key Competencies:

• Systems thinking across business processes, platform configuration, integrations, data flows, access controls, compliance requirements, and operational support models.

• Cross-functional influence and clear communication with R&D, Enterprise IT, Information Security, Quality, Finance, Procurement, Legal, vendors, and global stakeholders.

Key Deliverables:

• Budget and vendor management materials covering annual operating plan inputs, renewals, service reviews, vendor commitments, contract and statement-of-work inputs, escalation logs, and performance follow-up.

• Incident and problem management records, including root-cause summaries, corrective and preventive action plans, stakeholder updates, decision logs, and durable remediation actions.

Other Qualifications:

• 7+ years of professional experience in digital, technology, information systems, R&D technology, application operations, systems engineering, or related areas; pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or regulated healthcare experience strongly preferred.

• 4+ years of progressive leadership or management experience coordinating technical teams, matrixed partners, vendor resources, and cross-functional delivery across global or complex operating environments.

• Experience with single sign-on, identity and access management, patching, certificates, vulnerability remediation, incident and problem management, vendor service management, and platform support processes.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.excerpt: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)Location: Remote (U.
jobs.description:
Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) Preference given to CA, TX and FL
Department: Engineering
Reports to: VP of Engineering
Starting Pay Range: $142k - $170k/yr

Company Overview

Work Truck Solutions is the operating system for the commercial vehicle industry. While the retail auto market is saturated with software, the $130B+ commercial truck market was operating in the dark—until we turned on the lights.
We are the only platform that connects the entire ecosystem: OEMs, upfitters, dealerships, and fleet buyers. By digitizing complex inventory data (chassis + upfits) and streamlining the supply chain, we don’t just help dealers sell trucks; we ensure American businesses get the mission-critical vehicles they need to work. We are a team of innovators, disruptors, and problem-solvers dedicated to one mission: removing the friction from the commercial vehicle industry. We are profitable, growing, and aggressively scaling our technology to remain the undisputed authority in this space.

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on remote role for someone who has built test automation programs before and wants to build the next one with AI at the center. You will own how we test our products end to end: the Playwright suite that covers our dealer software, our internal admin tools and Comvoy.com, the way tests get written and maintained, and the path from a pull request to a release we trust.
Our engineering team is moving to an agentic way of working, where much of our code is written by AI agents under human review. That only works if our tests catch what the agents get wrong, and you will be the person who makes that true. You will use AI to write, expand and maintain test coverage far faster than a team could by hand. Just as important, you know when not to test. AI makes it easy to generate thousands of tests, and 10,000 Playwright tests is far more than our application needs. You will judge every test by the value it provides and remove the ones that don’t earn their place.
You will sit on our Platform team, next to the engineers who own our cloud infrastructure, pipelines and environments, and you will work across every product team. A large part of the job is people. You will mentor our existing test engineers, pair with them, review their work and help them become strong automation engineers who build with AI every day.

Responsibilities

  • Own the test automation strategy. Decide what gets tested at which layer (unit, API, end to end) and drive automated coverage until it is the main way we know a release is safe. Define the measures that show progress, such as coverage, flake rate, run time and escaped defects, and report on them.
  • Decide what is worth testing. Set a clear bar for test value: what risk a test covers, what it costs to run and maintain, and whether a cheaper test at a lower layer would do the job. Review the suite against that bar regularly and delete tests that fall below it, including AI-generated ones.
  • Build and scale our Playwright suite. Lead the architecture of our TypeScript Playwright framework: page objects, fixtures, test data, environment handling, parallel runs and reporting.
  • Use AI to build and expand automation. Use AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) to write new tests, convert manual test cases and legacy tests, triage failures and fix flaky tests. Build the prompts, rules, skills and agent workflows that let the whole team work this way. Set the review standard for AI-generated tests so they check real behavior, not just pass.
  • Explore agentic testing. Evaluate and pilot newer approaches, such as agents that explore the application, generate test plans from requirements or repair broken locators. Bring in what works and drop what doesn’t.
  • Mentor the QA team. Coach our test engineers on automation design, Playwright and AI-assisted workflows through pairing, code review and hands-on teaching. You are measured on how much the team improves, not only on the tests you write yourself.
  • Build testing into the pipeline. Work with Platform engineers to run the right tests at the right stage of CI/CD, on short-lived test environments, with fast and reliable feedback to developers. Help us gate deployments on test results we trust.
  • Partner with developers. Help product engineers write testable code and own their own tests, including the test attributes and contracts that keep UI tests stable as the product changes.
  • Collaboration. Communicate clearly with a distributed team, raise quality risks early and work well with both technical and non-technical partners.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a very senior engineer. You have built and run test automation at scale, you have made other test engineers better, and you have already changed how you work because of AI.
  • Deep test automation experience. 7+ years in test automation or software engineering in test, including designing and owning an automation framework that a whole team used, not just contributing tests to one.
  • Expert in Playwright. Production experience with Playwright and TypeScript: fixtures, page objects, network interception, authentication state, parallel runs, tracing and tracking down flaky tests.
  • Judgment about test value. You know when not to test. You can explain why a given test is or isn’t worth keeping, and you have a record of shrinking a bloated suite while making it more useful.
  • Hands-on AI experience (required). You use AI coding agents in your daily work and can talk about that work in specifics: tests or frameworks you built with AI, prompts or agent configurations you wrote, and a time AI-generated tests went wrong and how you caught it. You are curious about where this is going and want to push it further.
  • A track record of mentoring. You have coached test engineers, including people moving from manual testing into automation, and you can point to people who grew because of you.
  • Strong coder in more than one language. You write and read code in multiple languages, including JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one backend language such as C#. You can read our codebase (a .NET backend with SvelteKit and React frontends) and understand what you are testing. You understand the JavaScript behind Playwright well enough to debug async behavior, the browser and the test runner itself. You treat test code as production code.
  • API and data testing. Experience testing REST APIs and creating and managing test data, including in SQL databases.
  • CI/CD. Experience running test suites in pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar) with a focus on speed, reliability and clear reporting.
  • Strong Git workflow. Branching, pull requests and code reviews are second nature.

Nice to Have

  • Testing in .NET (C#) with MSTest or NUnit, or frontend unit testing with Vitest.
  • Experience with SvelteKit or React applications.
  • Experience with Azure.
  • Testing LLM-powered features or building evaluations for AI output.
  • Performance, accessibility or visual regression testing.

Benefits

  • Meaningful work on industry-changing products.
  • Competitive salary and a Monday-Friday work week.
  • Excellent medical, dental, 401k, and complimentary life insurance.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays.
  • Flexible schedule (subject to manager’s discretion).

Work Truck Solutions DOES NOT sponsor H-1B visas.
