Description

Founded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners. Our work supports evidence-based, community-driven solutions that strengthen public health systems and advance equity across the communities we serve. At BME, our clients are on the front lines of Public Health. Priorities may shift but our commitment to supporting our partners does not. We take pride in having multi-year, multi-project engagements, often working closely as an extension of their staff. Our success comes from our shared values: a bias toward action; optimistically collaborative; willingness to navigate ambiguity; minimal ego - no job is too small or big; pursuing the equitable solution; always learning, and; committed to quality at every stage.

Position Overview

BME Strategies is looking for a highly detail-oriented and organized Operations (Ops) Coordinator to join our People, Operations & Finance team. This is a new, hands-on role that offers meaningful exposure to the internal operations of a growing public health consulting firm, spanning business operations, HR and compliance, finance, technology, and data. The Ops Coordinator will report directly to the Senior Manager, Finance & Operations.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and genuinely excited about the behind-the-scenes work that keeps a firm running well. A natural fit for this role is someone who thrives on variety, finds satisfaction in improving processes, and is comfortable navigating the pace and shifting priorities of a growing consulting environment. This role offers room to grow over time, with opportunities to build broad operational expertise, take on new projects, and evolve based on the needs of the organization and the employee's own interests, strengths, and aspirations. This role will fall under BME’s “Senior Associate” title stem.

Please note: the person hired for this role must be within commutable distance to both North Andover and Boston (within 45 minutes - 1 hour) and have reliable access to their own vehicle/transportation for mail collection.

Key Responsibilities

  • General Operations
    • Manage biweekly mail collection from our North Andover site, including bank deposits and electronic distribution of mail to the appropriate team members.
    • Coordinate logistics for monthly in-person staff gatherings in Boston, including space, scheduling, and on-site needs.
    • Maintain and keep current assigned projects and tasks within the department's project management systems, ensuring timelines and documentation are up to date.
    • Support limited business development operations tasks, including master services agreement data management and related administrative work, as needed.
    • Contribute to the documentation of internal operations processes.
    • Support ongoing process improvement efforts across the team.
    • Support internal communications, including drafting and posting Slack announcements for new contracts and other firm updates.
    • Make occasional purchases via company card and manage select vendor accounts and relationships, including associated billing.
  • Finance and Reporting Support
    • Assist with ad hoc financial and operational reports, including data analysis and synthesis.
    • Manage weekly transaction coding and mapping in QuickBooks Online, categorizing and flagging exceptions for reconciliation review.
    • Support the monthly invoicing process, including drafting invoices, pulling timesheet data, coordinating with Practice/Team Leads on billing details, issuing invoices, and maintaining the invoice tracker.
    • Manage receipt collection and documentation for expense tracking.
    • Assist with backend data pulls and cleanup in support of monthly reporting.
    • Contribute to project budget tracking and project data entry.
  • Technology and Systems
    • Manage software license administration and Google Workspace user maintenance, including staff additions and removals, shared drive permissions, distribution group updates, renewal tracking, and ongoing maintenance of the firm's tools inventory and technology budget.
    • Provide first-line internal tech support and training for staff.
    • Support accurate entry and maintenance of contract information in the firm’s CRM system.
  • Human Resources
    • Support onboarding and offboarding logistics, including systems and license setup and removal, computer shipments, preparation and distribution of onboarding materials, and coordination with managers.
    • Process HR system updates in Gusto, including employee record maintenance, address updates, and temporary supervisor changes, and maintain the firm's org chart to reflect current staffing.

Experience, Qualification, & Skills

  • Required:
    • Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant experience in operations, administration, or a related field
    • Bachelor's degree
    • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced consulting environment
    • Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills
    • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism
    • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines with reliability
    • Strong project management ability, including tracking tasks, flagging issues proactively, and follow through without close oversight
    • Comfort working across functional areas and with a variety of stakeholders
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills
    • Proficiency with standard office and productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace)
    • A genuine curiosity about how organizations operate and a desire to learn across multiple disciplines
  • Preferred:
    • Experience in a consulting, nonprofit, or professional services environment
    • Familiarity with HR information systems, payroll platforms (e.g., Gusto), or accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks Online)
    • Experience with CRM platforms or internal software administration
    • Experience with data analysis and the ability to organize, interpret, and present data clearly and accessibly
    • Exposure to finance, HR compliance, or people operations functions
    • And an alignment with BME’s shared values

Work Environment

  • This is a full-time, remote position within the Greater Boston, Massachusetts area, and includes bi-weekly travel to our North Andover site for mail processing and check deposits, as well as monthly travel to Boston for staff gatherings.

Compensation & Benefits

  • BME Strategies offers a competitive compensation package that includes:
    • 6+ weeks total leave, including paid vacation, sick time, personal leave, and floating holidays;
    • Health, dental, and vision insurance, with 80% employer-paid coverage for the employee & 70% employer-paid coverage for dependents;
    • Health FSA and dependent care FSA;
    • 401(k) with employer match;
    • Employer-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance;
    • One-time technology stipend;
    • And opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • The salary range for this position is $79,040 - $92,123 annually.

Please note: New employees are typically brought into the organization at a salary between the range minimum and the salary range midpoint, dependent upon internal equity and the budgeted amount for the position.

  • We expect a large volume of applicants for this position and only those candidates invited to move forward in the interview process will be contacted.

We do not use third-party domains for recruitment outreach. If you receive communication from a different email address, please do not respond and report it to us at
  • Please note that BME Strategies is unable to sponsor work-related visas.

Diversity not only includes race and gender identity but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. These varied points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. BME Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description:
SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

Job Description:

This role will begin as a contingent position with the potential to transition to a permanent position.


The Construction Engineer I supports four core Construction Engineering functions across SOLV’s EPC operations by providing engineering coordination, technical communication, and documentation rigor. This role contributes to (1) Warranty Analysis, by gathering data and supporting engineering review of potential design or installation issues; (2) Emerging Technologies Implementation, by assisting with GPS-enabled pile driving, drone-based survey workflows, and new construction tools; (3) Construction Engineering Support During Operations, by coordinating RFIs, design updates, and field engineering clarifications; and (4) Pile Load Testing Support During Initial Design, by assisting with planning, scheduling, documentation, and engineering communication for pre-construction pile testing programs.


This role is remote and will require travel. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.


*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned


Position Responsibilities and Duties:


Warranty Forensics

  • Gather field data, photos, as-built information, and installation details to support warranty claim evaluations.
  • Document potential design, manufacturing, or installation concerns and organize findings for review by senior engineering staff.
  • Compare field conditions against design documents, specifications, and installation standards to help identify root causes of warranty-related issues.
  • Maintain accurate, traceable warranty documentation logs to support issue tracking, escalation, and resolution.
  • Assist in coordinating engineering input for remediation plans and communicating required actions to project teams and clients.

Emerging Technologies Implementation


  • Support the deployment of advanced construction technologies, including GPS enabled pile driving, drone-based topo capture, and machine control datasets.
  • Prepare and maintain engineering datasets used for GPS machine control, real time grading/terrain workflows, and other technology-enabled processes.
  • Assist with field execution of drone flights, data collection, and upload processes as required by construction and engineering teams.
  • Capture and organize field feedback on technology performance and communicate improvement opportunities to engineering leadership.
  • Participate in development, rollout, and continuous improvement of new construction technology SOPs.

​Construction Engineering Support During Operations

  • Coordinate daily engineering information flow to field teams, ensuring timely distribution of drawing updates, clarifications, and consultant responses.
  • Manage RFIs by drafting clear, concise questions, gathering supporting documentation, routing to the correct engineering discipline, and tracking closure to avoid schedule delays.
  • Interpret and communicate project-specific design requirements such as SOLV standards, contract requirements, and permit conditions.
  • Maintain engineering document control systems, including drawing sets, data room folders, engineering exhibits, submittals, and version tracking.
  • Participate in constructability reviews by identifying missing details, design conflicts, or potential field execution risks.
  • Support owner/IE comment cycles by preparing comment logs, collecting consultant responses, and presenting organized summaries to project managers and field teams.
  • Monitor engineering deliverable timelines, identify at-risk items, and support mitigation efforts with internal and external engineering partners.

Pile Load Testing Support During Initial Design

  • Assist with coordinating pre-construction pile load testing activities, including drill-rig scheduling, field logistics, and test setup.
  • Document load test procedures, test sequences, and field results accurately and consistently.
  • Track, organize, and communicate pile test data to project engineers, geotechnical consultants, and design partners.
  • Ensure pile test documentation aligns with contract requirements, industry standards, and engineering expectations.
  • Support identification of soil behavior or foundation performance concerns based on load test observations and results.

General Engineering Responsibilities

  • Conduct drawing comparisons, quantity checks, and review of plan sets to identify potential discrepancies or missing information.
  • Participate in project site visits to gather field data, observe installation methods, validate design assumptions, and enhance constructability awareness.
  • Identify and escalate engineering risks such as conflicting details, missing information, or unforeseen field conditions.
  • Contribute to SOP, workflow, and internal database development, including lessons learned, testing procedures, and advanced technology processes.
  • Build strong working relationships with project managers, superintendents, field engineers, consultants, and internal engineering teams to support fast issue resolution.

​Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Studies, or a closely related technical field (preferred).
  • 0–3 years of relevant experience, with the ability to perform tasks with guidance and grow toward independent execution (aligned with Engineer I expectations).
  • Engineer‑in‑Training (EIT) certification preferred or willingness to pursue certification.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, including civil, structural, electrical, and geotechnical plans.
  • Foundational understanding of construction processes, testing practices (such as pile load testing), and engineering documentation.
  • High attention to detail with strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain accurate, disciplined documentation across multiple engineering workflows.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with the ability to identify inconsistencies, collect supporting information, and escalate engineering concerns appropriately.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of explaining design updates, gathering field information, and collaborating with project managers, engineers, and field teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word; exposure to CAD, GIS, drone‑capture platforms, GPS machine‑control datasets, or similar tools preferred.
  • Willingness to learn and support emerging construction technologies, including drone‑based surveys, GPS‑enabled equipment, and digital field data systems.
  • Ability to conduct field work, including walking construction sites, collecting data, observing installation methods, and participating in testing activities.
  • Sense of urgency and ownership, able to support fast‑paced construction environments and respond quickly to engineering information needs.
  • Team‑oriented, with the ability to work collaboratively across engineering, operations, warranty, and technology‑focused groups.

Career experience with the development and deployment of privacy and information governance process, specifically from the perspective of in-house legal departments, will be valuable, as will deep familiarity with specific privacy workflows – including privacy impact assessments, consent management, subject rights requests, etc.-- and collaboration with leaders in other corporate functions such as IT, Data & Analytics, Cybersecurity, etc.

The successful candidate will be comfortable discussing and researching topics including:

  • Legal’s role in establishing and maintaining a defensible privacy program
  • Information governance processes, challenges, workflows, and cross-functional relationships
  • Evolving privacy issues and how they impact organizational strategy, including sensitive personal information, privacy and AI, consumer trust, and data ethics
  • Emerging privacy regulations and issues (e.g., biometrics, AI governance, cross-border transfer restrictions)

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Serve as a leading authority on privacy and information governance topics, such as:
    • Privacy strategy and program management,
    • GDPR, CCPA, and other leading privacy regulations,
    • Privacy impact assessments and DPIAs,
    • Cross-border data transfer restrictions and processes,
    • Data inventory and mapping,
    • Data subject rights requests processes,
    • Cookies and consent and preference management,
    • Evolving issues in the privacy landscape, including AI and privacy, biometrics, and consumer trust and preferences.
  • Stay abreast of external trends in the privacy landscape, including related areas like AI and AI governance.
  • Collaborate with peers and other experts across teams (e.g., Legal, IT, Finance) to understand client challenges, current market dynamics, evaluate vendors, and establish shared and consistent thought leadership and positions on relevant issues
  • Develop content and insight around emerging topics on AI governance
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; JD degree preferred
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including experience working in privacy, information governance, or within a corporate in-house legal department dealing with privacy and information governance
  • Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating privacy risk management efforts, setting or executing privacy strategy, working on information or data governance efforts across multiple stakeholder groups, and reviewing and synthesizing emerging privacy and related regulations
  • Demonstrate executive presence; with the ability to establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Experience with AI governance highly desirable
  • Demonstrated executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

jobs.description:
*** Pour la version en francais, veuillez la consulter et postulerici sur le site de la Fondation Sephis ***

Call for Expressions of Interest (EOI)

Supply of agricultural equipment - small and medium-sized artisanal enterprises (Ghana, Guinea and Ivory Coast)

I. ABOUT THE SEPHIS FOUNDATION

The SEPHIS Foundation is an organization committed to promoting inclusive and sustainable entrepreneurship in West Africa. It focuses its actions on strengthening the capacities of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), with particular attention to the economic empowerment of women and young people.

Through its programs, SEPHIS supports local economic actors by facilitating access to financing, offering training adapted to the realities on the ground and contributing to the development of sustainable value chains, particularly in the agricultural and agro-industrial sectors.

Since its inception, the Foundation has supported over 5,000 women entrepreneurs. In 15 years of operation, SEPHIS has established itself as a leading player in supporting the growth of women-led SMEs in sub-Saharan Africa. Through an integrated approach combining market access and financing, it actively contributes to the creation of sustainable value on the continent.

Present in Ivory Coast, Senegal and Togo, SEPHIS has supported more than 5,000 SMEs and mobilized nearly 10 million euros, enabling more than 1,000 women-owned businesses to access structuring financing.

Within the framework of the nature-based climate adaptation project in the forests of Guinea in West Africa ( NbS Guinean Forests), the SEPHIS Foundation provides operational management of the "Business Exchange" component, thus contributing to strengthening the viability and growth of the local beneficiary companies.

II. CONTEXT

The Nature-Based Climate Adaptation in Guinean Forests of West Africa ( NbS Guinean Forests) project aims to strengthen the local and regional capacities of communities living in the Guinean forest zone in Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana and Guinea, in nature-based climate adaptation solutions, while promoting transformational leadership of women.

It is implemented by a consortium composed of World University Service of Canada (WUSC) and the Centre for International Studies and Cooperation (CECI) in partnership with national and international partner organizations. It is funded by Global Affairs Canada under the Partnership for Climate Action and aims for three main objectives:

  • strengthen women's leadership in climate adaptation planning processes;
  • increase the restoration of degraded forests and key habitats with benefits for biodiversity;
  • to promote inclusive and gender-sensitive investments that generate sustainable income for women.

III. CALL FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (AMI)

As part of the implementation of the "Business Exchange" component of the NbS Guinean Forests project, the SEPHIS Foundation is launching this Call for Expressions of Interest (CEI) in order to establish a database of qualified suppliers for the provision of equipment and materials adapted to the needs of small and medium-sized artisanal enterprises, particularly in the agricultural and agro-industrial sectors.

This call is addressed to companies, distributors, manufacturers and other commercial structures capable of supplying, in quantity and within reasonable timeframes, quality equipment to Ghana, Guinea and Ivory Coast, or to at least one of these countries.

Candidates selected following this call for expressions of interest will be listed in the SEPHIS Foundation's supplier directory. This listing is a prerequisite for participating in restricted tenders that will be launched later for equipment acquisitions for the benefit of Business Grant recipients.

It is important to note that selection under this call for expressions of interest does not constitute a contract award. It aims solely to prequalify suppliers who meet the technical, administrative, and operational requirements of the project.

Interested suppliers are invited to express their interest in supplying small equipment, particularly in the following categories (indicative and non-exhaustive list):

Category

Equipment type

  1. Agricultural tools
  • Irrigation kits and watering equipment;
  • portable tractors ;
  • mechanized weeders ;
  • threshers (mechanized, portable, etc.);
  • seed drills ;
  • tillers ;
  • shredders ;
  • dabas ;
  • machetes ;
  • sickles and scythes;
  • fertilizer spreaders ;
  • solar generators.
  1. Storage and transport
  • Food dehydrators ;
  • drying chimneys ;
  • grain dryers ;
  • mini -silos;
  • storage nets ;
  • motorized tricycles.
  1. agricultural transformation
  • Multifunctional shredders;
  • briquette production machines ;
  • animal feed pellet manufacturing machines ;
  • heat presses ;
  • food processing machines (biscuits, sweets, etc.)
  • soap manufacturing equipment ;
  • pottery machines ;
  • ointment manufacturing and mixing equipment.
  1. Protection
  • Personal protective equipment adapted to agricultural and processing activities.

IV. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS

Candidates wishing to respond to this Call for Expressions of Interest (CEI) are required to submit a complete application including the elements listed below. Any incomplete application or one that does not meet the requirements may be rejected.

1. General information about the company

  • The full company name;
  • A summary presentation (profile) of the company including: history, areas of intervention, organization, main activities and markets covered;
  • The presentation file must not exceed five (5) pages, including brochures.

2. Administrative and legal documents

  • A copy of the company's registration certificate or any equivalent document (trade register, articles of incorporation, etc.), in accordance with the legislation of the country of registration;
  • A valid copy of the tax identification certificate (or equivalent);
  • A valid tax compliance certificate or any equivalent document required in the country of origin.

3. Coordinates and geographical presence

  • The full physical address of the company's headquarters;
  • GPS coordinates (if available);
  • The addresses of the offices or representations in the country or countries concerned by the AMI;
  • A working phone number and a valid email address.

4. Experience and technical skills

  • A description of the company's experience in supplying equipment similar to that mentioned in this AMI;
  • Proof of at least three (3) years of relevant experience in the country or countries concerned;
  • Evidence demonstrating the company's ability to deliver equipment in the required quantity and within the required timeframe (contract references, purchase orders, invoices, certificates of satisfactory performance, etc.);
  • A description of logistical capabilities (storage, transport, after-sales service, geographical coverage, etc.).

5. Professional References

  • At least three (3) letters of recommendation or client references, ideally from the country in which the candidate wishes to work;
  • For applications covering multiple countries, three (3) separate references per country are required;
  • References should include customer contact details for possible verification.

6. Compliance, ethics and litigation

  • A declaration on honor attesting that the company is in compliance with legal and tax obligations;
  • A statement regarding the absence of fraudulent practices, corruption or conflicts of interest;
  • A list of all ongoing or past litigation within the last five (5) years, specifying the parties involved and the status of the case.

7. Additional information (if applicable)

  • Any relevant certification (quality, technical standards, approvals, etc.);
  • Any additional information deemed useful to demonstrate the company's technical and financial capacity.

Important notes:

  • All documents must be submitted in French, English or accompanied by a certified translation;
  • The SEPHIS Foundation reserves the right to request additional information or supporting documents;
  • The information provided may be subject to verification with the relevant authorities or the references indicated.

V. EVALUATION CRITERIA

Expressions of interest received under this Call for Expressions of Interest (CEI) will be evaluated by the SEPHIS Foundation according to a structured, transparent process based on pre-established qualification criteria.

The evaluation is solely for the prequalification of suppliers for inclusion in the SEPHIS Foundation database. It does not constitute a contract award.

1. Administrative compliance (Elimination criterion)

Applications will be reviewed first and foremost based on their compliance with the submission requirements. Any incomplete application or one that does not meet the minimum requirements will be deemed ineligible.

2. Professional Experience and References

  • Demonstrated experience of at least three (3) years in the supply of similar equipment;
  • Quality and relevance of the customer references provided;
  • Work experience in the countries covered by the project (Ghana, Guinea, Ivory Coast);
  • Ability to deliver comparable equipment in terms of volume and complexity.

3. Technical and operational capacity

  • Availability and diversity of equipment offered in relation to the project's needs;
  • Production, supply and delivery capacity within the required timeframes;
  • Presence or logistical capacity in the countries of intervention;
  • Availability of after-sales services, maintenance or technical support, where applicable.

4. Financial capacity

  • Overall financial strength of the company;
  • Ability to execute large volume orders without operational risk;
  • Stability of activities and continuity of operations over the last three years (if applicable).

5. Geographic Coverage

  • Ability to intervene in one or more countries of the project (Ghana, Guinea, Ivory Coast);
  • Local presence or partnerships enabling efficient delivery in targeted areas.

6. Ethical compliance and integrity

  • Absence of major disputes or convictions related to fraudulent practices, corruption or non-compliance;
  • Compliance with tax and social obligations;
  • Commitment to respecting the principles of ethics and integrity of the project.

Evaluation methodology

  • The evaluation will be carried out according to a qualification system (pass/fail) for administrative and compliance criteria;
  • The technical and operational criteria will be used to establish a list of qualified suppliers ;
  • Only candidates meeting the minimum requirements will be registered in the SEPHIS Foundation's supplier database;
  • The final selection for specific markets will be made later through competitive tenders.

VI. GENERAL CONDITIONS AND DISCLAIMER CLAUSES

1. Nature of the AMI

This Call for Expressions of Interest (CEI) is published for the purpose of prequalifying suppliers . It does not constitute a contractual commitment or a promise of contract award by the SEPHIS Foundation or its partners.

Participation in this call for expressions of interest does not confer any automatic right to the conclusion of future contracts.

2. Information verification

The SEPHIS Foundation reserves the right to carry out any verification of the information and documents provided by candidates, directly or through authorized third parties.

Any false, incomplete, misleading or intentionally erroneous information will result in the immediate elimination of the candidate, without prejudice to any further action.

3. Registration in the supplier database

Registration in the SEPHIS Foundation's supplier database:

  • does not constitute a guarantee of selection for future contracts;
  • does not imply any minimum volume or financial commitment;
  • may be reviewed, suspended or withdrawn at any time based on performance, compliance or ethical criteria.

4. Confidentiality and Ownership of Information

All information submitted in connection with this call for expressions of interest will be treated confidentially by the SEPHIS Foundation and its partners.

However, by submitting their application, candidates agree that this information may be shared with the project's technical and financial partners strictly for the purpose of evaluating and implementing the program.

5. Fraud, corruption and integrity

Any attempt at fraud, corruption, collusion or unethical practice will result in the immediate exclusion of the candidate and may lead to prosecution in accordance with applicable laws and the policies of financial partners, including Global Affairs Canada.

6. Responsibility of Bidders

Candidates are solely responsible for:

  • the accuracy and completeness of the information provided;
  • the conformity of their file to the requirements of this call for expressions of interest;
  • covering all costs related to the preparation and submission of their application.

The SEPHIS Foundation cannot under any circumstances be held responsible for the costs incurred by candidates in the context of this process.

7. Applicable Law

This call for proposals is governed by the internal rules and procedures of the SEPHIS Foundation as well as the requirements of the project's financial partners. Any interpretation or dispute relating to this call for proposals will be handled in accordance with the applicable contractual frameworks.

VII. SUBMISSION PROCEDURES

Companies and organizations interested in this Call for Expressions of Interest (AMI) are invited to submit their complete application exclusively electronically.

1. Submission Method

Applications must be sent by email to the following address:

No physical submissions will be accepted.

NbS Business Exchange Program "

Any application that does not comply with this instruction may not be considered.

3. File contents

  • The required documents are attached;
  • A consolidated file in PDF format (if possible);
  • Clearly named files (see section below).

4. Document format

  • The files must be readable, complete, and not password protected;
  • Attachments must be organized in a clear and consistent manner.

5. Submission deadline

Any submission received after this deadline will not be considered.

Job Title: Project Manager II

Job Location: Leeds

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

What if your project leadership skills helped new medicines take their first step in human clinical trials?

Fortrea is one of the world´s largest and longest-established early-phase clinical research organizations.

From first-in-human to exploratory biomarker or complex ph1b programs, our Clinical Pharmacology teams generate critical safety, tolerability, PK and PD data that help new medicines to move forward.

We are currently hiring a Project Manager II in the UK to drive this mission forward.

This is a full-time, remote job.

DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of assigned Healthy Volunteers and Patient Clinical Pharmacology projects independently or under the direction of a Senior Project Lead, overseeing complex, high‑value studies across regional / global, cross‑functional teams.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for sponsor project teams, managing expectations, driving communication, and building long‑term client relationships.
  • Own project scope, timelines, and budgets, proactively managing change, financial performance, and delivery against contractual commitments.
  • Apply your project leadership expertise to anticipate, identify, and mitigate risks, managing critical paths to ensure key milestones and performance metrics remain aligned with both client and Fortrea objectives.
  • Provide senior leadership within a matrix project environment, guiding and mentoring project team members while resolving issues and escalations at pace.
  • Ensure quality, compliance, and audit readiness, maintaining oversight of TMFs, CTMS activities, project training, and adherence to SOPs and ICH/GCP standards.
  • Contribute to business growth and operational excellence, supporting bid defence activities, strategic client relationships, KPI oversight, and process improvement initiatives.

AND YOUR LONG-TERM CONTRIBUTION?

You will play a key role in strengthening how Fortrea delivers Phase Ib clinical trials, helping evolve our approach to more complex early‑phase programs.

Beyond individual projects, your experience will support process innovation and operational delivery, influencing how Phase Ib studies are planned, executed, and scaled across Clinical Pharmacology Services.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Extensive clinical research experience within a CRO or biopharmaceutical environment, including at least 2 years of full project management accountability on domestic, regional and or international clinical studies.
  • Phase 1 and Phase Ib experience: Familiarity with early-phase trials in healthy volunteers and patients and their fast-paced environment is ideal, but international PM experience in Ph II-III will also be welcomed.
  • Financial Acumen: study budget management skills, with experience in forecasting, revenue recognition and change order development and negotiation.
  • Leadership: proven ability to inspire and manage globally dispersed teams and vendors, ensuring cross-functional collaboration and achieving core project milestones. Ability to work on multiple studies at any one time.
  • Risk Management: expertise in critical path analysis and the development of effective risk mitigation plans
  • Client Relations: a probing ability to build client trust, resolve complex challenges and influence decisions
  • BID presentation expertise.

Education/Qualifications:

  • University/college life science degree from an appropriately accredited institution.

Preferred:

  • Master´s or other advanced degree
  • PMP certification

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced professional — MBA or a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA), with a minimum of 3–5 years post-qualification experience (PQE) — to serve as a trusted right hand to the Managing Director (MD) of a diversified group with multiple business interests. This is a senior support role for a candidate who has hands-on experience managing a business or business unit, and can now bring that operational and financial judgment to support the MD across several ventures simultaneously.

This is not an entry-level PA position — we are looking for someone who has previously run, co-run, or held significant operational/financial responsibility within a business, and is now seeking a role working closely with ownership/leadership.

Tasks

  • Oversee day-to-day coordination across the MD's multiple business interests, ensuring priorities are tracked and deadlines met
  • Review and manage business finance and accounts, including monitoring cash flow, budgets, and financial reporting from each business unit
  • Manage the MD's diary, scheduling, and stakeholder liaison, prioritising competing demands and ensuring efficient use of the MD's time
  • Follow up on action items, decisions, and correspondence on behalf of the MD across all business units
  • Draft, edit, and proofread reports, and executive summaries for internal and external stakeholders
  • Identify, escalate, and summarise operational or financial issues requiring the MD's attention, with recommended courses of action
  • Liaise with department heads, external advisors (legal, accounting, banking), and business partners on the MD's behalf
  • Support strategic projects, including business reviews, market research, and investment or expansion proposals
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive business and financial information

Requirements

  • MBA from a recognised institution OR a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — finance, general management, or strategy background preferred
  • Minimum 3–5 years of post-qualification experience (PQE), with proven experience managing a business, business unit, or department — real operational or P&L responsibility, not purely staff/support experience
  • Ideally, prior experience supporting senior leadership or a business owner with multiple ventures
  • Strong financial literacy: able to read management accounts, interpret cash flow statements, and flag anomalies
  • Excellent written English, with proven ability to produce polished reports, summaries, and correspondence
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple workstreams under time pressure
  • Discreet, trustworthy, and professional, with strong stakeholder management skills
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Based in or willing to work Delhi NCR hours; role is remote but requires strong availability and responsiveness, including occasional flexibility outside standard hours

Benefits

  • Direct exposure to senior leadership and cross-business strategic decision-making
  • Remote working flexibility with a Delhi NCR-based preference
  • Competitive salary of ₹3–6 LPA, based on experience
  • Opportunity to build a long-term career supporting a growing multi-business group

Interested candidates should send their CV along with a short cover note outlining their business management experience .

Job Title: AI Literacy Manager

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

AI Literacy Manager

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will be responsible for AI Literacy program management, learning operations and go-to-market product delivery. This incudes managing AI Literacy programs, developing trainings, and increasing AI fluency and readiness, measured via engagement metrics, feedback, and adoption rates.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Manager, AI Literacy will lead complex, cross-functional enterprise efforts to ensure Amgen colleagues can understand foundational AI concepts, apply AI responsibly and collaborate with AI meaningfully in their day-to-day work.

You will be responsible for leading enterprise-wide programs and moments that inspire and scale AI literacy and adoption globally. Collaborate with Corporate Affairs, Responsible AI Literacy, functional Learning & Performance leaders and technical teams to continuously evolve existing AI literacy efforts focused on AI fundamentals, applying AI responsibly and human-AI collaboration.

Responsibilities:

  • AI Literacy: Plan and deliver AI literacy initiatives that reach employees at all levels across Amgen, with an initial focus on certification programs and large-scale social learning events.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with product, technology, communications and responsible AI teams to plan, coordinate and implement AI literacy programs, ensuring that AI learning initiatives adhere to enterprise guidelines and responsible AI policies.
  • Change Enablement: Develop cultural transformation initiatives for engagement strategies that drive organizational alignment on AI initiatives. Partner with functions to identify role-specific workflow opportunities and help teams integrate AI into business processes, driving measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and decision-making.
  • Education & Engagement Program Delivery: Implement tailored education programs to build AI fluency across all levels of the organization, ensuring teams are equipped to use AI effectively. Develop tailored material and training modules for leaders and partners
  • Organize and deliver high-impact events (e.g., AI Symposiums, Digital Learning Days, Hackathons) to foster community engagement. Collaborate with Corporate Affairs to create marketing material and campaigns for these events.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Lead stakeholder mapping, management and inclusion. Create enterprise ready content to ensure cohesive messaging and clear articulation of AI's value across the organization.
  • Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Track and report on the effectiveness of AI learning programs and GTM initiatives. Define and monitor adoption, engagement, capability, and business impact metrics to assess effectiveness and continuously improve programs.
  • AI expertise: Understand when and how to apply generative AI to produce better outcomes, increase efficiency and enhance your cognitive capacity and judgement.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The technology professional we seek is an educator with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree with 5 years of AI or technology education or Go-to-Market experience

OR

Master’s degree and 8 years of AI or technology education or Go-to-Market experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Project and Change Management: 5+ years of experience leading large-scale AI or technology transformation programs in large, complex Fortune 500 environments. Record of building strong partnerships with cross-functional teams and managing diverse workloads to meet deadlines. Agile, PMP, and/or Prosci certifications are preferred.
  • Learning & Development: Consistent track record of executing successful L&D or GTM technology programs, preferably in a biopharma, technology, or AI-focused environment. Background in adult learning theory or learning experience design for technology-related skills.
  • AI Acumen: Comfortable using generative AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot and Lovable to improve business results. Know how to avoid AI slop and continue to think for yourself while improving results with AI. Hands-on technical ability to build Custom GPTs, Workspace agents and other automations. Optimistic and empathetic approach to AI enablement. Understanding of AI-focused solutions and digital transformation trends, particularly in life sciences.
  • Expert Communication Skills: Demonstrable ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences to inspire and scale adoption. Experience producing executive level content and reporting.
  • Independent and Collaborative Working Style: Ability to work autonomously with minimal guidance and know when to seek input, combined with a collaborative approach to obtain alignment and support project goals.
  • Leadership Skills: Strong leadership and team management skills with experience managing cross-functional teams for GTM and technical education programs.
  • Innovation mindset and ability to navigate ambiguity and operate in startup mode in a large, complex organization.

Nice-to-Have

  • Background in AI/software development or IT delivery
  • Familiarity with AI&D product lifecycle and go-to-market strategies.
  • Familiarity with enterprise learning ecosystems, layered literacy models, role-based enablement, or function-led training coordination
  • Experience developing or deploying AI-enabled enablement tools, such as chatbots, knowledge assistants, retrieval-based guidance tools, workflow copilots, or other interactive guidance mechanisms
  • Experience with human-centered design, service design, product management, UX research, or responsible AI

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives

We are a fast-paced company, committed to growing a formidable business. We will do so by delivering exceptional value to our clients and developing new and innovative ways for our tech to grow.

  • Fab newly fitted out office in the heart of Leamington Spa

  • Free mental health support through Mindful Employer Plus
  • Cultural and active lifestyle contributions for a healthy mind and body
  • Sabbatical scheme – just send us a postcard
  • Regular team socials but no ‘forced fun’

LOCATION

This role can be carried out in the UK or remotely from another European country. Some travel to the UK may be required. Applicants based outside Europe cannot be considered.

SALARY

We will ensure that exact salary offered for you will be competitive, country specific and based on your qualifications, competencies, professional experience and requirements for the corresponding job function.

If you think you're who we're looking for, drop us a line and let's have coffee (in person or virtually).

NO COVER LETTER, NO REPLY!

jobs.excerpt: About the Role:We’re building AI into STARLIMS, a platform used across quality manufacturing, life sciences, public health, forensics, and environmental sciences.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

We’re building AI into STARLIMS, a platform used across quality manufacturing, life sciences, public health, forensics, and environmental sciences.

This role is focused on agentic systems: software that reasons over a task, calls tools, works through multiple steps, and hands the result to a person to review and approve.

Our users work under strict accuracy, traceability, and validation requirements. The engineering challenge is making non-deterministic systems reliable, observable, and controllable enough to be trusted, tested, and shipped.

You’ll work on both the platform and runtime our agents execute on and the production agents built on top of it.

What You’ll Work On:

Agent Platform & Runtime (Core Focus)

  • Design and build the runtime our agents execute on: planning and execution loops, tool calling, state management, durable execution, and failure recovery
  • Build the layer through which agents reach platform data and external systems safely
  • Design coordination, delegation, and handoff across agents and workflows where needed
  • Make agent behavior versionable, testable, measurable, and regression-safe across releases
  • Build reusable primitives so new agents are configured rather than rebuilt from scratch

Building Agents (Core Focus)

  • Take a domain workflow from expert conversation to a working agent: goals, actions, execution flow, failure handling, and success criteria
  • Ground agent decisions and outputs in authoritative enterprise data rather than relying on model knowledge alone
  • Implement human-in-the-loop by design, including approval gates, override capture, uncertainty handling, and clear evidence for agent decisions. Agents recommend and draft; people decide
  • Close the loop: turn user corrections and overrides into signals that measurably improve the agent

Evaluation & Reliability

  • Build evaluation harnesses for multi-step behavior, not single-response accuracy: task completion, tool-call correctness, groundedness, trajectory quality, and regression across model, prompt, and tool changes
  • Define production metrics for agent quality, reliability, latency, cost, and human intervention rates
  • Implement guardrails, fallbacks, timeouts, cost ceilings, and end-to-end observability and tracing across agent runs
  • Design safeguards against prompt injection, unsafe tool use, excessive permissions, data leakage, and other agent-specific security risks
  • Manage prompt evolution, model drift, and non-determinism while maintaining consistent, measurable system behavior across releases

Integration & Data

  • Integrate agents with platform APIs and third-party enterprise systems already running in our customers’ environments
  • Build retrieval and context pipelines that turn fragmented enterprise data into reliable, permission-aware agent context
  • Design controlled execution paths for automated actions, with a complete, traceable audit trail

Platform & Infrastructure

  • Build and operate backend services on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, etc.)
  • Own significant parts of the system architecture and contribute to key technical decisions
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and deployment pipelines

Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python
  • Backend: Node.js, Python, AWS Lambda, Step Functions
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP and related agent/tool protocols, embeddings and vector search
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
  • Testing: Jest, Playwright, pytest

What We’re Looking For

Must Have

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, including production systems
  • Strong understanding of LLM behavior, limitations, and failure modes, especially how errors compound across a multi-step run
  • Experience with LLM APIs, tool and function calling, and designing planning and execution loops
  • Experience evaluating and debugging non-deterministic systems
  • Solid backend and cloud experience (AWS or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python

You Should Be Comfortable With

  • Debugging across distributed and non-deterministic systems
  • Making explicit tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost
  • Working in ambiguous problem spaces where the right architecture isn't obvious yet
  • Owning production systems end-to-end
  • Choosing conventional software over AI when AI isn't the right solution

Nice to Have

  • C#, Microsoft .NET Framework
  • Tool and interop protocols such as MCP
  • Experience building production LLM systems, including tool-using or multi-step agentic workflows beyond simple prompting and chat interfaces
  • Evaluation pipelines and metrics built specifically for agentic systems
  • Experience in regulated or domain-heavy systems (validation, audit trails, controlled change)
  • Retrieval and grounding techniques for supplying agent context
  • Workflow and durable-execution platforms (Temporal, Step Functions, n8n, etc.)
  • Containerization and orchestration (ECS, EKS, Kubernetes)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)

What You’ll Be Doing:

Position Summary

The Senior QA Automation Engineer leads the quality strategy for the Evolent Platform web user experience. This role designs and maintains end-to-end, component, accessibility, contract, and test automation for a React and Next.js application and owns the quality signals that determine release readiness.

This individual works independently with minimal supervision, applies creativity to testing challenges, sets and upholds the automation patterns others follow, and mentors quality engineers across the team. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate testing and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on test strategy and solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy and Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and manage comprehensive test strategies for the user experience, covering functional, regression, accessibility, performance, and AI-output quality.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and product planning to ensure quality is built into all phases of the software lifecycle.
  • Define and uphold test automation patterns and standards in partnership with testing automation architects and front-end leads.
  • Mentor quality engineers, promoting best practices in testing, automation, and quality assurance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in testing processes, tools, and methodologies, and evaluate emerging testing technologies for applicability.

Test Automation and CI/CD

  • Lead the creation, maintenance, and optimization of Playwright end-to-end suites and Vitest component tests for React and Next.js features.
  • Build contract tests for the AG-UI event stream, verifying event sequencing, shared state, tool-call events, and human-in-the-loop approval interrupts.
  • Build API tests for backend-for-frontend endpoints and .NET and Python (FastAPI) services.
  • Test streaming behavior and resilience, including slow, interrupted, and failed agent calls, retries, and timeouts.
  • Plan and execute basic load and performance tests for streaming endpoints and data-heavy screens.
  • Integrate and execute automated suites in GitHub Actions, maintaining a consistently high pass rate and reliable results.

Accessibility Testing

  • Lead accessibility testing against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508, combining automated axe-core checks with manual screen reader testing using JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver.
  • Partner with engineering and design to triage accessibility defects and support independent accessibility conformance reviews.

Defect Management and Quality Reporting

  • Isolate, analyze, document, and prioritize defects before escalating to developers, and collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders for timely resolution.
  • Analyze test and evaluation results, generate quality metrics, and report on quality state and release readiness to stakeholders.
  • Present work in Agile ceremonies and lead technical knowledge-sharing sessions.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering

  • Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, test script development, test data generation, documentation, troubleshooting, and defect analysis.
  • Evaluate and validate AI-generated tests, scripts, and analysis for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve testing productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, skills, agents, testing playbooks, and AI-assisted testing patterns to benefit the broader engineering organization.

Governance and Compliance

  • Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information (including PHI in test data) is used with unapproved AI services or tooling; use synthetic data for testing.
  • Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, including 3+ years of hands-on test automation for modern web applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright using TypeScript or JavaScript for end-to-end automation.
  • Experience with component testing using Vitest or Jest and React Testing Library.
  • Experience testing React-based web applications, including asynchronous and streaming behavior.
  • Hands-on accessibility testing experience with axe-core and manual screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver) against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508.
  • Experience with API testing and contract testing, including schema-based validation of APIs or event streams.
  • Experience with load or performance testing tools (e.g., k6, JMeter).
  • Experience creating and maintaining automation jobs in CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions with YAML) and version control with Git.
  • Knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, ALM).
  • In-depth knowledge of testing methodologies, including functional, regression, accessibility, and performance testing.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python for test tooling or agent evaluation.

Education

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member and provider experiences.

The Principal, Segment QE Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for defining, designing, and scaling enterprise-wide test automation strategies, frameworks, platforms, and AI-enabled quality engineering capabilities. This role serves as the enterprise automation authority across Humana's business segments, partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, Product, and Quality Engineering teams to accelerate software delivery through modern automation and intelligent quality practices.

The Principal Automation Segment Architect will lead the adoption of automation-first testing approaches, establish enterprise standards and frameworks, drive AI-enabled testing innovations, and provide technical leadership for quality engineering transformation initiatives. This individual will be responsible for designing scalable automation solutions leveraging technologies such as Selenium, Playwright, REST Assured , Tricentis Tosca, Azure DevOps (ADO), qTest, API automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-powered testing agents, while enabling delivery teams to achieve greater speed, reliability, and quality.

Enterprise Automation Strategy & Architecture

Use your skills to make an impact

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Cloud para atuar na evolução, sustentação e modernização dos ambientes cloud da Qualicorp, contribuindo para a construção de uma arquitetura escalável, segura e altamente disponível em um ecossistema multi-cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP).

Esta posição terá papel estratégico na jornada de transformação digital da companhia, apoiando a aceleração das migrações para cloud, a consolidação das práticas de DevOps e SRE, a implementação de observabilidade ponta a ponta e a automação de infraestrutura e operações, garantindo alta performance e confiabilidade para sistemas críticos do negócio.

Se você possui experiência em plataformas cloud, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform ou CloudFormation), CI/CD, automação e observabilidade, além de um perfil colaborativo, analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas, essa oportunidade pode ser para você!

Nesta posição você será responsável por:

  • Projetar e manter infraestrutura cloud escalável em AWS, Azure e/ou GCP usando Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation);
  • Orquestrar e gerenciar clusters Kubernetes em produção (EKS, AKS, GKE), incluindo deployment, scaling, networking e troubleshooting;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para automação end-to-end de builds e deployments;
  • Implementar e manter soluções de observabilidade, logging e monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch) para visibilidade de sistemas;
  • Otimizar custos cloud através de rightsizing, reserved instances, auto-scaling e análise de desperdícios;
  • Colaborar em segurança cloud-native: IAM, VPC, secrets management, compliance LGPD/HIPAA;
  • Suportar desenvolvimento de aplicações containerizadas com Docker, orientando best practices.

Requisitos para candidatura:

  • Cloud Platforms: Expertise profunda em pelo menos uma (AWS, Azure ou GCP). Domínio de compute, storage, networking e security services;
  • Kubernetes: Experiência em produção com EKS, AKS ou GKE. Manifests YAML, networking, autoscaling, helm charts;
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficiência em Terraform ou CloudFormation. Modularização, versionamento, state management;
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Design e implementação com GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou Jenkins;
  • Docker & Containerização: Build, otimização e deploy de imagens Docker. Docker registry management;
  • Linux: Administração profundo de Linux (Red Hat, Ubuntu). Shell scripting (Bash), package management, system hardening;
  • Observability: Implementação de Prometheus, Grafana ou ferramentas equivalentes (CloudWatch, Application Insights)
  • Scripting: Python ou Bash para automação de tarefas operacionais.

Habilidades e comportamentos que fazem a diferença:

  • Diligência: Meticulosidade em configurações de segurança, documentação detalhada de arquiteturas, cumprimento rigoroso de compliance (LGPD, HIPAA) e SLAs de uptime;
  • Negociação: Comunicação clara de trade-offs técnicos e financeiros (performance vs. custo), alinhamento com stakeholders em decisões arquiteturais complexas;
  • Atitude: Ownership de problemas em produção, aprendizado contínuo com novas tecnologias, mentalidade de melhoria contínua e pró-atividade em documentar soluções;
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de troubleshooting rápido em ambientes complexos, debugging de pipelines, análise de logs e métricas;
  • Colaboração: Trabalho efetivo em equipe cross-functional (developers, security, product), mentoria de juniores, pair programming.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Fullstack EngineerYour Opportunity:We're building a category-defining company at the intersection of real estate, technology, business services, and the consumer.
jobs.description:
Senior Fullstack Engineer

Your Opportunity:

We're building a category-defining company at the intersection of real estate, technology, business services, and the consumer. As a profitable, hypergrowth startup on the path to an IPO, our standards are high, our team is scrappy, and our commitment is to execute the best work of our lives.

This is YOUR CHANCE to shape the backbone of a company that's scaling rapidly and innovating boldly. As our Senior Fullstack Engineer, you'll partner with the CTO, founders, and executives to build and scale our mortgage technology platform, shipping features end to end across a mix of microservices and monolith architectures, with a focus on backend systems and third-party integrations. If you thrive in complexity, entrepreneurial problem-solving, and believe in scaling through tech and AI, this is your PLACE.

Who Develops You: CTO

What You're Great At:

You are a seasoned engineer with 7+ years building and running production web applications, and you take a problem from a vague description to a shipped, monitored solution. You go deep on Ruby on Rails, including API-only services, ActiveRecord, PostgreSQL, background jobs, and RSpec. You're also comfortable shipping polished UI with React and TypeScript, and you've worked with GraphQL (ideally Apollo) on both server and client.

You've built distributed, event-driven systems and know how to debug failures that span services, using retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency. You've also tamed third-party integrations (REST, SOAP, webhooks) and partner APIs that are slow, inconsistent, or poorly documented. You treat sensitive personal and financial data with care and have strong instincts for security and multi-tenant data isolation.

You use AI and agentic coding tools at an advanced level every day, can describe how you structure context for agents and verify what they produce, and you build tooling that makes other engineers more effective. You communicate clearly: you can write a strong design doc, explain a production incident to a customer success manager, and disagree productively with a product manager. You own production through on-call, incident response, observability, and blameless postmortems.

Bonus points if you have experience in mortgage tech or a similar regulated, integration-heavy domain (fintech, lending, insurance, payments, healthcare), familiarity with LOS platforms (Encompass, MortgageBot, Byte) or MISMO standards, Node.js/TypeScript services, Elasticsearch, Redis, Docker, AWS, CI/CD, saga or workflow orchestration patterns, or a history of mentoring engineers and leading cross-team projects.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain features across Rails API services, TypeScript/Node services, a GraphQL gateway, and React frontends
  • Own integrations with external platforms (LOS systems, mortgage insurance providers, document and e-sign vendors), including data mapping, sync and reconciliation, retries, and idempotency
  • Design and evolve asynchronous, multi-step workflows using message queues (RabbitMQ, SNS/SQS), Sidekiq background jobs, and saga-style orchestration
  • Keep our multi-tenant platform correct and secure, respecting partner boundaries in every query and event
  • Lead technical design for significant features by writing design docs and architecture decision records, weighing trade-offs, and building alignment before you build
  • Identify and pay down technical debt, improving service boundaries, module design, test coverage, and developer experience
  • Hold a high bar in code review and help set engineering standards across the team
  • Join the on-call rotation, lead incident response, and follow through on root-cause fixes that prevent recurrence
  • Use observability tools and CI/CD to keep the platform healthy, and improve them where they fall short
  • Work directly with Customer Support & Success on lender-reported escalations, reproducing issues, investigating sync problems with external LOSs, and explaining findings clearly to non-engineers
  • Partner with Product Managers to refine requirements, uncover edge cases early, and propose simpler alternatives
  • Work with UI/UX Designers to turn designs into polished, accessible interfaces, and push back constructively when technical constraints affect the experience
  • Mentor other engineers through pairing, code review, and design feedback, including on effective AI-assisted workflows
  • Lead on AI-assisted engineering by using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) daily to plan, implement, test, debug, and review, and by delegating well-scoped work to agents and reviewing their output rigorously
  • Build and maintain shared AI tooling for the team, including agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), reusable skills and prompts, MCP servers connecting agents to internal systems, and automated workflows
  • Set and follow guardrails for AI use: verify agent output, never expose secrets or customer data, and know when a task needs a human-written solution

Why Maxwell:

We believe people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and surrounded by others who are equally driven. That's why this role includes a "work from the place you work best" approach – at home, in an office, or on the move. Our competitive benefits include PTO as needed, comprehensive insurance coverage, a 401(k) match, stock option grants, and a stock purchase plan. Every team member is an owner, building the place they are proud to call "my company."

ICF's Global Health and Development (GHD) line of business, part of the Health, People, and Human Services (HPHS) Group, is seeking an Applied AI Engineer to build frontier-model systems for various global health and survey programs. This role will support the development of AI-enabled tools that draft survey reports, let researchers and policymakers analyze data in natural language, translate questionnaires into low-resource languages, and support interviewers and data quality in the field. No tool is adopted unless it matches or beats the expert-led process it replaces. You will build the prompting, agent, and pipeline layer across the program. You will also build the evaluation harnesses that show whether each tool actually works, judged against ground truth produced by some of the most experienced survey methodologists in the world.

  • Design and build LLM pipelines and agents for survey workflows, including:
